5.206.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi narādhipa ..
bālamaṃḍanamāhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
5.206.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि नराधिप ..
बालमंडनमाहात्म्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
5.206.m: Viśvāmitra said: / All this has been related to you as I was asked, O ruler of men: / the māhātmya of Bālamaṇḍana, which destroys all sins,

5.206.s:
yatraikasminnapi snāne kṛte pārthivasattama ..
sarveṣāṃ labhyate puṇyaṃ tīrthānāṃ snānasaṃbhavam ..
māghamāse trayodaśyāṃ śuklapakṣa upasthite .. 2 ..
5.206.d:
यत्रैकस्मिन्नपि स्नाने कृते पार्थिवसत्तम ..
सर्वेषां लभ्यते पुण्यं तीर्थानां स्नानसंभवम् ..
माघमासे त्रयोदश्यां शुक्लपक्ष उपस्थिते .. 2 ..
5.206.m: where, when even a single ablution is performed, O best of kings, / the merit arising from bathing in all sacred fords is obtained, / on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Māgha.

5.206.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
kasmācchakrasya saṃsthānaṃ paṃcarātraṃ dharātale ..
nādhikaṃ jāyate teṣāṃ yathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām .. 3 ..
5.206.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
कस्माच्छक्रस्य संस्थानं पंचरात्रं धरातले ..
नाधिकं जायते तेषां यथान्येषां दिवौकसाम् .. 3 ..
5.206.m: Ānarta said: / Why is Indra's stay on the surface of the earth for only five nights, / and not longer, as it is for other gods?

5.206.s:
varṣāṃte kāni cāhāni yeṣu śakro dharātale ..
samāgacchati ko māsa etatsarvaṃ bravīhi me .. 4 ..
5.206.d:
वर्षांते कानि चाहानि येषु शक्रो धरातले ..
समागच्छति को मास एतत्सर्वं ब्रवीहि मे .. 4 ..
5.206.m: And at the end of the year, which are the days on which Indra / comes to the earth, and what is the month? Tell me all this!

5.206.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi kathā menāṃ dharādhipa ..
paṃcarātrātparaṃ śakro yathā na syāddharātale .. 5 ..
5.206.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि कथा मेनां धराधिप ..
पंचरात्रात्परं शक्रो यथा न स्याद्धरातले .. 5 ..
5.206.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Listen, O king of the earth, I will tell this story / of how Indra may not remain on the surface of the earth for more than five nights.

5.206.s:
āsītpūrvaṃ bṛhatkalpe jayatsenaḥ sureśvaraḥ ..
trailokyasya samastasya svāmī dānavadarpahā .. 6 ..
5.206.d:
आसीत्पूर्वं बृहत्कल्पे जयत्सेनः सुरेश्वरः ..
त्रैलोक्यस्य समस्तस्य स्वामी दानवदर्पहा .. 6 ..
5.206.m: Formerly, in the Bṛhatkalpa, there was a lord of gods named Jayatsena, / master of the entire three worlds, who crushed the pride of the Danavas.

5.206.s:
trailokye sakale pūjāṃ bhajamānaḥ sadaiva hi ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya gautamasya muneḥ priyā .. 7 ..
5.206.d:
त्रैलोक्ये सकले पूजां भजमानः सदैव हि ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य गौतमस्य मुनेः प्रिया .. 7 ..
5.206.m: He always received worship in all the three worlds. / But after some time, the beloved wife of the sage Gautama,

5.206.s:
ahilyānāma bhāryā'bhūdrūpe ṇāpratimā bhuvi ..
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cakame śakraḥ kāmadevavaśaṃ gataḥ ..8..
5.206.d:
अहिल्यानाम भार्याऽभूद्रूपे णाप्रतिमा भुवि ..
तां दृष्ट्वा चकमे शक्रः कामदेववशं गतः ..8..
5.206.m: named Ahilyā, was matchless in beauty on earth; / having seen her, Indra fell under the power of the god of love and desired her.

5.206.s:
nityameva samāgatya svargalokātsa kāmabhāk ..
gautame nirgate rājansamididhmārthameva hi ..
darbhārthaṃ phalamūlārthaṃ svayameva mahātmabhiḥ .. 9 ..
atha tasya samācakhyau nārado munisattamaḥ ..
śakrasya ceṣṭitaṃ sarvaṃ tathāhilyāsamudbhavam .. ..6.207.1...
5.206.d:
नित्यमेव समागत्य स्वर्गलोकात्स कामभाक् ..
गौतमे निर्गते राजन्समिदिध्मार्थमेव हि ..
दर्भार्थं फलमूलार्थं स्वयमेव महात्मभिः .. 9 ..
अथ तस्य समाचख्यौ नारदो मुनिसत्तमः ..
शक्रस्य चेष्टितं सर्वं तथाहिल्यासमुद्भवम् .. ..6.207.1...
5.206.m:
Coming regularly from the world of heaven, he indulged his desire / whenever Gautama had gone out, O king, for the purpose of kindling-wood, / for sacred grass, or for fruits and roots, as the great-souled [sages] themselves do.
Then Nārada, the best of sages, told him / all of Śakra's conduct, and likewise what had occurred with Ahilyā.

5.206.s:
tacchrutvā sahasā tūrṇaṃ gautamo gṛhamabhyagāt ..
yāvatpaśyati deveśaṃ saha patnyā samāgatam ..11..
5.206.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा सहसा तूर्णं गौतमो गृहमभ्यगात् ..
यावत्पश्यति देवेशं सह पत्न्या समागतम् ..11..
5.206.m: Hearing that, Gautama immediately and swiftly went to his house, / only to see the lord of the gods united with his wife.

5.206.s:
śakro'pi gautamaṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ ..
nirjagāmāśramāttasmādvivastro'pi bhayākulaḥ ..12..
5.206.d:
शक्रोऽपि गौतमं दृष्ट्वा पलायनपरायणः ..
निर्जगामाश्रमात्तस्माद्विवस्त्रोऽपि भयाकुलः ..12..
5.206.m: Śakra too, seeing Gautama, intent upon flight, / ran out from that hermitage, naked and frantic with fear.

5.206.s:
ahilyāpi bhayatrastā dṛṣṭvā bhartāramāgatam..
adhomukhī sthitā rājaṃstadā vyākuliteṃdriyā..13..
5.206.d:
अहिल्यापि भयत्रस्ता दृष्ट्वा भर्तारमागतम्..
अधोमुखी स्थिता राजंस्तदा व्याकुलितेंद्रिया..13..
5.206.m: Ahilyā also, terrified with fear upon seeing her husband arrived, / stood with her face cast down, O king, her senses perturbed.

5.206.s:
gautamo'pi ca taddṛṣṭvā samyagbhāryāviceṣṭitam ..
dadau śāpaṃ mahārāja kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ .. 14 ..
5.206.d:
गौतमोऽपि च तद्दृष्ट्वा सम्यग्भार्याविचेष्टितम् ..
ददौ शापं महाराज कोपसंरक्तलोचनः .. 14 ..
5.206.m: Seeing that conduct of his wife clearly, Gautama / pronounced a curse, O great king, his eyes reddened with rage:

5.206.s:
yasmācchakra pāpakarma kṛtamīdṛgvigarhitam ..
bhāryā me dūṣitā sādhvī tasmādavṛṣaṇo bhava ..15..
5.206.d:
यस्माच्छक्र पापकर्म कृतमीदृग्विगर्हितम् ..
भार्या मे दूषिता साध्वी तस्मादवृषणो भव ..15..
5.206.m: "Because, O Śakra, you have committed such a contemptible sinful deed, / and my virtuous wife has been violated, therefore become testicle-less!

5.206.s:
sahasraṃ ca bhagānāṃ te vaktre bhavatu mā ciram ..
yena tvaṃ viplavaṃ yāsi trailokye sacarācare ..16..
5.206.d:
सहस्रं च भगानां ते वक्त्रे भवतु मा चिरम् ..
येन त्वं विप्लवं यासि त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ..16..
5.206.m: And let a thousand vulvas appear upon your face without delay, / whereby you may suffer disgrace across the three worlds, both moving and unmoving!

5.206.s:
aparaṃ martyaloke'tra yadyāgacchasi vāsava ..
pūjākṛte tato mūrdhā śatadhā te bhaviṣyati .. 17 ..
5.206.d:
अपरं मर्त्यलोकेऽत्र यद्यागच्छसि वासव ..
पूजाकृते ततो मूर्धा शतधा ते भविष्यति .. 17 ..
5.206.m: Moreover, if you ever come here to the mortal world, O Vāsava, / for the sake of worship, then your head will shatter into a hundred pieces!"

5.206.s:
evaṃ śaptvā ca taṃ śakraṃ tato'hilyāmuvāca saḥ ..
kopasaṃraktanetrastu bhartsayitvā muhurmuhuḥ .. 18 ..
5.206.d:
एवं शप्त्वा च तं शक्रं ततोऽहिल्यामुवाच सः ..
कोपसंरक्तनेत्रस्तु भर्त्सयित्वा मुहुर्मुहुः .. 18 ..
5.206.m: Having thus cursed Śakra, he then spoke to Ahilyā, / reviling her repeatedly with eyes reddened with rage:

5.206.s:
yasmātpāpe tvayā karma kṛtametadvigarhitam..
tasmācchilāmayī bhūtvā tvaṃ tiṣṭha vasudhātale .. 19 ..
5.206.d:
यस्मात्पापे त्वया कर्म कृतमेतद्विगर्हितम्..
तस्माच्छिलामयी भूत्वा त्वं तिष्ठ वसुधातले .. 19 ..
5.206.m: "Because you, O sinful woman, have committed this contemptible act, / therefore turn into stone and remain upon the surface of the earth!"

5.206.s:
tataḥ sā tatkṣaṇājjātā tasya bhāryā śilātmikā ..
indro'pi ca parityakto vṛṣaṇābhyāṃ tathā'bhavat .. 6.207.20 ..
5.206.d:
ततः सा तत्क्षणाज्जाता तस्य भार्या शिलात्मिका ..
इन्द्रोऽपि च परित्यक्तो वृषणाभ्यां तथाऽभवत् .. 6.207.20 ..
5.206.m: Then in that very instant his wife became turned to stone, / and Indra, likewise, was stripped of both testicles.

5.206.s: sahasrabhagacihnastu vaktradeśe babhūva ha .. 21 ..
5.206.d: सहस्रभगचिह्नस्तु वक्त्रदेशे बभूव ह .. 21 ..
5.206.m: Indeed, he came to be marked with a thousand vulvas on the region of his face.

5.206.s:
atha meroḥ samāsādya kaṃdaraṃ vijanaṃ hariḥ ..
savrīḍaḥ sevate nityaṃ na jagāma nijāṃ purīm .. 22 ..
5.206.d:
अथ मेरोः समासाद्य कंदरं विजनं हरिः ..
सव्रीडः सेवते नित्यं न जगाम निजां पुरीम् .. 22 ..
5.206.m: Then Hari, having reached a solitary cave of Mount Meru, / dwelt there continually filled with shame, and did not go to his own city.

5.206.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve sodvegāstena varjitāḥ ..
no jānaṃti ca tatrasthaṃ kandarānveṣaṇe ratāḥ o. 23 ..
5.206.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे सोद्वेगास्तेन वर्जिताः ..
नो जानंति च तत्रस्थं कन्दरान्वेषणे रताः ओ. 23 ..
5.206.m: Then all the hosts of gods, distressed at being abandoned by him / and not knowing where he stayed, engaged in searching the caves.

5.206.s: pīḍyaṃte dānavai raudraiḥ svarge jāte virājake .. 24 ..
5.206.d: पीड्यंते दानवै रौद्रैः स्वर्गे जाते विराजके .. 24 ..
5.206.m: They were oppressed by fierce Dānavas when heaven was left without a king.

5.206.s:
etasminnantare jīvaḥ śakrāṇyā bhayabhītayā ..
sodvegayā paripṛṣṭaḥ kva gato'tha puraṃdaraḥ .. 25 ..
5.206.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे जीवः शक्राण्या भयभीतया ..
सोद्वेगया परिपृष्टः क्व गतोऽथ पुरंदरः .. 25 ..
5.206.m: Meanwhile, Jīva was asked by Śakrāṇī, who was frightened with fear / and agitated: "Where then has Purandara gone?"

5.206.s:
atha jīvaściraṃ dhyātvā dṛṣṭvā taṃ jñānacakṣuṣā ..
jagāma sahito devaiḥ provācātha suniṣṭhuram .. 26 ..
5.206.d:
अथ जीवश्चिरं ध्यात्वा दृष्ट्वा तं ज्ञानचक्षुषा ..
जगाम सहितो देवैः प्रोवाचाथ सुनिष्ठुरम् .. 26 ..
5.206.m: Then Jīva, having meditated for a long time and seeing him with the eye of knowledge, / went accompanied by the gods, and then spoke very harshly:

5.206.s:
kimitthaṃ rājyabhogāṃstvaṃ tyaktvā vijanamāśritaḥ ..
kiṃ tvayā vihitaṃ dhyānaṃ kiṃ raudraṃ saṃśritaṃ tapaḥ .. 27 ..
5.206.d:
किमित्थं राज्यभोगांस्त्वं त्यक्त्वा विजनमाश्रितः ..
किं त्वया विहितं ध्यानं किं रौद्रं संश्रितं तपः .. 27 ..
5.206.m: "Why have you thus abandoned the enjoyments of kingship and resorted to a solitary place? / Have you undertaken meditation, or have you resorted to fierce austerity?"

5.206.s:
bṛhaspatervacaḥ śrutvā bhagavaktraḥ puraṃdaraḥ ..
provāca lajjayā yukto dīno bāṣpapariplutaḥ .. 28 ..
5.206.d:
बृहस्पतेर्वचः श्रुत्वा भगवक्त्रः पुरंदरः ..
प्रोवाच लज्जया युक्तो दीनो बाष्पपरिप्लुतः .. 28 ..
5.206.m: Hearing the words of Bṛhaspati, Purandara, with vulvas on his face, / spoke filled with shame, wretched and overwhelmed with tears:

5.206.s:
nāhaṃ rājyaṃ kariṣyāmi trailokye'pi kathaṃcana ..
paśya me yādṛśī jātā hyavasthā gautamānmuneḥ .. 29 ..
sahasrabhagacihnena kathaṃ vaktreṇa tānaham ..
devānsaṃbhāvayiṣyāmi paulomīṃ ca tathā śivam..6.207.3...
5.206.d:
नाहं राज्यं करिष्यामि त्रैलोक्येऽपि कथंचन ..
पश्य मे यादृशी जाता ह्यवस्था गौतमान्मुनेः .. 29 ..
सहस्रभगचिह्नेन कथं वक्त्रेण तानहम् ..
देवान्संभावयिष्यामि पौलोमीं च तथा शिवम्..6.207.3...
5.206.m:
"I will by no means rule over the three worlds. / Look at the state I have been reduced to by the sage Gautama!
With a face marked with a thousand vulvas, how shall I / face the gods, Paulomī, and likewise Śiva?

5.206.s:
martyalokodbhavā pūjā naṣṭā mama bṛhaspate ..
gautamasya muneḥ śāpātkasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare .. 31 ..
5.206.d:
मर्त्यलोकोद्भवा पूजा नष्टा मम बृहस्पते ..
गौतमस्य मुनेः शापात्कस्मिंश्चित्कारणांतरे .. 31 ..
5.206.m: My worship arising from the mortal world has been ruined, O Bṛhaspati, / on account of a certain incident, through the curse of the sage Gautama."

5.206.s:
tacchrutvā devarājasya bṛhaspatiruvācaha ..
duḥkhena mahatā yuktaḥ sarvairdevaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ..
gautamasya samīpe ca gatvā provāca taṃ svayam .. 32 ..
5.206.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा देवराजस्य बृहस्पतिरुवाचह ..
दुःखेन महता युक्तः सर्वैर्देवैः समावृतः ..
गौतमस्य समीपे च गत्वा प्रोवाच तं स्वयम् .. 32 ..
5.206.m: Hearing that from the king of the gods, Bṛhaspati spoke; / filled with great sorrow and surrounded by all the gods, / he went into the presence of Gautama and spoke to him in person:

5.206.s:
etacchakraparityaktaṃ trailokyamapi cākhilam ..
pīḍyate dānavairvipra naṣṭayajñotsavakriyam .. 33 ..
5.206.d:
एतच्छक्रपरित्यक्तं त्रैलोक्यमपि चाखिलम् ..
पीड्यते दानवैर्विप्र नष्टयज्ञोत्सवक्रियम् .. 33 ..
5.206.m: "This entire threefold world, abandoned by Śakra, / is oppressed by the Dānavas, O brahmin, its sacrifices and festive rites destroyed.

5.206.s:
naiṣa vāṃchati rājyaṃ svaṃ lajjayā parayā yutaḥ ..
tasmādasya prasādaṃ tvaṃ yathāvatkartumarhasi ..
anugraheṇa śāpasya mama vākyāddvijottama .. 34 ..
5.206.d:
नैष वांछति राज्यं स्वं लज्जया परया युतः ..
तस्मादस्य प्रसादं त्वं यथावत्कर्तुमर्हसि ..
अनुग्रहेण शापस्य मम वाक्याद्द्विजोत्तम .. 34 ..
5.206.m: Filled with utter shame, he does not desire his own kingship. / Therefore, you ought to show him favor as is fitting, / by mitigating the curse at my request, O best of the twice-born!"

5.206.s:
tacchrutvā gautamaḥ prāha na me vākyaṃ bhavenmṛṣā ..
na vākyaṃ lopayiṣyāmi yaduktaṃ svayameva hi .. .. 35 ..
5.206.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा गौतमः प्राह न मे वाक्यं भवेन्मृषा ..
न वाक्यं लोपयिष्यामि यदुक्तं स्वयमेव हि .. .. 35 ..
5.206.m: Hearing that, Gautama said: "My word cannot be false; / I will not annul the word that I myself have uttered."

5.206.s:
tataḥ provāca te viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ cāpi maheśvaraḥ ..
tathā devagaṇāḥ sarve vinayāvanatā sthitāḥ .. 36 ..
5.206.d:
ततः प्रोवाच ते विष्णुः स्वयं चापि महेश्वरः ..
तथा देवगणाः सर्वे विनयावनता स्थिताः .. 36 ..
5.206.m: Then Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara himself, / and all the hosts of gods standing bowed in humility, spoke to you:

5.206.s:
anyathā brahmaṇo vākyaṃ na te kartuṃ prayujyate ..
tasmātkuruṣva viprendra śāpasyānugrahaṃ hareḥ .. 37 ..
5.206.d:
अन्यथा ब्रह्मणो वाक्यं न ते कर्तुं प्रयुज्यते ..
तस्मात्कुरुष्व विप्रेन्द्र शापस्यानुग्रहं हरेः .. 37 ..
5.206.m: "It is not proper for you to render the word of a brahmin otherwise; / nevertheless, O chief of brahmins, grant mitigation of the curse for Hari."

5.206.s:
dṛṣṭvā tanmanaso dārḍhyaṃ surā viṣṇupurogamāḥ ..
brahmaṇoṃ'tikamabhyetya tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayan .. 38 ..
5.206.d:
दृष्ट्वा तन्मनसो दार्ढ्यं सुरा विष्णुपुरोगमाः ..
ब्रह्मणोंऽतिकमभ्येत्य तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयन् .. 38 ..
5.206.m: Seeing the firmness of his mind, the gods headed by Viṣṇu / approached the presence of Brahmā and reported everything to him:

5.206.s: śāpaṃ śakrasya saṃjātaṃ tathā tasmānmahāmuneḥ .. 39 ..
5.206.d: शापं शक्रस्य संजातं तथा तस्मान्महामुनेः .. 39 ..
5.206.m: the curse that had befallen Śakra from that great sage;

5.206.s:
yathā viḍaṃbanā jātā devarājasya garhitā ..
tathā ca dānavaiḥ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ vyākulīkṛtam .. 6.207.40 ..
5.206.d:
यथा विडंबना जाता देवराजस्य गर्हिता ..
तथा च दानवैः सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं व्याकुलीकृतम् .. 6.207.40 ..
5.206.m: how a shameful humiliation had befallen the king of the gods; / and how the entire three worlds had been thrown into distress by the Dānavas;

5.206.s:
yathā na kurute rājyaṃ vrīḍitaḥ sa śacīpatiḥ ..
tacchrutvā padmajastūrṇaṃ hariśaṃbhusamanvitaḥ .. 41 ..
5.206.d:
यथा न कुरुते राज्यं व्रीडितः स शचीपतिः ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा पद्मजस्तूर्णं हरिशंभुसमन्वितः .. 41 ..
5.206.m: and how the ashamed lord of Śacī would not rule. / Hearing that, the lotus-born [Brahmā] quickly, accompanied by Hari and Śambhu,

5.206.s:
jagāma tatra yatrāste duḥkhitaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ..
gautamaṃ ca samānīya tatraiva ca pitāmahaḥ .. 42 ..
5.206.d:
जगाम तत्र यत्रास्ते दुःखितः पाकशासनः ..
गौतमं च समानीय तत्रैव च पितामहः .. 42 ..
5.206.m: went to where the sorrowful Pākaśāsana was staying; / and bringing Gautama to that very spot, the Grandfather

5.206.s:
tataḥ provāca pratyakṣaṃ devānāṃ vāsavasya ca ..
ayuktaṃ devarājena vihitaṃ munisattama ..43..
5.206.d:
ततः प्रोवाच प्रत्यक्षं देवानां वासवस्य च ..
अयुक्तं देवराजेन विहितं मुनिसत्तम ..43..
5.206.m: then spoke visibly before the gods and Vāsava: / "An improper deed was done by the king of the gods, O best of sages,

5.206.s:
yatte pradūṣitā bhāryā kāmopahatacetasā ..
na te doṣo'sti yacchaptaśchidre cāsminpuraṃdaraḥ ..
paraṃ praśasyate nityaṃ munīnāṃ paramā kṣamā .. 44 ..
5.206.d:
यत्ते प्रदूषिता भार्या कामोपहतचेतसा ..
न ते दोषोऽस्ति यच्छप्तश्छिद्रे चास्मिन्पुरंदरः ..
परं प्रशस्यते नित्यं मुनीनां परमा क्षमा .. 44 ..
5.206.m: in that your wife was violated by him whose mind was afflicted by lust. / There is no fault in you for having cursed Purandara in this transgression, / yet supreme forbearance among sages is always praised.

5.206.s:
yathā trailokyarājyaṃ svaṃ prakaroti śatakratuḥ ..
tvayā svayaṃ prasādena tathā nītirvidhīyatām ..45..
5.206.d:
यथा त्रैलोक्यराज्यं स्वं प्रकरोति शतक्रतुः ..
त्वया स्वयं प्रसादेन तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् ..45..
5.206.m: A policy should be arranged by your own grace in such a way / that Śatakratu may govern his kingdom of the three worlds.

5.206.s:
dattvā'sya vṛṣaṇau bhūyo nāśa yitvā bhagānimān..
martyaloke gatiścāsya yathā syāttatsamācara..46..
5.206.d:
दत्त्वाऽस्य वृषणौ भूयो नाश यित्वा भगानिमान्..
मर्त्यलोके गतिश्चास्य यथा स्यात्तत्समाचर..46..
5.206.m: Having restored his two testicles and removed these vulvas, / act so that he may again have entry into the mortal world!"

5.206.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ sa munirdevagauravāt ..
vṛṣaṇau meṣasaṃbhūtau yojayāmāsa tau tadā ..47..
5.206.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां स मुनिर्देवगौरवात् ..
वृषणौ मेषसंभूतौ योजयामास तौ तदा ..47..
5.206.m: Hearing their words, that sage, out of respect for the gods, / then attached two testicles taken from a ram.

5.206.s:
tānbhagānpāṇinā spṛṣṭvā cakre netrāṇi sanmuniḥ..
tataḥ provāca tāndevāngautamaśca mahātapāḥ..48..
5.206.d:
तान्भगान्पाणिना स्पृष्ट्वा चक्रे नेत्राणि सन्मुनिः..
ततः प्रोवाच तान्देवान्गौतमश्च महातपाः..48..
5.206.m: Touching those vulvas with his hand, the noble sage turned them into eyes. / Then Gautama, of great austerity, spoke to the gods:

5.206.s:
sahasrākṣo mayā śakro nirmitoyaṃ surottamāḥ ..
sa meṣavṛṣaṇaścāpi svaṃ ca rājyaṃ kariṣyati ..
śobhā'sya netrajā vaktre suramyā saṃbhaviṣyati ..49..
5.206.d:
सहस्राक्षो मया शक्रो निर्मितोयं सुरोत्तमाः ..
स मेषवृषणश्चापि स्वं च राज्यं करिष्यति ..
शोभाऽस्य नेत्रजा वक्त्रे सुरम्या संभविष्यति ..49..
5.206.m: "I have made this Śakra thousand-eyed, O best of gods. / Having the testicles of a ram, he shall also rule his own kingdom; / a charming beauty born of eyes will appear on his face.

5.206.s:
puṃstvaṃ ca meṣajotthābhyāṃ vṛṣaṇābhyāṃ bhaviṣyati ..
na ca martye gatiścāsya pūjārthaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati .. 6.207.50 ..
5.206.d:
पुंस्त्वं च मेषजोत्थाभ्यां वृषणाभ्यां भविष्यति ..
न च मर्त्ये गतिश्चास्य पूजार्थं संभविष्यति .. 6.207.50 ..
5.206.m: And his virility will come from the two testicles born of a ram; / but he shall have no entry into the mortal world for the sake of worship."

5.206.s:
etasminnantare jātaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ puraṃdaraḥ..
śobhayā parayā yukto munestasya prabhāva taḥ ..51..
5.206.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे जातः सहस्राक्षः पुरंदरः..
शोभया परया युक्तो मुनेस्तस्य प्रभाव तः ..51..
5.206.m: In that moment, Purandara became thousand-eyed, / endowed with supreme splendor through the power of that sage.

5.206.s:
tataḥ saṃgṛhya pādau ca gautamasya mahātmanaḥ..
provāca vacanaṃ śakraḥ sarvadevasamāgame .. 52 ..
5.206.d:
ततः संगृह्य पादौ च गौतमस्य महात्मनः..
प्रोवाच वचनं शक्रः सर्वदेवसमागमे .. 52 ..
5.206.m: Then, clasping the two feet of the great-souled Gautama, / Śakra spoke these words in the assembly of all the gods: 52

5.206.s:
durlabhā martyalokotthā pūjā brāhmaṇasattama ..
sā me tava prasādena yathā syāttatsamācara .. 53 ..
5.206.d:
दुर्लभा मर्त्यलोकोत्था पूजा ब्राह्मणसत्तम ..
सा मे तव प्रसादेन यथा स्यात्तत्समाचर .. 53 ..
5.206.m: “Worship originating in the world of mortals is hard to attain, best of brahmins; / act so that it may be mine through your grace! 53

5.206.s:
trailokyapatijā saṃjñā mā nāśaṃ yātu me dvija ..
prasādāttava sā nityaṃ yathā syāttadvidhīyatām .. 54 ..
5.206.d:
त्रैलोक्यपतिजा संज्ञा मा नाशं यातु मे द्विज ..
प्रसादात्तव सा नित्यं यथा स्यात्तद्विधीयताम् .. 54 ..
5.206.m: Let not my title of ‘Lord of the Three Worlds’ perish, O twice-born one! / Ordain that, through your grace, it may be everlasting.” 54

5.206.s:
tacchrutvā lajjayāviṣṭaḥ kṛpayā cātha sanmuniḥ..
tamūce sarvadevānāṃ pratyakṣaṃ pākaśāsanam .. 55 ..
5.206.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा लज्जयाविष्टः कृपया चाथ सन्मुनिः..
तमूचे सर्वदेवानां प्रत्यक्षं पाकशासनम् .. 55 ..
5.206.m: Hearing that, filled with shame and also with compassion, the good sage / spoke to that chastiser of Pāka before the eyes of all the gods: 55

5.206.s:
paṃcarātraṃ ca te pūjā martyaloke bhaviṣya ti ..
ananyāṃ tṛptimabhyeṣi yathā caiva tu vatsaram .. 56 ..
5.206.d:
पंचरात्रं च ते पूजा मर्त्यलोके भविष्य ति ..
अनन्यां तृप्तिमभ्येषि यथा चैव तु वत्सरम् .. 56 ..
5.206.m: “Your worship shall take place in the mortal world for five nights, / and you will attain an incomparable satisfaction that will last throughout the year. 56

5.206.s:
yatra deśe pure grāme paṃcarātraṃ mahotsavaḥ ..
tatra saṃvatsaraṃ yāvannīrogo bhavitā janaḥ ..57..
5.206.d:
यत्र देशे पुरे ग्रामे पंचरात्रं महोत्सवः ..
तत्र संवत्सरं यावन्नीरोगो भविता जनः ..57..
5.206.m: In whatever region, city, or village this great festival of five nights is held, / there the people shall remain free from disease for a whole year. 57

5.206.s:
ādhayo vyādhayo naiva na durbhikṣaṃ kathaṃcana ..
na ca rājño vināśaḥ syānnaiva loke'sukhaṃ kvacit .. 58 ..
5.206.d:
आधयो व्याधयो नैव न दुर्भिक्षं कथंचन ..
न च राज्ञो विनाशः स्यान्नैव लोकेऽसुखं क्वचित् .. 58 ..
5.206.m: There shall be no mental agonies nor bodily illnesses, and never any famine; / nor will the king perish, nor will there be unhappiness anywhere in the world. 58

5.206.s:
yatra sthāne maho bhāvī tāvakaśca puraṃdara ..
prabhūtapayaso gāvaḥ prabhaviṣyaṃti tatra ca ..
subhikṣaṃ sukhino lokāḥ sarvopadravavarjitāḥ .. 59 ..
5.206.d:
यत्र स्थाने महो भावी तावकश्च पुरंदर ..
प्रभूतपयसो गावः प्रभविष्यंति तत्र च ..
सुभिक्षं सुखिनो लोकाः सर्वोपद्रववर्जिताः .. 59 ..
5.206.m: In whatever place your festival is held, O Puraṃdara, / cows will produce abundant milk there; / there will be abundance of food, and the people will be happy and freed from all afflictions.” 59

5.206.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ śaradi prāpte sarva sattvamanohare ..
saptacchadasamākīrṇe bandhūkasuvirājite .. 6.207.60 ..
5.206.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
यद्येवं शरदि प्राप्ते सर्व सत्त्वमनोहरे ..
सप्तच्छदसमाकीर्णे बन्धूकसुविराजिते .. 6.207.60 ..
5.206.m: Indra said: / “If so, then when autumn has arrived, captivating all living beings, / strewn with Saptacchada trees, adorned with Bandhūka flowers, 60

5.206.s:
mālatīgandhasaṃkīrṇe navasasyasamākule ..
caṃdrajyotsnākṛtoddyote ṣaṭpadārāva saṃkule .. 61 ..
5.206.d:
मालतीगन्धसंकीर्णे नवसस्यसमाकुले ..
चंद्रज्योत्स्नाकृतोद्द्योते षट्पदाराव संकुले .. 61 ..
5.206.m: filled with the fragrance of Mālati, teeming with new crops, / illuminated by the moon's radiance, resonant with the humming of bees, 61

5.206.s:
kumudotpalasaṃyukte tatra syātsumahotsavaḥ ..
yena bālo'pi vṛddho'pi saṃhṛṣṭastatsamācara .. 62 ..
5.206.d:
कुमुदोत्पलसंयुक्ते तत्र स्यात्सुमहोत्सवः ..
येन बालोऽपि वृद्धोऽपि संहृष्टस्तत्समाचर .. 62 ..
5.206.m: abounding in white and blue water-lilies—let the great festival be celebrated there, / so that both the young and the old may rejoice: bring that about!” 62

5.206.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
adya śravaṇanakṣatre tava datto mahotsavaḥ ..
vaiṣṇave puṇyanakṣatre sarvapāpavivarjite .. 63 ..
5.206.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
अद्य श्रवणनक्षत्रे तव दत्तो महोत्सवः ..
वैष्णवे पुण्यनक्षत्रे सर्वपापविवर्जिते .. 63 ..
5.206.m: Gautama said: / “Today, under the constellation of Śravaṇa, a great festival has been granted to you, / under the auspicious constellation sacred to Viṣṇu, free of all sin. 63

5.206.s:
tvayā me dharṣitā bhāryā pauṣṇe nakṣatrasaṃjñite ..
tasminbhaviṣyati vyaktaṃ tava pātaḥ puraṃdara .. 64 ..
5.206.d:
त्वया मे धर्षिता भार्या पौष्णे नक्षत्रसंज्ञिते ..
तस्मिन्भविष्यति व्यक्तं तव पातः पुरंदर .. 64 ..
5.206.m: My wife was violated by you under the constellation named Pauṣṇa; / under that [same constellation], your fall will clearly take place, O Puraṃdara, 64

5.206.s:
yenaiṣā māmakī kīrtistāvakaṃ vaktu karma tat ..
vikhyātiṃ yātu loke'tra na kaścitpāpamācaret .. 65 ..
5.206.d:
येनैषा मामकी कीर्तिस्तावकं वक्तु कर्म तत् ..
विख्यातिं यातु लोकेऽत्र न कश्चित्पापमाचरेत् .. 65 ..
5.206.m: so that this fame of mine may proclaim that deed of yours / and attain renown in this world, and no one may commit a sin. 65

5.206.s:
śravaṇādīni paṃcaiva nakṣatrāṇi pṛthakpṛthak ..
tava pūjākṛte paṃca kratutulyāni tāni ca ..
bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃdehaḥ sarvatīrthamayāni ca .. 66 ..
5.206.d:
श्रवणादीनि पंचैव नक्षत्राणि पृथक्पृथक् ..
तव पूजाकृते पंच क्रतुतुल्यानि तानि च ..
भविष्यंति न संदेहः सर्वतीर्थमयानि च .. 66 ..
5.206.m: The five constellations beginning with Śravaṇa, taken individually, / will, for the sake of your worship, be equal to five sacrifices, / and will undoubtedly comprise all sacred fords. 66

5.206.s:
yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya pūjāṃ tava kariṣyati ..
viśeṣātphalapuṣpaiśca sa taṃ kṛtsnamavāpnuyāt .. 67 ..
5.206.d:
यो यं काममभिध्याय पूजां तव करिष्यति ..
विशेषात्फलपुष्पैश्च स तं कृत्स्नमवाप्नुयात् .. 67 ..
5.206.m: Whatever desire one contemplates when performing your worship, / especially with fruits and flowers, he shall obtain it entirely. 67

5.206.s:
paraṃ mūrtirna te pūjyā kutrāpi ca bhaviṣyati ..
tvayā me dūṣitā bhāryā brāhmaṇī prāṇasaṃmatā .. 68 ..
5.206.d:
परं मूर्तिर्न ते पूज्या कुत्रापि च भविष्यति ..
त्वया मे दूषिता भार्या ब्राह्मणी प्राणसंमता .. 68 ..
5.206.m: However, no idol of yours will ever be worshipped anywhere, / because my wife, a brahmin woman dear to me as life, was defiled by you. 68

5.206.s:
tasmādvṛkṣodbhavāṃ yaṣṭiṃ brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ ..
tāvakaiḥ sakalairmaṃtraiḥ sthāpayiṣyaṃti śaktitaḥ .. 69 ..
5.206.d:
तस्माद्वृक्षोद्भवां यष्टिं ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः ..
तावकैः सकलैर्मंत्रैः स्थापयिष्यंति शक्तितः .. 69 ..
5.206.m: Therefore, brahmins who have mastered the Vedas / shall erect a wooden staff with all your mantras according to their ability, 69

5.206.s:
paṃcarātravidhānena yathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām ..
tataḥ saṃkramaṇaṃ kṛtvā pūjā martyasamudbhavā ..
tvayā grāhyā sahasrākṣa tṛptiścaiva bhaviṣyati .. 6.207.70 ..
5.206.d:
पंचरात्रविधानेन यथान्येषां दिवौकसाम् ..
ततः संक्रमणं कृत्वा पूजा मर्त्यसमुद्भवा ..
त्वया ग्राह्या सहस्राक्ष तृप्तिश्चैव भविष्यति .. 6.207.70 ..
5.206.m: in accordance with the rite of five nights, as is done for other gods; / then, having caused the invocation [into it], the worship offered by mortals / must be received by you, O thousand-eyed one, and satisfaction shall be yours. 70

5.206.s:
yo yathā caiva te yaṣṭiṃ suptāmutthāpayiṣyati ..
tasya tasyādhikā siddhiḥ saṃbhaviṣyaṃti vāsava .. 71 ..
5.206.d:
यो यथा चैव ते यष्टिं सुप्तामुत्थापयिष्यति ..
तस्य तस्याधिका सिद्धिः संभविष्यंति वासव .. 71 ..
5.206.m: In whatever manner one raises your sleeping staff, / to that degree higher accomplishment will arise for him, O Vāsava. 71

5.206.s:
paṃcarātravratarato yo brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ ..
prakariṣyati te pūjāṃ phalapuṣpairyathoditaiḥ .. 72 ..
5.206.d:
पंचरात्रव्रतरतो यो ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः ..
प्रकरिष्यति ते पूजां फलपुष्पैर्यथोदितैः .. 72 ..
5.206.m: He who, devoted to the five-night vow and dedicated to celibacy, / performs your worship with fruits and flowers as prescribed, 72

5.206.s: paradārakṛtātpāpātsa sarvānmuktimeṣyati .. 73 ..
5.206.d: परदारकृतात्पापात्स सर्वान्मुक्तिमेष्यति .. 73 ..
5.206.m: shall obtain release from all sins committed with another's wife. 73

5.206.s:
namaḥ śakrāya devāya śunāsīrāya te namaḥ ..
namaste vajrahastāya namaste vajrapāṇaye .. 74 ..
5.206.d:
नमः शक्राय देवाय शुनासीराय ते नमः ..
नमस्ते वज्रहस्ताय नमस्ते वज्रपाणये .. 74 ..
5.206.m: ‘Homage to Śakra, the god; homage to you, Śunāsīra; / homage to you whose hand bears the vajra; homage to you who hold the vajra in your fist.’ 74

5.206.s:
mantreṇānena yaścārghyaṃ tava śakra pradāsyati ..
paradārakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tasya sarvaṃ prayāsyati .. .. 785 ..
yaścedaṃ tava saṃvādaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ puraṃdara ..
kīrtayiṣyati sadbhaktyā tathaivākarṇayiṣyati .. 76 ..
tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvannaiva rogo bhaviṣyati ..
tacchrutvā vibudhāḥ sarve tathetyuktvā praharṣitāḥ .. 77 ..
jagmuḥ śakraṃ samādāya punarevāmarāvatīm ..
gautamo'pi nijā vāsaṃ gataḥ kopasamāśritaḥ .. 78 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya indramahotsavavarṇanaṃnāma saptottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 207 ..
5.206.d:
मन्त्रेणानेन यश्चार्घ्यं तव शक्र प्रदास्यति ..
परदारकृतं पापं तस्य सर्वं प्रयास्यति .. .. 785 ..
यश्चेदं तव संवादं मया सार्धं पुरंदर ..
कीर्तयिष्यति सद्भक्त्या तथैवाकर्णयिष्यति .. 76 ..
तस्य संवत्सरं यावन्नैव रोगो भविष्यति ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा विबुधाः सर्वे तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रहर्षिताः .. 77 ..
जग्मुः शक्रं समादाय पुनरेवामरावतीम् ..
गौतमोऽपि निजा वासं गतः कोपसमाश्रितः .. 78 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य इन्द्रमहोत्सववर्णनंनाम सप्तोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 207 ..
5.206.m:
Whoever offers an oblation to you, O Śakra, with this mantra, / all his sin committed with another's wife will be destroyed. 75
And whoever recounts this dialogue of yours with me, O Puraṃdara, / with true devotion, and likewise listens to it, 76
no disease shall afflict him for a whole year.” / Hearing that, all the gods rejoiced, saying, “So be it!” 77
Taking Śakra with them, they returned once more to Amarāvatī. / Gautama, too, filled with anger, went to his own abode. 78
Thus ends the two hundred and seventh chapter, entitled “Description of Indra’s Great Festival,” in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 207

5.207.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
evaṃ śakre divaṃ prāpte deveṣu sakaleṣu ca ..
gautamaḥ svāśramaṃ prāpatkopena mahatā jvalan .. 1 ..
5.207.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
एवं शक्रे दिवं प्राप्ते देवेषु सकलेषु च ..
गौतमः स्वाश्रमं प्रापत्कोपेन महता ज्वलन् .. 1 ..
5.207.m: Viśvāmitra said: / When Śakra and all the gods had thus reached heaven, / Gautama reached his own hermitage, blazing with intense wrath. 1

5.207.s:
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ devaviceṣṭitam ..
varadānaṃ ca śakrāya śatānandasya cāgrataḥ .. 2 ..
5.207.d:
ततः स कथयामास सर्वं देवविचेष्टितम् ..
वरदानं च शक्राय शतानन्दस्य चाग्रतः .. 2 ..
5.207.m: Then he narrated all the doings of the gods / and the granting of the boon to Śakra in the presence of Śatānanda. 2

5.207.s:
tacchrutvā pitaraṃ prāha vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ ..
tātāṃbāyā na kasmāttvaṃ prasādaṃ prakaroṣi me .. 3 ..
5.207.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा पितरं प्राह विनयावनतः स्थितः ..
तातांबाया न कस्मात्त्वं प्रसादं प्रकरोषि मे .. 3 ..
5.207.m: Hearing that, [Śatānanda] stood bowed with humility and said to his father: / “Father, why do you not show grace to mother for my sake? 3

5.207.s:
utthāpane na te kiñcidasādhyaṃ vidyate vibho ..
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yathā syānmama cāṃbayā .. 4 ..
5.207.d:
उत्थापने न ते किञ्चिदसाध्यं विद्यते विभो ..
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे यथा स्यान्मम चांबया .. 4 ..
5.207.m: In restoring her, nothing is impossible for you, O lord; / therefore, show grace to me so that my mother may be [restored], 4

5.207.s:
samāgamo muniśreṣṭha dīnasyotkaṇṭhitasya ca ..
tasmādutthāpya tāṃ tūrṇaṃ prāyaścittavidhiṃ tataḥ ..
tasmādādiśa me kṣipraṃ yena śuddhiḥ prajāyate .. 5 ..
5.207.d:
समागमो मुनिश्रेष्ठ दीनस्योत्कण्ठितस्य च ..
तस्मादुत्थाप्य तां तूर्णं प्रायश्चित्तविधिं ततः ..
तस्मादादिश मे क्षिप्रं येन शुद्धिः प्रजायते .. 5 ..
5.207.m: so that there may be a reunion with my mother for me, wretched and yearning, O best of sages. / Therefore, quickly restoring her, then ordain for her / a rite of expiation swiftly, by which purification is accomplished.” 5

5.207.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
madyāvaliptabhāṃḍasya yadi śuddhiḥ prajāyate ..
tatstrīṇāṃ jāyateśuddhiryonau śukrābhiṣecanāt .. 6 ..
5.207.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
मद्यावलिप्तभांडस्य यदि शुद्धिः प्रजायते ..
तत्स्त्रीणां जायतेशुद्धिर्योनौ शुक्राभिषेचनात् .. 6 ..
5.207.m: Gautama said: / “If purification can occur for a pot smeared with liquor, / then purification can occur for women when semen is sprinkled into the vagina! 6

5.207.s:
brāhmaṇastu surāṃ pītvā mauṃjīhomena śudhyati ..
tiṃginīṃ sādhayitvā ca na tu nārī vidharmitā .. 7 ..
5.207.d:
ब्राह्मणस्तु सुरां पीत्वा मौंजीहोमेन शुध्यति ..
तिंगिनीं साधयित्वा च न तु नारी विधर्मिता .. 7 ..
5.207.m: A brahmin having drunk liquor is purified by a fire sacrifice with muñja grass / and by accomplishing the tiṅginī rite; but not a defiled woman. 7

5.207.s:
madyabhāṃḍamapi prāyo yathāvadvahniśodhitam..
viśudhyati tathā nārī vahnidagdhā viśudhyati ..
yasyā reto'tha saṃkrāṃta mudarāṃte'nyasaṃbhavam.. 8 ..
5.207.d:
मद्यभांडमपि प्रायो यथावद्वह्निशोधितम्..
विशुध्यति तथा नारी वह्निदग्धा विशुध्यति ..
यस्या रेतोऽथ संक्रांत मुदरांतेऽन्यसंभवम्.. 8 ..
5.207.m: Just as even a liquor-pot generally becomes purified / when cleansed properly by fire, so a woman whose womb has received / another's semen can be purified only when burned by fire. 8

5.207.s:
etasmātkāraṇānmātā mayā te putra sā śilā ..
vihitā na hi tasyāśca viśuddhistu kathañcana .. 9 ..
5.207.d:
एतस्मात्कारणान्माता मया ते पुत्र सा शिला ..
विहिता न हि तस्याश्च विशुद्धिस्तु कथञ्चन .. 9 ..
5.207.m: For this reason, O son, your mother was turned into a stone by me; / for there is no purification for her by any means whatsoever.” 9

5.207.s:
.. śatānanda uvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ sādhayiṣyāmi tatkṛte'haṃ hutāśanam..
viṣaṃ vā bhakṣayiṣyāmi patiṣyāmi jalāśaye .. 6.208.10 ..
5.207.d:
.. शतानन्द उवाच .. ..
यद्येवं साधयिष्यामि तत्कृतेऽहं हुताशनम्..
विषं वा भक्षयिष्यामि पतिष्यामि जलाशये .. 6.208.10 ..
5.207.m: Śatānanda said: / “If it is so, I will enter fire for her sake, / or I will consume poison, or throw myself into a reservoir of water. 10

5.207.s:
māturviyogatastāta satyametanmayoditam ..
dharmadroṇāḥ sthitāścānye manvādyā munayastathā .. 11 ..
5.207.d:
मातुर्वियोगतस्तात सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..
धर्मद्रोणाः स्थिताश्चान्ये मन्वाद्या मुनयस्तथा .. 11 ..
5.207.m: This which I have spoken, father, is the truth, on account of separation from my mother. / Other receptacles of dharma exist, such as Manu and other sages, 11

5.207.s:
itihāsapurāṇāni vedāṃtāni bahūni ca ..
saṃciṃtya tāta sarvāṇi dehi śuddhiṃ mamāpi tām..
mama mātuḥ kariṣyāmi no cetprāṇaparikṣayam .. 12 ..
5.207.d:
इतिहासपुराणानि वेदांतानि बहूनि च ..
संचिंत्य तात सर्वाणि देहि शुद्धिं ममापि ताम्..
मम मातुः करिष्यामि नो चेत्प्राणपरिक्षयम् .. 12 ..
5.207.m: and many Itihāsas, Purāṇas, and Vedāntas. / Reflecting on all of them, father, grant that purification to my mother, / or else I will bring about the destruction of my life!” 12

5.207.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca ..
tacchrutvā suciraṃ dhyātvā gautamaḥ prāha taṃ sutam..
pariṣvajya svabāhubhyāṃ mūrdhnyāghrāya tataḥ param ..13..
5.207.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा सुचिरं ध्यात्वा गौतमः प्राह तं सुतम्..
परिष्वज्य स्वबाहुभ्यां मूर्ध्न्याघ्राय ततः परम् ..13..
5.207.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Hearing that and contemplating for a very long time, Gautama embraced that son / with both his arms, smelled him on the crown of his head, and then spoke to him: // 13

5.207.s:
yadyevaṃ vatsa mā kārṣīḥ sāhasaṃ pāpasaṃbhavam..
ātmadehavighātena śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama .. .. 14 ..
5.207.d:
यद्येवं वत्स मा कार्षीः साहसं पापसंभवम्..
आत्मदेहविघातेन श्रूयतां वचनं मम .. .. 14 ..
5.207.m: "If that is so, my child, do not commit a rash act born of sin / by destroying your own body. Listen to my words! // 14

5.207.s:
medhyatve tava mātuśca śuddhirjñātā mayā purā ..
yayā sā mama harmyārhā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 15 ..
5.207.d:
मेध्यत्वे तव मातुश्च शुद्धिर्ज्ञाता मया पुरा ..
यया सा मम हर्म्यार्हा भविष्यति न संशयः .. 15 ..
5.207.m: The purification for the purity of your mother was known to me long ago, / by which she will become worthy of my house again, without a doubt. // 15

5.207.s:
utpatsyate ravervaṃśe rāmarūpī janā rdanaḥ..
rāvaṇasya vadhārthāya mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ..
tasya pādasya saṃsparśādbhūyaḥ śuddhā bhaviṣyati.
tasmātpratīkṣya tāvattvamautsukyaṃ vraja putraka..
etatsamyaṅmayā jñātaṃ vatsa divyena cakṣuṣā..18..
5.207.d:
उत्पत्स्यते रवेर्वंशे रामरूपी जना र्दनः..
रावणस्य वधार्थाय मानुषं रूपमास्थितः..
तस्य पादस्य संस्पर्शाद्भूयः शुद्धा भविष्यति.
तस्मात्प्रतीक्ष्य तावत्त्वमौत्सुक्यं व्रज पुत्रक..
एतत्सम्यङ्मया ज्ञातं वत्स दिव्येन चक्षुषा..18..
5.207.m: Janārdana in the form of Rāma will be born in the Solar dynasty, / assuming a human form for the sake of slaying Rāvaṇa. / By the touch of his foot she will become pure again. / Therefore, wait until then, my son, and be patient! / This has been rightly known by me, my child, through the divine eye." // 18

5.207.s:
etacchrutvā tathetyuktvā śatānandaḥ praharṣitaḥ..
sthitaḥ pratīkṣamāṇastu taṃ kālaṃ mātṛvatsalaḥ .. 19 ..
5.207.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तथेत्युक्त्वा शतानन्दः प्रहर्षितः..
स्थितः प्रतीक्षमाणस्तु तं कालं मातृवत्सलः .. 19 ..
5.207.m: Having heard this and saying "So be it," Śatānanda rejoiced; / loving his mother, he waited expecting that time. // 19

5.207.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā rāmarūpī janārdanaḥ ..
rāvaṇasya vadhārthāya jāto daśarathālaye .. 6.208.20 ..
5.207.d:
ततः कालेन महता रामरूपी जनार्दनः ..
रावणस्य वधार्थाय जातो दशरथालये .. 6.208.20 ..
5.207.m: Then, after a great lapse of time, Janārdana in the form of Rāma / was born in the house of Daśaratha to slay Rāvaṇa. // 20

5.207.s:
sa mayā bhagavā viṣṇurbālabhāvena saṃsthitaḥ ..
nijayajñasyarakṣārthaṃ samānītaḥ svamāśramam ..
rākṣasānāṃ vināśāya yajñakarmavināśinām .. 21 ..
5.207.d:
स मया भगवा विष्णुर्बालभावेन संस्थितः ..
निजयज्ञस्यरक्षार्थं समानीतः स्वमाश्रमम् ..
राक्षसानां विनाशाय यज्ञकर्मविनाशिनाम् .. 21 ..
5.207.m: That Lord Viṣṇu, abiding in the state of a child, / was brought by me to my own hermitage to protect my sacrifice, / for the destruction of the demons who destroy sacrificial rites. // 21

5.207.s:
hataistai rākṣasai raudrairmama pūrṇo'bhavanmakhaḥ ..
ayodhyāyāḥ samānītaḥ sa mayā raghunaṃdanaḥ .. 22 ..
5.207.d:
हतैस्तै राक्षसै रौद्रैर्मम पूर्णोऽभवन्मखः ..
अयोध्यायाः समानीतः स मया रघुनंदनः .. 22 ..
5.207.m: When those terrible demons were slain, my sacrifice was completed. / That delight of the Raghu lineage was brought by me from Ayodhyā // 22

5.207.s:
sītāyāśca vivāhārthaṃ lakṣmaṇena samanvitaḥ ..
śrutvā svayaṃvaraṃ tasyāḥ pārthivānāṃ samāgamam .. 23 ..
5.207.d:
सीतायाश्च विवाहार्थं लक्ष्मणेन समन्वितः ..
श्रुत्वा स्वयंवरं तस्याः पार्थिवानां समागमम् .. 23 ..
5.207.m: accompanied by Lakṣmaṇa, for the sake of marriage with Sītā, / upon hearing of her svayaṃvara and the gathering of kings. // 23

5.207.s:
tato mārge mayā dṛṣṭā gautamasyāśrame śubhe ..
ahilyā sā śilā rūpā pramāṇena mahattamā .. 24 ..
5.207.d:
ततो मार्गे मया दृष्टा गौतमस्याश्रमे शुभे ..
अहिल्या सा शिला रूपा प्रमाणेन महत्तमा .. 24 ..
5.207.m: Then along the way, in the auspicious hermitage of Gautama, I saw / that Ahilyā in the form of a rock, immensely large in size. // 24

5.207.s:
tataḥ prokto mayā rāmaḥ spṛśemāṃ vatsa pāṇinā ..
mānuṣatvaṃ labhedyena gautamasya priyā muneḥ ..
śāpadoṣeṇa saṃjātā śileyaṃ tasya sanmuneḥ .. 25 ..
5.207.d:
ततः प्रोक्तो मया रामः स्पृशेमां वत्स पाणिना ..
मानुषत्वं लभेद्येन गौतमस्य प्रिया मुनेः ..
शापदोषेण संजाता शिलेयं तस्य सन्मुनेः .. 25 ..
5.207.m: Then Rāma was told by me: "Touch this [rock] with your hand, my child, / so that the beloved wife of the sage Gautama may regain her human form. / Through the fault of the curse of that noble sage, she became this rock." // 25

5.207.s:
avikalpaṃ tato rāmo mama vākyena tāṃ śilām ..
pasparśa pārthivaśreṣṭha kautū halasamanvitaḥ .. 26 ..
5.207.d:
अविकल्पं ततो रामो मम वाक्येन तां शिलाम् ..
पस्पर्श पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ कौतू हलसमन्वितः .. 26 ..
5.207.m: Then, without hesitation, upon my word, / Rāma touched that rock, full of curiosity, O best of kings. // 26

5.207.s:
atha rāmeṇa saṃspṛṣṭā sahasaivāṃganā muneḥ ..
śuśubhe mānuṣī jātā divyarūpavapurdharā .. 27 ..
5.207.d:
अथ रामेण संस्पृष्टा सहसैवांगना मुनेः ..
शुशुभे मानुषी जाता दिव्यरूपवपुर्धरा .. 27 ..
5.207.m: Touched by Rāma, the wife of the sage suddenly / became human and shone, bearing a body of celestial form. // 27

5.207.s:
tataḥ sā lajjayā''viṣṭā praṇipatya ca gautamam ..
smaramāṇā''tmanaḥ kṛtyaṃ yacchakreṇa samanvitam .. 28 ..
5.207.d:
ततः सा लज्जया'ऽविष्टा प्रणिपत्य च गौतमम् ..
स्मरमाणा'ऽत्मनः कृत्यं यच्छक्रेण समन्वितम् .. 28 ..
5.207.m: Then, seized with shame, she bowed down to Gautama, / remembering her own act which was done with Śakra: // 28

5.207.s:
prāyaścittaṃ mama svāmindehi sarvamaśeṣataḥ ..
yannarasya samāyoge parasyāha prajāpatiḥ .. 29 ..
5.207.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं मम स्वामिन्देहि सर्वमशेषतः ..
यन्नरस्य समायोगे परस्याह प्रजापतिः .. 29 ..
5.207.m: "O master, prescribe for me fully the entire expiation / which Prajāpati declared for union with another man! // 29

5.207.s:
ahaṃ duṣkaramapyetatkariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ..
yena śuddhirbhavenmahyaṃ puraścaraṇasevanāt .. 6.208.30 ..
5.207.d:
अहं दुष्करमप्येतत्करिष्यामि न संशयः ..
येन शुद्धिर्भवेन्मह्यं पुरश्चरणसेवनात् .. 6.208.30 ..
5.207.m: Even if this is difficult to perform, I will do it, without a doubt, / so that through the practice of preparatory observances, purification may be mine." // 30

5.207.s:
tataḥ saṃciṃtya suciraṃ provāca gautamastadā ..
kuru cāndrāyaṇaśataṃ kṛcchrāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam .. 31 ..
5.207.d:
ततः संचिंत्य सुचिरं प्रोवाच गौतमस्तदा ..
कुरु चान्द्रायणशतं कृच्छ्राणां च सहस्रकम् .. 31 ..
5.207.m: Then, reflecting for a long time, Gautama said at that time: / "Perform a hundred cāndrāyaṇa penances and a thousand kṛcchra penances, // 31

5.207.s:
prājāpatyāyutaṃ cāpi tīrthayātrāparāyaṇā ..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu yāni tīrthāni bhūtale ..
teṣāṃ saṃdarśanātsamyaktataḥ śuddhimavāpsyasi .. 32 ..
5.207.d:
प्राजापत्यायुतं चापि तीर्थयात्रापरायणा ..
अष्टषष्टिषु तीर्थेषु यानि तीर्थानि भूतले ..
तेषां संदर्शनात्सम्यक्ततः शुद्धिमवाप्स्यसि .. 32 ..
5.207.m: and ten thousand prājāpatya penances, devoted to pilgrimage to sacred fords. / From duly visiting all those sacred fords that exist on the earth / among the sixty-eight sacred fords, you will attain purification." // 32

5.207.s:
sā tathaiti pratijñāya nityaṃ vrataparāyaṇā ..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭisu tīrtheṣu vārāṇasyādiṣu kramāt.. 33 ..
5.207.d:
सा तथैति प्रतिज्ञाय नित्यं व्रतपरायणा ..
अष्टषष्टिसु तीर्थेषु वाराणस्यादिषु क्रमात्.. 33 ..
5.207.m: Agreeing, "So be it," and constantly devoted to vows, / she visited the sixty-eight sacred fords, Vārāṇasī and others in succession. // 33

5.207.s:
babhrāma tāni liṃgāni pūjayantī prabhaktitaḥ ..
krameṇaiva tu saṃprāptā hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhavam .. 34 ..
5.207.d:
बभ्राम तानि लिंगानि पूजयन्ती प्रभक्तितः ..
क्रमेणैव तु संप्राप्ता हाटकेश्वरसंभवम् .. 34 ..
5.207.m: She wandered, worshiping those liṅgas with great devotion. / In due course she arrived at the place belonging to Hāṭakeśvara. // 34

5.207.s:
yāvatpaśyati sā sādhvī tāvannāgabilo mahān ..
pūrito nāgareṇaiva mārgaḥ pātālasaṃbhavaḥ .. 35 ..
5.207.d:
यावत्पश्यति सा साध्वी तावन्नागबिलो महान् ..
पूरितो नागरेणैव मार्गः पातालसंभवः .. 35 ..
5.207.m: As the virtuous woman looked, [she saw that] the great Serpent-Chasm— / the path leading to Pātāla—had been filled up by the Nāgara people, // 35

5.207.s:
gacchaṃti yena pūrvaṃ tu tīrthayātrāparāyaṇāḥ ..
hāṭakeśvaradevasya darśanārthaṃ munīśvarāḥ .. 36 ..
5.207.d:
गच्छंति येन पूर्वं तु तीर्थयात्रापरायणाः ..
हाटकेश्वरदेवस्य दर्शनार्थं मुनीश्वराः .. 36 ..
5.207.m: by which the foremost sages devoted to pilgrimages / formerly used to go to have darśana of the god Hāṭakeśvara. // 36

5.207.s:
atha sā cintayāmāsa na dṛṣṭe tu sureśvare ..
hāṭakeśvaradeve ca na hi yātrāphalaṃ labhet .. 37 ..
5.207.d:
अथ सा चिन्तयामास न दृष्टे तु सुरेश्वरे ..
हाटकेश्वरदेवे च न हि यात्राफलं लभेत् .. 37 ..
5.207.m: Then she thought: "If the lord of gods, the god Hāṭakeśvara, / is not seen, one cannot obtain the fruit of pilgrimage. // 37

5.207.s:
tasmāttapaḥ kari ṣyāmi sthitvā caiva suduṣkaram ..
yenāhaṃ tatprabhāvena taṃ paśyāmi sureśvaram .. 38 ..
5.207.d:
तस्मात्तपः करि ष्यामि स्थित्वा चैव सुदुष्करम् ..
येनाहं तत्प्रभावेन तं पश्यामि सुरेश्वरम् .. 38 ..
5.207.m: Therefore, staying right here, I shall perform very difficult austerity / so that through its power I may see that lord of gods." // 38

5.207.s:
evaṃ sā niścayaṃ kṛtvā tapastepe suduṣkaram ..
darśanārthaṃ hi devasya pātālanilayasya ca .. 39 ..
5.207.d:
एवं सा निश्चयं कृत्वा तपस्तेपे सुदुष्करम् ..
दर्शनार्थं हि देवस्य पातालनिलयस्य च .. 39 ..
5.207.m: Having thus made her resolve, she practiced very difficult austerity / for the sake of obtaining darśana of the god residing in Pātāla. // 39

5.207.s:
paṃcāgnisādhakā grīṣme hemante salilāśrayā ..
varṣāsvākāśaśayanā sā babhūva tapasvinī .. 6.208.40 ..
haraliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya svanāmnā cāṃtike tadā ..
trikālaṃ pūjayāmāsa gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ .. 41 ..
5.207.d:
पंचाग्निसाधका ग्रीष्मे हेमन्ते सलिलाश्रया ..
वर्षास्वाकाशशयना सा बभूव तपस्विनी .. 6.208.40 ..
हरलिंगं प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्वनाम्ना चांतिके तदा ..
त्रिकालं पूजयामास गन्धपुष्पानुलेपनैः .. 41 ..
5.207.m: Practicing the five-fire austerity in summer, staying in water in winter, / and sleeping under the open sky in the rainy season, she became an ascetic woman. / Then, having installed a liṅga of Hara nearby in her own name, / she worshiped it at the three times of the day with perfumes, flowers, and unguents. // 41

5.207.s:
evaṃ tapasi saṃsthāyāstasyāḥ kālo mahāngataḥ ..
na ca saṃdarśanaṃ jātaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhavam.. 42 ..
5.207.d:
एवं तपसि संस्थायास्तस्याः कालो महान्गतः ..
न च संदर्शनं जातं हाटकेश्वरसंभवम्.. 42 ..
5.207.m: While she remained thus in austerity, a great period of time elapsed, / yet darśana of Hāṭakeśvara did not take place. // 42

5.207.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya śatānandaśca tatsutaḥ ..
sa tāmanveṣamāṇastu tasminkṣetre samāgataḥ ..
mātṛsneha parītātmā tīrthānveṣaṇatatparaḥ .. 43 ..
5.207.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य शतानन्दश्च तत्सुतः ..
स तामन्वेषमाणस्तु तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे समागतः ..
मातृस्नेह परीतात्मा तीर्थान्वेषणतत्परः .. 43 ..
5.207.m: After some time, her son Śatānanda, / searching for her, arrived in that sacred field, / his mind filled with love for his mother, intent on searching the sacred fords. // 43

5.207.s:
atha tāṃ tatra saṃvīkṣya dāruṇe tapasi sthitām ..
praṇipatya sthito dīnaḥ saduḥkho vākyamabravīt .. 44 ..
5.207.d:
अथ तां तत्र संवीक्ष्य दारुणे तपसि स्थिताम् ..
प्रणिपत्य स्थितो दीनः सदुःखो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 44 ..
5.207.m: Then, seeing her there engaged in severe austerity, / he bowed down and stood miserable and sorrowful, and spoke these words: // 44

5.207.s:
kimatra kliśyate kāyastapaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam..
saptaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu yāni liṃgāni teṣu ca .. 45 ..
5.207.d:
किमत्र क्लिश्यते कायस्तपः कृत्वा सुदारुणम्..
सप्तषष्टिषु तीर्थेषु यानि लिंगानि तेषु च .. 45 ..
5.207.m: "Why is your body tormented here by performing such severe austerity? / Among the sixty-seven sacred fords, those liṅgas that exist there, // 45

5.207.s:
māheśvarāṇi liṃgāni tāni dṛṣṭāni ca tvayā ..
etatpātālasaṃsthaṃ ca hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam.. 46 ..
5.207.d:
माहेश्वराणि लिंगानि तानि दृष्टानि च त्वया ..
एतत्पातालसंस्थं च हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम्.. 46 ..
5.207.m: those liṅgas of Maheśvara have been seen by you. / And as for this [liṅga] named Hāṭakeśvara situated in Pātāla, // 46

5.207.s:
na paśyati naraḥ kaściddṛṣṭaṃ kṣetre na kenacit ..
tena śuddhiśca saṃjātā svabhartrā vihitā tu yā ..47 ..
5.207.d:
न पश्यति नरः कश्चिद्दृष्टं क्षेत्रे न केनचित् ..
तेन शुद्धिश्च संजाता स्वभर्त्रा विहिता तु या ..47 ..
5.207.m: no man sees it, nor has it been seen by anyone in this sacred field. / By that [worship already performed], purification has arisen, which was prescribed by your husband. // 47

5.207.s:
tasmādāgaccha gacchāmastātāśrāmapade śubhe ..
tvanmārgaṃ vīkṣate tātaḥ karṣuko varṣaṇaṃ yathā .. 48 .
5.207.d:
तस्मादागच्छ गच्छामस्ताताश्रामपदे शुभे ..
त्वन्मार्गं वीक्षते तातः कर्षुको वर्षणं यथा .. 48 .
5.207.m: Therefore, come, let us go to my father's auspicious hermitage! / My father watches for your return just as a farmer watches for rain." // 48

5.207.s:
.. āhilyovāca .. ..
yāvatpaśyāmi no devaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ..
tāvadgacchāmi no gehaṃ yadā paśyāmi taṃ haram .. 49 ..
5.207.d:
.. आहिल्योवाच .. ..
यावत्पश्यामि नो देवं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम् ..
तावद्गच्छामि नो गेहं यदा पश्यामि तं हरम् .. 49 ..
5.207.m: Ahilyā said: / "As long as I do not see the god named Hāṭakeśvara, / so long will I not go home. When I see that Hara, // 49

5.207.s: tadā yāsye gṛhaṃ putra niścayo'yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ .. 6.208.50 ..
5.207.d: तदा यास्ये गृहं पुत्र निश्चयोऽयं मया कृतः .. 6.208.50 ..
5.207.m: then I will go home, my son; this is the resolve made by me." // 50

5.207.s:
tacchrutvā so'pi tāṃ prāha hyeṣa cenniścayastava ..
mayā'pi tātapārśve tu pragaṃtavyaṃ tvayā -pa .. 51 ..
5.207.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा सोऽपि तां प्राह ह्येष चेन्निश्चयस्तव ..
मयाऽपि तातपार्श्वे तु प्रगंतव्यं त्वया -प .. 51 ..
5.207.m: Hearing that, he too said to her: "Indeed, if this is your resolve, / then I too will not go to my father's side without you." // 51

5.207.s:
evamuktvā tataḥ sopi sthāpayāmāsa śāṃbha vam ..
liṃgaṃ ca pūjayāmāsa trikālaṃ tapasi sthitaḥ .. 52 ..
5.207.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततः सोपि स्थापयामास शांभ वम् ..
लिंगं च पूजयामास त्रिकालं तपसि स्थितः .. 52 ..
5.207.m: Having spoken thus, he too installed a liṅga / of Śambhu and, established in austerity, worshiped it at the three times of the day. // 52

5.207.s:
śatānandastu rājarṣiḥ gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ..
naivedyairvividhaiḥ sūktairvedoktaiḥ paryatoṣayat .. 53 ..
5.207.d:
शतानन्दस्तु राजर्षिः गन्धपुष्पानुलेपनैः ..
नैवेद्यैर्विविधैः सूक्तैर्वेदोक्तैः पर्यतोषयत् .. 53 ..
5.207.m: Śatānanda, the royal seer, propitiated it with perfumes, flowers, and unguents, / with diverse food offerings, and with Vedic hymns. // 53

5.207.s:
ṣaṣṭhānnakālabhojyasya vratacaryāratasya ca ..
evaṃ tasyā'pi saṃsthasya gataḥ kālo mahānmune ..
na ca tuṣyati deveśa stābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ kathañcana .. 54 ..
5.207.d:
षष्ठान्नकालभोज्यस्य व्रतचर्यारतस्य च ..
एवं तस्याऽपि संस्थस्य गतः कालो महान्मुने ..
न च तुष्यति देवेश स्ताभ्यां द्वाभ्यां कथञ्चन .. 54 ..
5.207.m: Eating only at the sixth mealtime and dedicated to the observance of vows, / as he also remained thus, O sage, a great period of time elapsed, / yet the lord of gods was by no means pleased with the two of them. // 54

5.207.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā gautamo'pi mahāmuniḥ ..
ājagāma svayaṃ tatra putradarśanalālasaḥ .. 55 ..
5.207.d:
ततः कालेन महता गौतमोऽपि महामुनिः ..
आजगाम स्वयं तत्र पुत्रदर्शनलालसः .. 55 ..
5.207.m: Then, after a great period of time, the great sage Gautama himself / arrived there, longing to see his son. // 55

5.207.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ putraṃ tapasi saṃsthitam ..
tutoṣa prathamaṃ tāvatpaścāduḥkhasamanvitaḥ .. 56 ..
5.207.d:
स दृष्ट्वा भार्यया सार्धं पुत्रं तपसि संस्थितम् ..
तुतोष प्रथमं तावत्पश्चादुःखसमन्वितः .. 56 ..
5.207.m: Seeing his son engaged in austerity together with his wife, / he first rejoiced, but afterwards was filled with sorrow:

5.207.s:
aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ putro me kṛśatāṃ gataḥ ..
tapasaḥ saṃprabhāvena nayāmi svagṛhaṃ katham ..
bhāryeyaṃ ca tathā mahyaṃ vivarṇā tu kṛśā sthitā .. 57 ..
5.207.d:
अहो बत महत्कष्टं पुत्रो मे कृशतां गतः ..
तपसः संप्रभावेन नयामि स्वगृहं कथम् ..
भार्येयं च तथा मह्यं विवर्णा तु कृशा स्थिता .. 57 ..
5.207.m: “Alas, what great hardship! My son has become emaciated / by the force of austerity; how can I take him home? / And this wife of mine also remains emaciated and pale.”

5.207.s:
evaṃ saṃciṃtya manasā tāvubhau pratyabhāṣata ..
gamyatāṃ svagṛhaṃ kṛtvā tapasaḥ saṃnivartanam .. 58 ..
5.207.d:
एवं संचिंत्य मनसा तावुभौ प्रत्यभाषत ..
गम्यतां स्वगृहं कृत्वा तपसः संनिवर्तनम् .. 58 ..
5.207.m: Having reflected thus in his mind, he spoke to them both: / “Go home, having put an end to your austerity.”

5.207.s:
.. śatānanda uvāca .. ..
tātāṃbā bahudhā proktā tapasaḥ saṃnivartane ..
no gacchati tathā harmyamadṛṣṭe hāṭakeśvare .. 59 ..
5.207.d:
.. शतानन्द उवाच .. ..
तातांबा बहुधा प्रोक्ता तपसः संनिवर्तने ..
नो गच्छति तथा हर्म्यमदृष्टे हाटकेश्वरे .. 59 ..
5.207.m: Śatānanda said: / “Father, mother has been told many times to cease her austerity; / yet she will not go home without having seen Hāṭakeśvara.

5.207.s:
ahaṃ tayā vihīnastu naiva yāsyāmi niścitam ..
evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāga yadyuktaṃ tatsamācara .. 6.208.60 ..
5.207.d:
अहं तया विहीनस्तु नैव यास्यामि निश्चितम् ..
एवं ज्ञात्वा महाभाग यद्युक्तं तत्समाचर .. 6.208.60 ..
5.207.m: And bereft of her, I certainly will not go. / Knowing this, O fortunate one, do whatever is fitting.”

5.207.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ niścayo vatsa tava mātuśca saṃsthitaḥ ..
ahaṃ te darśayiṣyāmi tapasā hāṭakeśvaram .. 61 ..
5.207.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
यद्येवं निश्चयो वत्स तव मातुश्च संस्थितः ..
अहं ते दर्शयिष्यामि तपसा हाटकेश्वरम् .. 61 ..
5.207.m: Gautama said: / “If such is the resolve of you and your mother, my child, / I shall reveal Hāṭakeśvara to you through austerity.”

5.207.s:
evamuktvā tataḥ so'pi tapaścakre mahāmuniḥ ..
ekāṃtaropavāsastu sthito varṣaśataṃ muniḥ..
ṣaṣṭhānnakālabhojī ca tāvatkāle tato'bhavat..62..
5.207.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततः सोऽपि तपश्चक्रे महामुनिः ..
एकांतरोपवासस्तु स्थितो वर्षशतं मुनिः..
षष्ठान्नकालभोजी च तावत्काले ततोऽभवत्..62..
5.207.m: Having spoken thus, that great sage also performed austerity: / fasting on alternate days, the sage remained for a hundred years; / and he ate only at the sixth mealtime for an equal duration then.

5.207.s:
trirātrabhojī paścācca sa babhūva munīśvaraḥ.
tāvatkālaṃ phalairninye tāvatkālaṃ jalāśanaḥ..
vāyubhakṣastato bhūyastāvatkālamabhūnmuniḥ..63..
5.207.d:
त्रिरात्रभोजी पश्चाच्च स बभूव मुनीश्वरः.
तावत्कालं फलैर्निन्ये तावत्कालं जलाशनः..
वायुभक्षस्ततो भूयस्तावत्कालमभून्मुनिः..63..
5.207.m: After that, the lord of sages ate only every three nights; / an equal amount of time he passed on fruits, and an equal time subsisting on water; / then, subsisting on wind, the sage remained for an equal amount of time.

5.207.s:
tato varṣasahasrāṃte parame saṃvyavasthite..
prabhidya medinīpṛṣṭhaṃ niṣkrāṃtaṃ liṃgamuttamam .. 64
5.207.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते परमे संव्यवस्थिते..
प्रभिद्य मेदिनीपृष्ठं निष्क्रांतं लिंगमुत्तमम् .. 64
5.207.m: Then, at the end of a thousand years, as he stood in supreme [absorption], / an excellent liṅga emerged, cleaving the surface of the earth,

5.207.s:
dvādaśārkapratīkāśaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitama ..
etasminnaṃtare devaḥ śaṃbhuḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ .. 65 ..
5.207.d:
द्वादशार्कप्रतीकाशं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवः शंभुः प्रत्यक्षतां गतः .. 65 ..
5.207.m: resembling twelve suns and endowed with all auspicious marks. / At that moment, the divine Śambhu became visible.

5.207.s:
etasminneva kāle tu bhagavāñchaśiśekharaḥ ..
tasya dṛṣṭipathaṃ gatvā vākyametaduvāca ha .. 66 ..
5.207.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भगवाञ्छशिशेखरः ..
तस्य दृष्टिपथं गत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 66 ..
5.207.m: At that very time, the blessed Lord with the crescent moon on his crest, / entering his range of sight, spoke these words:

5.207.s: gautamā'haṃ pratuṣṭaste tapasā'nena suvrata .. 67 ..
5.207.d: गौतमाऽहं प्रतुष्टस्ते तपसाऽनेन सुव्रत .. 67 ..
5.207.m: “Gautama, I am well pleased with this austerity of yours, O you of noble vows.

5.207.s:
etacca māmakaṃ liṃgaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ..
pātālācca viniṣkrāṃtaṃ tava bhaktyā mahāmune ..68..
5.207.d:
एतच्च मामकं लिंगं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम् ..
पातालाच्च विनिष्क्रांतं तव भक्त्या महामुने ..68..
5.207.m: And this liṅga of mine, named Hāṭakeśvara, / has emerged from Pātāla by your devotion, O great sage.

5.207.s:
etadarthaṃ tapastaptaṃ sabhāryeṇa tvayā hi tat ..
saputreṇākhilaṃ jātaṃ phalaṃ tasya yathepsitam .. 69 ..
5.207.d:
एतदर्थं तपस्तप्तं सभार्येण त्वया हि तत् ..
सपुत्रेणाखिलं जातं फलं तस्य यथेप्सितम् .. 69 ..
5.207.m: For this purpose that austerity was performed by you with your wife / and with your son; the entire fruit of it has come to pass according to your desire.

5.207.s:
etatpaśyatu te bhāryā ahilyā divyarūpiṇī ..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭyudbhavaṃ yena yātrāphalamavāpnuyāt .. 6.208.70 ..
5.207.d:
एतत्पश्यतु ते भार्या अहिल्या दिव्यरूपिणी ..
अष्टषष्ट्युद्भवं येन यात्राफलमवाप्नुयात् .. 6.208.70 ..
5.207.m: Let your wife Ahilyā, possessing divine form, behold this, / so that she may obtain the fruit of pilgrimage arising from the sixty-eight [tīrthas].

5.207.s: tvaṃ cāpi prārthaya varaṃ yena sarvaṃ dadāmi te .. 71 ..
5.207.d: त्वं चापि प्रार्थय वरं येन सर्वं ददामि ते .. 71 ..
5.207.m: And you too ask for a boon, whereby I may grant you everything.”

5.207.s:
.. gautama uvāca ..
hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñe tu sakṛddṛṣṭe ca yatphalam ..
pātālasthe ca yatpuṇyaṃ narāṇāṃ jāyate phalam ..
dṛṣṭenānena tatpuṇyaṃ pūjitena viśeṣataḥ .. 72 ..
5.207.d:
.. गौतम उवाच ..
हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञे तु सकृद्दृष्टे च यत्फलम् ..
पातालस्थे च यत्पुण्यं नराणां जायते फलम् ..
दृष्टेनानेन तत्पुण्यं पूजितेन विशेषतः .. 72 ..
5.207.m: Gautama said: / “Whatever fruit comes from seeing the one named Hāṭakeśvara once, / and whatever merit and fruit arises for men when he is situated in Pātāla, / may that merit come by seeing this one, and especially by worshiping him.

5.207.s:
anye'pi ye janāstacca pūjayaṃti prabhaktitaḥ ..
caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ te prayāṃtu triviṣṭapam .. 73 ..
5.207.d:
अन्येऽपि ये जनास्तच्च पूजयंति प्रभक्तितः ..
चैत्रशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां ते प्रयांतु त्रिविष्टपम् .. 73 ..
5.207.m: Moreover, whatever people worship it with great devotion / on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, may they go to heaven.

5.207.s:
etalliṃgaṃ na jānaṃti narāḥ siddhyabhikāṃkṣiṇaḥ ..
viśaṃti vivaraṃ tena hāṭakeśvarakāṃkṣayā .. 74 ..
5.207.d:
एतल्लिंगं न जानंति नराः सिद्ध्यभिकांक्षिणः ..
विशंति विवरं तेन हाटकेश्वरकांक्षया .. 74 ..
5.207.m: Men desiring spiritual accomplishment do not know this liṅga; / out of a longing for Hāṭakeśvara, they enter the subterranean cavity.

5.207.s:
api pāpasamopetā liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ..
paradārodbhavā tpāpādahilyeśvaradarśanāt .. 79 ..
mucyaṃte mānavāstadvacchatānaṃdeśvarādapi ..
tasmindine vihitayā tābhyāṃ caiva prapūjayā .. 76 ..
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
etasminneva kāle tu vyāptaḥ svargo'khilo nṛpa ..
mānuṣairapi pāpāḍhyaiḥ sarvadharmavivarjitaiḥ .. 77 ..
na kaścitkurute yajñaṃ tīrtha yātrāmathāparam ..
na vrataṃ niyamaṃ caiva dānasyāpi kathāmapi .. 78 ..
tacca liṃgatrayaṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ .. 79 ..
5.207.d:
अपि पापसमोपेता लिंगस्यास्य प्रभावतः ..
परदारोद्भवा त्पापादहिल्येश्वरदर्शनात् .. 79 ..
मुच्यंते मानवास्तद्वच्छतानंदेश्वरादपि ..
तस्मिन्दिने विहितया ताभ्यां चैव प्रपूजया .. 76 ..
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु व्याप्तः स्वर्गोऽखिलो नृप ..
मानुषैरपि पापाढ्यैः सर्वधर्मविवर्जितैः .. 77 ..
न कश्चित्कुरुते यज्ञं तीर्थ यात्रामथापरम् ..
न व्रतं नियमं चैव दानस्यापि कथामपि .. 78 ..
तच्च लिंगत्रयं दृष्ट्वा स्पृष्ट्वा संपूज्य भक्तितः .. 79 ..
5.207.m:
Even those who have accumulated sins, through the power of this liṅga, / and from the sin arising from [violating] another's wife, by the darśana of Ahilyeśvara,”
“are liberated, O humans, and likewise from Śatānandeśvara, / through the excellent worship performed for the two of them on that day.”
Viśvāmitra said: / “At that very time, O king, all of heaven was filled / even with men laden with sins and devoid of all dharma.
No one performed a sacrifice, or pilgrimage to a sacred ford, or anything else, / nor any vow or observance, nor even spoke of giving gifts,
after seeing, touching, and worshiping that triad of liṅgas with devotion.

5.207.s:
tato bhītāḥ surāḥ sarve saspardhairmānuṣairvṛtāḥ ..
procuḥ puraṃdaraṃ gatvā vyathayā prayā yutāḥ .. 6.208.80 ..
5.207.d:
ततो भीताः सुराः सर्वे सस्पर्धैर्मानुषैर्वृताः ..
प्रोचुः पुरंदरं गत्वा व्यथया प्रया युताः .. 6.208.80 ..
5.207.m: Then all the gods, frightened and surrounded by arrogant men, / went to Purandara and, filled with distress, spoke:

5.207.s:
martyaloke sahasrākṣa sarve dharmāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ..
api pāpasamācārā abhyetya puruṣā iha .. 81 ..
5.207.d:
मर्त्यलोके सहस्राक्ष सर्वे धर्माः क्षयं गताः ..
अपि पापसमाचारा अभ्येत्य पुरुषा इह .. 81 ..
5.207.m: ‘O thousand-eyed one, in the mortal world all dharmas have perished. / Even men of sinful conduct, having arrived here,

5.207.s:
asmābhiḥ saha garvāḍhyāḥ spardhāṃ kurvaṃti sarvadā ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre liṃgatrayamanuttamam .. 82 ..
5.207.d:
अस्माभिः सह गर्वाढ्याः स्पर्धां कुर्वंति सर्वदा ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे लिंगत्रयमनुत्तमम् .. 82 ..
5.207.m: swollen with pride, vie with us constantly. / In the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara there is an unsurpassed triad of liṅgas,

5.207.s:
yatsthitaṃ sthāpitaṃ tatra gautamena mahātmanā ..
saputreṇa sadāreṇa tasya pūjāprabhāvataḥ .. 83 ..
5.207.d:
यत्स्थितं स्थापितं तत्र गौतमेन महात्मना ..
सपुत्रेण सदारेण तस्य पूजाप्रभावतः .. 83 ..
5.207.m: which was situated there and established by the great-souled Gautama / along with his son and his wife; by the power of worshiping it,

5.207.s:
api pāpasamācārā ihāgacchaṃti te'khilāḥ ..
yamasya narakāḥ sarve sāṃprataṃ śūnyatāṃ gatāḥ .. 84 ..
5.207.d:
अपि पापसमाचारा इहागच्छंति तेऽखिलाः ..
यमस्य नरकाः सर्वे सांप्रतं शून्यतां गताः .. 84 ..
5.207.m: all those people, even those of sinful conduct, come here; / all the hells of Yama have now become empty.

5.207.s:
gautamena samānītaḥ pātālāddhāṭakeśvaraḥ ..
tapasā toṣayitvā tu tatra sthāne sureśvaraḥ .. 85 ..
5.207.d:
गौतमेन समानीतः पातालाद्धाटकेश्वरः ..
तपसा तोषयित्वा तु तत्र स्थाने सुरेश्वरः .. 85 ..
5.207.m: Hāṭakeśvara, the lord of the gods, was brought up from Pātāla / by Gautama, having pleased him with austerity in that place.

5.207.s: tatprabhāvādayaṃ jāto vyavahāro dharātale .. 86 ..
5.207.d: तत्प्रभावादयं जातो व्यवहारो धरातले .. 86 ..
5.207.m: By that power, this practice has arisen on the surface of the earth.

5.207.s:
evaṃ jñātvā pravartaṃte yathā yajñāstathā kuru ..
tairvinā naiva tṛptiḥ syādasmākaṃ ca kathaṃcana .. 87 ..
5.207.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा प्रवर्तंते यथा यज्ञास्तथा कुरु ..
तैर्विना नैव तृप्तिः स्यादस्माकं च कथंचन .. 87 ..
5.207.m: Knowing this, act in such a way that sacrifices proceed; / without them there can be no satisfaction for us in any way.’

5.207.s:
tacchrutvā vāsavastatra samāhūya ca manmatham ..
krodhaṃ lobhaṃ tathā daṃbhaṃ matsaraṃ dveṣasaṃyutam .. 98 ..
gatvā dharātalaṃ sarve mamādeśāddrutaṃ tataḥ ..
svaśaktyā vārayadhvaṃ bho gautameśvarapūjakān .. 89 ..
ahilyeśvaradevasya śatānaṃdeśvarasya ca ..
śakrādeśaṃ tu saṃprāpya te gatā dharaṇītale .. 6.208.90 ..
kāmādikā narānbhejurgautameśvarapūjakān ..
tathā'hilyeśvarasyāpi śatānaṃdeśvarasya ca .. 91 ..
tato bhūyo makhā jātāḥ samagre dharaṇītale ..
saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇāḥ sarve vatāni niyamāstathā .. 92 ..
tīrthayātrā japo homo yāścānyāḥ sukṛtakriyāḥ ..
etatsarvaṃ mayā khyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dharādhipa .. 93 ..
gayākūpyanuṣaṃgeṇa śakragautamaceṣṭitam ..
bālamaṇḍanamāhātmyaṃ śakreśvarasamanvitam .. 94 ..
5.207.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वासवस्तत्र समाहूय च मन्मथम् ..
क्रोधं लोभं तथा दंभं मत्सरं द्वेषसंयुतम् .. 98 ..
गत्वा धरातलं सर्वे ममादेशाद्द्रुतं ततः ..
स्वशक्त्या वारयध्वं भो गौतमेश्वरपूजकान् .. 89 ..
अहिल्येश्वरदेवस्य शतानंदेश्वरस्य च ..
शक्रादेशं तु संप्राप्य ते गता धरणीतले .. 6.208.90 ..
कामादिका नरान्भेजुर्गौतमेश्वरपूजकान् ..
तथाऽहिल्येश्वरस्यापि शतानंदेश्वरस्य च .. 91 ..
ततो भूयो मखा जाताः समग्रे धरणीतले ..
संपूर्णदक्षिणाः सर्वे वतानि नियमास्तथा .. 92 ..
तीर्थयात्रा जपो होमो याश्चान्याः सुकृतक्रियाः ..
एतत्सर्वं मया ख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि धराधिप .. 93 ..
गयाकूप्यनुषंगेण शक्रगौतमचेष्टितम् ..
बालमण्डनमाहात्म्यं शक्रेश्वरसमन्वितम् .. 94 ..
5.207.m:
Hearing that, Vāsava summoned Manmatha there, / along with Anger, Greed, Deceit, and Envy accompanied by Hatred:
‘All of you, go swiftly to the surface of the earth by my command, / and by your own power ward off those who worship Gautameśvara,
and the divine Ahilyeśvara, and Śatānandeśvara!’ / Having received Śakra’s command, they went to the surface of the earth.
Desire and the others took possession of the men who worshiped Gautameśvara, / and likewise Ahilyeśvara and Śatānandeśvara.
Then sacrifices took place once more over the entire surface of the earth, / all with complete sacrificial fees, as did vows and observances,
pilgrimages to sacred fords, recitation of mantras, fire oblations, and whatever other virtuous deeds [there are]. / All this has been related by me, since I was asked, O lord of the earth:
the deed of Śakra and Gautama in connection with Gayākūpī, / the māhātmya of Bālamaṇḍana together with Śakreśvara,

5.207.s:
indrasya sthāpanaṃ martye ahilyākhyānameva ca ..
gautameśvaramāhātmyaṃ tathāhilyeśvarasya ca .. 95 ..
yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ..
sa mucyetpātakātsadyaḥ paradārasamudbhavāt .. 96 ..
5.207.d:
इन्द्रस्य स्थापनं मर्त्ये अहिल्याख्यानमेव च ..
गौतमेश्वरमाहात्म्यं तथाहिल्येश्वरस्य च .. 95 ..
यश्चैतच्छृणुयान्नित्यं श्रद्धया परया युतः ..
स मुच्येत्पातकात्सद्यः परदारसमुद्भवात् .. 96 ..
5.207.m:
the establishment [of the liṅga] by Indra among mortals, the story of Ahilyā, / and the māhātmya of Gautameśvara and of Ahilyeśvara.
And whoever hears this constantly, endowed with supreme faith, / is immediately freed from the sin arising from [violating] another's wife.”

5.207.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye gautameśvarāhilyeśvara śatānandeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 208 ..
5.207.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गौतमेश्वराहिल्येश्वर शतानन्देश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 208 ..
5.207.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Gautameśvara, Ahilyeśvara, and Śatānandeśvara,” in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.208.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
sāṃprataṃ muniśārdūla śaṃkhatīrtha samudbhavam..
māhātmyaṃ vada me kṛtsnaṃ śraddhā me mahatī sthitā .. 1 ..
5.208.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
सांप्रतं मुनिशार्दूल शंखतीर्थ समुद्भवम्..
माहात्म्यं वद मे कृत्स्नं श्रद्धा मे महती स्थिता .. 1 ..
5.208.m: Ānarta said: / Now, tiger among sages, tell me the entire māhātmya / arising from Śaṅkhatīrtha; great faith has arisen in me.

5.208.s:
aho tīrthamaho tīrthaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam [.
kṣetraṃ yacca dharāpṛṣṭhe sarvāścaryamayaṃ śubham .. 2 ..
5.208.d:
अहो तीर्थमहो तीर्थं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम् [.
क्षेत्रं यच्च धरापृष्ठे सर्वाश्चर्यमयं शुभम् .. 2 ..
5.208.m: Ah, what a sacred ford, ah, what a sacred ford, known as Hāṭakeśvara! / And what an auspicious sacred field upon the surface of the earth, filled with all wonders!

5.208.s:
nāhaṃ tṛptiṃ dvijaśreṣṭha pragacchāmi kathaṃcana ..
śṛṇvānastu sumāhātmyaṃ kṣetrasyāsya samudbhavam .. 3 ..
5.208.d:
नाहं तृप्तिं द्विजश्रेष्ठ प्रगच्छामि कथंचन ..
शृण्वानस्तु सुमाहात्म्यं क्षेत्रस्यास्य समुद्भवम् .. 3 ..
5.208.m: I find no satiety at all, best of the twice-born, / as I listen to the exalted māhātmya that originates from this sacred field.

5.208.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
atra te kīrtayiṣyāmi pūrvavṛttaṃ kathāṃtaram ..
śaṃkhatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ yathājātaṃ dharātale .. 4 ..
5.208.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
अत्र ते कीर्तयिष्यामि पूर्ववृत्तं कथांतरम् ..
शंखतीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं यथाजातं धरातले .. 4 ..
5.208.m: Viśvāmitra said: / In this regard, I shall narrate to you another ancient account, / the māhātmya of Śaṅkhatīrtha, as it came to pass upon the surface of the earth.

5.208.s:
ānartādhipatiḥ pūrvamāsīdanyo mahīpatiḥ ..
yathā tvaṃ sāṃprataṃ bhūmau sarvalokaprapālakaḥ .. 5 ..
5.208.d:
आनर्ताधिपतिः पूर्वमासीदन्यो महीपतिः ..
यथा त्वं सांप्रतं भूमौ सर्वलोकप्रपालकः .. 5 ..
5.208.m: Formerly, there was another ruler of the earth, the king of Ānarta, / just as you are now on earth the protector of all the world.

5.208.s:
so'kasmātkuṣṭhabhāgjāto vikalāṃgo babhūva ha ..
aputraḥ śatrubhirvyāptastrastaśca nṛpasattamaḥ .. 6 ..
5.208.d:
सोऽकस्मात्कुष्ठभाग्जातो विकलांगो बभूव ह ..
अपुत्रः शत्रुभिर्व्याप्तस्त्रस्तश्च नृपसत्तमः .. 6 ..
5.208.m: Suddenly, he was afflicted with leprosy and became crippled in his limbs; / sonless, beset by enemies, and terrified was that best of kings.

5.208.s:
sa sarvairbhūmipālaiśca sarvataḥ paripīḍitaḥ ..
rājyabhraṃśasamopetaḥ prāpto raivatakaṃ girim .. 7 ..
5.208.d:
स सर्वैर्भूमिपालैश्च सर्वतः परिपीडितः ..
राज्यभ्रंशसमोपेतः प्राप्तो रैवतकं गिरिम् .. 7 ..
5.208.m: Harassed on all sides by all the rulers of the earth, / and suffering the loss of his kingdom, he arrived at Mount Raivataka.

5.208.s: tatrāpi pīḍyate nityaṃ sarvatastu malimlucaiḥ .. 8 ..
5.208.d: तत्रापि पीड्यते नित्यं सर्वतस्तु मलिम्लुचैः .. 8 ..
5.208.m: Even there he was constantly tormented on every side by thieves.

5.208.s:
hastyaśvarathahīnastu kośahīno yadā'bhavat ..
sa tadā ciṃtayāmāsa kiṃ karomi ca sāṃpratam .. 9 ..
5.208.d:
हस्त्यश्वरथहीनस्तु कोशहीनो यदाऽभवत् ..
स तदा चिंतयामास किं करोमि च सांप्रतम् .. 9 ..
5.208.m: When he was deprived of elephants, horses, and chariots, and devoid of his treasury, / he then thought: 'What shall I do now?'

5.208.s: kalatrāṇyapi sarvāṇi hriyaṃte taskarairbalāt .. .. 6.209.10 ..
5.208.d: कलत्राण्यपि सर्वाणि ह्रियंते तस्करैर्बलात् .. .. 6.209.10 ..
5.208.m: Even all his wives were forcibly carried off by robbers.

5.208.s:
sa evaṃ ciṃtayānastu gato vai nāradaṃ vibhum ..
draṣṭuṃ pārthivaśārdūla vaiṣṇave divase sthite .. 11 ..
5.208.d:
स एवं चिंतयानस्तु गतो वै नारदं विभुम् ..
द्रष्टुं पार्थिवशार्दूल वैष्णवे दिवसे स्थिते .. 11 ..
5.208.m: Reflecting thus, tiger among kings, on a sacred day of Viṣṇu, / he went to see the powerful Nārada.

5.208.s:
tatrāpaśyatsa saṃprāptaṃ nāradaṃ munisattamam ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena dāmodaradidṛkṣayā .. 12 ..
5.208.d:
तत्रापश्यत्स संप्राप्तं नारदं मुनिसत्तमम् ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन दामोदरदिदृक्षया .. 12 ..
5.208.m: There he saw Nārada, the best of sages, who had arrived / in the course of a pilgrimage to sacred fords out of a desire to see Dāmodara.

5.208.s:
taṃ praṇamyātha śirasā kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ..
provāca vacanaṃ dīna upaviśya tadagrataḥ .. 13 .. ..
5.208.d:
तं प्रणम्याथ शिरसा कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः ..
प्रोवाच वचनं दीन उपविश्य तदग्रतः .. 13 .. ..
5.208.m: Bowing to him with his head, standing with folded hands, / and sitting down before him, he spoke these wretched words:

5.208.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
śatrubhiḥ paribhūto'haṃ samatānmunisattama ..
tato rājyaparibhraṃśātsaṃprāpto'tra mahāgirau .. 14 ..
5.208.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
शत्रुभिः परिभूतोऽहं समतान्मुनिसत्तम ..
ततो राज्यपरिभ्रंशात्संप्राप्तोऽत्र महागिरौ .. 14 ..
5.208.m: The king said: / I have been overthrown on all sides by enemies, best of sages; / then, having fallen from my kingdom, I have arrived here on this great mountain.

5.208.s:
vipine taskaraiḥ pāpaiḥ prapīḍye'haṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
yatkiṃcidaśvanāgādyaṃ mayā saha samāgatam .. 15 ..
5.208.d:
विपिने तस्करैः पापैः प्रपीड्येऽहं समंततः ..
यत्किंचिदश्वनागाद्यं मया सह समागतम् .. 15 ..
5.208.m: In the forest I am tormented on all sides by wicked robbers; / whatever little—horses, elephants, and the like—had come along with me,

5.208.s:
tatsarvaṃ taskarairnītaṃ kośā dārāstathā vasu ..
tasmādvada muniśreṣṭha vairāgyaṃ me mahatsthitam .. 16 ..
5.208.d:
तत्सर्वं तस्करैर्नीतं कोशा दारास्तथा वसु ..
तस्माद्वद मुनिश्रेष्ठ वैराग्यं मे महत्स्थितम् .. 16 ..
5.208.m: all of that was carried off by robbers, along with my treasuries, wives, and wealth. / Therefore tell me, best of sages: a great world-weariness has come upon me.

5.208.s:
anyajanmodbhavaṃ kiṃcinmama pāpaṃ sudāruṇam ..
yenemāṃ ca daśāṃ prāptaḥ sahasā munisattama .. 17 ..
5.208.d:
अन्यजन्मोद्भवं किंचिन्मम पापं सुदारुणम् ..
येनेमां च दशां प्राप्तः सहसा मुनिसत्तम .. 17 ..
5.208.m: Was there some very terrible sin of mine originating from another birth, / because of which, best of sages, I have suddenly reached this state?

5.208.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā munīśvaraḥ ..
provācā'tha nṛpaṃ dīnaṃ jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā .. 18 ..
5.208.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चिरं ध्यात्वा मुनीश्वरः ..
प्रोवाचाऽथ नृपं दीनं ज्ञात्वा दिव्येन चक्षुषा .. 18 ..
5.208.m: Hearing those words of his, the lord of sages meditated for a long time; / having known [the truth] through his divine eye, he then spoke to the wretched king:

5.208.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
na tvayā kutsitaṃ kiṃcitpūrva dehāṃtare kṛtam ..
mayā jñātaṃ mahārāja sarvaṃ divyena cakṣuṣā .. 19 ..
5.208.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
न त्वया कुत्सितं किंचित्पूर्व देहांतरे कृतम् ..
मया ज्ञातं महाराज सर्वं दिव्येन चक्षुषा .. 19 ..
5.208.m: Nārada said: / Nothing vile was done by you in your previous body; / I have known everything, great king, by means of my divine eye.

5.208.s:
tvamāsīḥ pārthivaḥ pūrvaṃ siddhapannagasaṃjñite ..
pattane somavaṃśīyaḥ sarva śatrunibarhaṇaḥ .. 6.209.20 ..
5.208.d:
त्वमासीः पार्थिवः पूर्वं सिद्धपन्नगसंज्ञिते ..
पत्तने सोमवंशीयः सर्व शत्रुनिबर्हणः .. 6.209.20 ..
5.208.m: Formerly, you were a king of the Lunar Dynasty / in the city named Siddhapannaga, a slayer of all enemies.

5.208.s:
tvayā ceṣṭaṃ mahāyajñaiḥ sadā saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaiḥ ..
mahādānāni dattāni pūjitā brāhmaṇottamāḥ .. 21 ..
tena karma vipākena bhūyaḥ pārthivatāṃ gataḥ .. 22 ..
5.208.d:
त्वया चेष्टं महायज्ञैः सदा संपूर्णदक्षिणैः ..
महादानानि दत्तानि पूजिता ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः .. 21 ..
तेन कर्म विपाकेन भूयः पार्थिवतां गतः .. 22 ..
5.208.m: You performed great sacrifices with always plentiful sacrificial gifts, / bestowed great gifts, and honoured the best of brahmins; / by the ripening of that action, you attained kingship once again.

5.208.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
iha janmani no kṛtyaṃ saṃsmarāmi vibho kṛtam ..
tatkiṃ rājyapari bhraṃśaḥ sahasā me samutthitaḥ .. 23 ..
5.208.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
इह जन्मनि नो कृत्यं संस्मरामि विभो कृतम् ..
तत्किं राज्यपरि भ्रंशः सहसा मे समुत्थितः .. 23 ..
5.208.m: Ānarta said: / In this birth, O lord, I remember no misdeed committed; / then why has this sudden loss of my kingdom befallen me?

5.208.s:
lakṣmyā hīnasya lokasya loke'sminvyarthatāṃ vrajet ..
jīvitaṃ muniśārdūla vijñātaṃ hi mayā'dhunā .. 24 ..
5.208.d:
लक्ष्म्या हीनस्य लोकस्य लोकेऽस्मिन्व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् ..
जीवितं मुनिशार्दूल विज्ञातं हि मयाऽधुना .. 24 ..
5.208.m: The life of a person bereft of fortune in this world comes to naught, / tiger among sages; indeed, I have realised this now.

5.208.s:
mṛto naro gataśrīko mṛtaṃ rāṣṭramarājakam ..
mṛtamaśrotriye dānaṃ mṛto yajñastvadakṣiṇaḥ .. 25 ..
5.208.d:
मृतो नरो गतश्रीको मृतं राष्ट्रमराजकम् ..
मृतमश्रोत्रिये दानं मृतो यज्ञस्त्वदक्षिणः .. 25 ..
5.208.m: A man bereft of splendour is dead; dead is a realm without a king; / dead is a gift [given] to one who is not a Vedic scholar; dead is a sacrifice without sacrificial gifts.

5.208.s:
lakṣmyā hīnasya martyasya bāṃdhavo'pi vijāyate..
prārthayiṣyati māṃ nūnaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ cānyato vrajet .. 26 ..
5.208.d:
लक्ष्म्या हीनस्य मर्त्यस्य बांधवोऽपि विजायते..
प्रार्थयिष्यति मां नूनं दृष्ट्वा तं चान्यतो व्रजेत् .. 26 ..
5.208.m: Even a relative turns away from a mortal bereft of fortune; / thinking, 'Surely he will ask me [for something],' having seen him, he goes elsewhere.

5.208.s:
yathā māṃ sāṃprataṃ dṛṣṭvā ye mayā'pi pratarpitāḥ ..
te'pi dūrataraṃ yāṃti eṣa māṃ prārthayi ṣyati .. 27 ..
5.208.d:
यथा मां सांप्रतं दृष्ट्वा ये मयाऽपि प्रतर्पिताः ..
तेऽपि दूरतरं यांति एष मां प्रार्थयि ष्यति .. 27 ..
5.208.m: Just as now, having seen me, even those who were gratified by me / go far away, [thinking,] 'This man will beg from me.'

5.208.s:
dhanahīnaṃ naraṃ tyaktvā kulīnamapi cottamam ..
gacchati svajano'nyatra śuṣkaṃ vṛkṣamivāṃḍajāḥ .. 28 ..
5.208.d:
धनहीनं नरं त्यक्त्वा कुलीनमपि चोत्तमम् ..
गच्छति स्वजनोऽन्यत्र शुष्कं वृक्षमिवांडजाः .. 28 ..
5.208.m: Abandoning a man bereft of wealth, even if of noble birth and excellent, / one's own kin goes elsewhere, like birds [leaving] a withered tree.

5.208.s:
tatkāryakāraṇārthāya daridro' bhyeti cedgṛham ..
dhanino bhartsayaṃtyenaṃ samāgacchaṃti nāṃtikam .. 29 ..
5.208.d:
तत्कार्यकारणार्थाय दरिद्रो' भ्येति चेद्गृहम् ..
धनिनो भर्त्सयंत्येनं समागच्छंति नांतिकम् .. 29 ..
5.208.m: If a poor man comes to the house of the wealthy for some purpose or need, / they revile him; they do not come near him.

5.208.s:
kṛpaṇo'pi dhanāḍhyaścedāgacchati hi yācitum ..
eṣa dāsyati me kiṃci diti citte nṛṇāṃ bhavet .. 6.209.30 ..
5.208.d:
कृपणोऽपि धनाढ्यश्चेदागच्छति हि याचितुम् ..
एष दास्यति मे किंचि दिति चित्ते नृणां भवेत् .. 6.209.30 ..
5.208.m: Even if a miser who is rich in wealth comes begging, / it will be in the minds of men: 'This man will give me something.'

5.208.s:
mama tvaṃ pūrvavaṃśīyaḥ pitā te ca piturmama ..
sadā snehaparaścāsīttvaṃ ca snehavivarjitaḥ .. 31 ..
5.208.d:
मम त्वं पूर्ववंशीयः पिता ते च पितुर्मम ..
सदा स्नेहपरश्चासीत्त्वं च स्नेहविवर्जितः .. 31 ..
5.208.m: 'You belong to my ancestral lineage, and your father was always devoted to affection / for my father, but you are devoid of affection.'

5.208.s:
evaṃ bruvaṃti loke'tra dhanināṃ purataḥ sthitāḥ ..
kulīnā api pāpānāṃ dṛśyaṃte dhanalipsayā ..
daridrasya manuṣyasya kṣitau rājyaṃ prakurvataḥ .. 32 ..
5.208.d:
एवं ब्रुवंति लोकेऽत्र धनिनां पुरतः स्थिताः ..
कुलीना अपि पापानां दृश्यंते धनलिप्सया ..
दरिद्रस्य मनुष्यस्य क्षितौ राज्यं प्रकुर्वतः .. 32 ..
5.208.m: Thus they speak in this world, standing in front of the wealthy; / even men of noble birth are seen [serving] sinners out of a desire for wealth. / For a poor man who rules a kingdom on earth,

5.208.s:
praśoṣaḥ kevalaṃ bhāvī hṛdayasya mahāmune ..
dvāvimau kaṇṭakau tīkṣṇau śarīrapariśoṣiṇau ..
yaścādhanaḥ kāmayate yaśca kupyatyanīśvaraḥ .. 33 ..
5.208.d:
प्रशोषः केवलं भावी हृदयस्य महामुने ..
द्वाविमौ कण्टकौ तीक्ष्णौ शरीरपरिशोषिणौ ..
यश्चाधनः कामयते यश्च कुप्यत्यनीश्वरः .. 33 ..
5.208.m: there will only be the withering of his heart, great sage. / These two are sharp thorns that dry up the body: / one who, lacking wealth, still desires, and one who, lacking power, gets angry.

5.208.s:
śmaśānamapi sevaṃte dhanalubdhā niśāgame ..
janetāramapi tyaktvā nityaṃ yāṃti sudūrataḥ .. 34 ..
5.208.d:
श्मशानमपि सेवंते धनलुब्धा निशागमे ..
जनेतारमपि त्यक्त्वा नित्यं यांति सुदूरतः .. 34 ..
5.208.m: Those greedy for wealth frequent even a cremation ground at the arrival of night; / abandoning even their own progenitor, they constantly go very far away.

5.208.s:
sumūrkhopi bhavedvidvānakulīno'pi satkulaḥ ..
yasya vittaṃ bhave ddharmye viparītamato'nyathā .. 35 ..
5.208.d:
सुमूर्खोपि भवेद्विद्वानकुलीनोऽपि सत्कुलः ..
यस्य वित्तं भवे द्धर्म्ये विपरीतमतोऽन्यथा .. 35 ..
5.208.m: Even a complete fool becomes a scholar, even a low-born man becomes of noble family, / if he has wealth in his house; the opposite is true otherwise.

5.208.s:
nirviṇṇo'haṃ muniśreṣṭha jīvitasya ca sāṃpratam ..
tasmādbrūhi kimarthaṃ me dāridryaṃ samupasthitam .. 36 ..
5.208.d:
निर्विण्णोऽहं मुनिश्रेष्ठ जीवितस्य च सांप्रतम् ..
तस्माद्ब्रूहि किमर्थं मे दारिद्र्यं समुपस्थितम् .. 36 ..
5.208.m: I am despondent with life now, best of sages; / therefore tell me why this poverty has come upon me,

5.208.s:
kuṣṭhaścāpi mamopetaḥ śatrubhiśca parābhavam ..
anyajanmāṃtaraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tvayā divyena cakṣuṣā .. 37 ..
5.208.d:
कुष्ठश्चापि ममोपेतः शत्रुभिश्च पराभवम् ..
अन्यजन्मांतरं दृष्टं त्वया दिव्येन चक्षुषा .. 37 ..
5.208.m: and also leprosy has befallen me, and defeat by enemies. / Another birth was seen by you with your divine eye,

5.208.s:
kukarmaṇā na saṃspṛṣṭaṃ svalpenāpi bravīṣi mām ..
etajjanmātaraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ smarāmi munisattama .. 38 ..
5.208.d:
कुकर्मणा न संस्पृष्टं स्वल्पेनापि ब्रवीषि माम् ..
एतज्जन्मातरं दृष्टं स्मरामि मुनिसत्तम .. 38 ..
5.208.m: and you tell me that I was not touched even by the slightest evil deed. / Seeing this [present] birth, best of sages, I recall

5.208.s:
na mayā kukṛtaṃ kiṃcitkadācitsamanuṣṭhitam ..
tatkiṃ rājyaparibhraṃśo jāto'yaṃ mama sanmune .. 39 ..
5.208.d:
न मया कुकृतं किंचित्कदाचित्समनुष्ठितम् ..
तत्किं राज्यपरिभ्रंशो जातोऽयं मम सन्मुने .. 39 ..
5.208.m: that no evil deed was ever committed by me. / Then why, true sage, has this loss of my kingdom occurred?

5.208.s:
atra me kautukaṃ jātaṃ tasmāddehi vinirṇayam ..
bhavenna vā bhavetkarma kṛtaṃ yacca śubhāśubham .. 6.209.40 ..
5.208.d:
अत्र मे कौतुकं जातं तस्माद्देहि विनिर्णयम् ..
भवेन्न वा भवेत्कर्म कृतं यच्च शुभाशुभम् .. 6.209.40 ..
5.208.m: Curiosity has arisen in me regarding this; therefore give me the conclusion: / Does an action, good or bad, that has been performed bear fruit or not?

5.208.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā tu nāradaḥ ..
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭastataḥ provāca sādaram .. 41 ..
5.208.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चिरं ध्यात्वा तु नारदः ..
कृपया परयाविष्टस्ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् .. 41 ..
5.208.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Having heard those words of his, Nārada, after meditating for a long time, / was overcome with supreme compassion, and then said with respect:

5.208.s:
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi yathā śuddhiḥ prajāyate ..
tava rājyasya saṃprāptiryathā bhūyo'pi jāyate .. 42 ..
5.208.d:
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा शुद्धिः प्रजायते ..
