5.211.m: There lived a certain rustic man in that region, afflicted with old age; / he was a leper, yet he continually herded cattle. (56)

5.211.s:
ekadā rakṣatastasya paśūṃstatra gireradhaḥ ..
ekaḥ paśurviniṣkrāṃtaḥ satpathāttṛṇalobhataḥ ..57..
5.211.d:
एकदा रक्षतस्तस्य पशूंस्तत्र गिरेरधः ..
एकः पशुर्विनिष्क्रांतः सत्पथात्तृणलोभतः ..57..
5.211.m: Once, while he was tending cattle below the mountain there, / one beast strayed from the right path out of greed for grass. (57)

5.211.s:
saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa patitastasya nirjhare ..
na ca saṃlakṣitastena gacchamānaḥ kathaṃcana .. 58 ..
5.211.d:
सप्तम्यां रविवारेण पतितस्तस्य निर्झरे ..
न च संलक्षितस्तेन गच्छमानः कथंचन .. 58 ..
5.211.m: On a Sunday which was a seventh lunar day, it fell into his mountain stream; / and it was not noticed by him at all as it went. (58)

5.211.s:
atha yāvadgṛhe so'tha bhojanāthaṃ samudyataḥ ..
tāvattasya paśoḥ svāmī bhartsayansamupāgataḥ ..59..
5.211.d:
अथ यावद्गृहे सोऽथ भोजनाथं समुद्यतः ..
तावत्तस्य पशोः स्वामी भर्त्सयन्समुपागतः ..59..
5.211.m: Now, just as he was at home preparing to take his meal, / the owner of that beast arrived, scolding him: (59)

5.211.s:
nāyātaḥ sa paśuḥ kasmānmadīyo māmake gṛhe ..
tasmādānaya taṃ śīghraṃ no cetprāṇānharāmi te .. 6.212.60 ..
5.211.d:
नायातः स पशुः कस्मान्मदीयो मामके गृहे ..
तस्मादानय तं शीघ्रं नो चेत्प्राणान्हरामि ते .. 6.212.60 ..
5.211.m: “Why has that beast of mine not returned to my house? / Therefore bring it back at once, or else I will take your life!” (60)

5.211.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā bhaya saṃtrastaḥ sa kuṣṭhī satvaraṃ yayau ..
tena mārgeṇa yenaiva divā bhrāṃto mahītale .. 61 ..
5.211.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा भय संत्रस्तः स कुष्ठी सत्वरं ययौ ..
तेन मार्गेण येनैव दिवा भ्रांतो महीतले .. 61 ..
5.211.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that, terrified with fear, the leper went quickly / along the very path by which he had wandered on the ground by day. (61)

5.211.s:
atha dūrātsa śuśrāva tasya rāvaṃ paśostadā ..
patitasya mahāgarte niśāṃte tamasi sthite ..62..
5.211.d:
अथ दूरात्स शुश्राव तस्य रावं पशोस्तदा ..
पतितस्य महागर्ते निशांते तमसि स्थिते ..62..
5.211.m: Then from afar he heard the cry of that beast / fallen into a deep pit, as the night was ending and darkness still lingered. (62)

5.211.s:
tato gatvā'tha taṃ gartaṃ praviśya jalamadhyataḥ ..
cakarṣa taṃ paśuṃ kṛcchrātpaṃkamadhyātsudāruṇāt ..
samādāyātha taṃ harmyaṃ prajagāma śanaiḥśanaiḥ .. 63 ..
5.211.d:
ततो गत्वाऽथ तं गर्तं प्रविश्य जलमध्यतः ..
चकर्ष तं पशुं कृच्छ्रात्पंकमध्यात्सुदारुणात् ..
समादायाथ तं हर्म्यं प्रजगाम शनैःशनैः .. 63 ..
5.211.m: Then, going to that pit and entering into the water, / he dragged out that beast with difficulty from the terrible mire; / and taking it, he went slowly toward the dwelling. (63)

5.211.s: arpayitvātha taṃ tasya svakīyaṃ tvāśramaṃ gataḥ .. 64 ..
5.211.d: अर्पयित्वाथ तं तस्य स्वकीयं त्वाश्रमं गतः .. 64 ..
5.211.m: Having handed it over to him, he went back to his own hermitage. (64)

5.211.s:
tataḥ supto mahābhāgāḥ sa prabuddhaḥ punaryadā ..
prabhāte vīkṣate gātraṃ yāvatkuṣṭhavivarjitam .. 65 ..
5.211.d:
ततः सुप्तो महाभागाः स प्रबुद्धः पुनर्यदा ..
प्रभाते वीक्षते गात्रं यावत्कुष्ठविवर्जितम् .. 65 ..
5.211.m: Then he slept, O fortunate ones; and when he awoke again / at dawn, he beheld his body completely free from leprosy, (65)

5.211.s:
śobhayā parayā yuktaṃ vismayotphullalocanaḥ ..
ciṃtayāmāsa kiṃ hyetadakasmādrogasaṃkṣayaḥ .. 66 ..
5.211.d:
शोभया परया युक्तं विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः ..
चिंतयामास किं ह्येतदकस्माद्रोगसंक्षयः .. 66 ..
5.211.m: endowed with supreme beauty; his eyes wide with astonishment, / he pondered: “What indeed is this sudden destruction of disease? (66)

5.211.s:
nūnaṃ tasya prabhāvo'yaṃ tīrthasyādya niśāgame ..
mayāvagāhitaṃ yacca paśorarthaṃ sukarddamam .. 67 ..
5.211.d:
नूनं तस्य प्रभावोऽयं तीर्थस्याद्य निशागमे ..
मयावगाहितं यच्च पशोरर्थं सुकर्द्दमम् .. 67 ..
5.211.m: Surely this is the power of that sacred ford at nightfall today, / where I plunged into the deep mud for the sake of the beast.” (67)

5.211.s:
tataśca vīkṣayāmāsa tena gatvā sukautukāt ..
yāvatkaṃḍūvinirmuktastejasā parivāritaḥ .. 68 ..
5.211.d:
ततश्च वीक्षयामास तेन गत्वा सुकौतुकात् ..
यावत्कंडूविनिर्मुक्तस्तेजसा परिवारितः .. 68 ..
5.211.m: Then he looked at [the beast] after going there out of great wonder: / it too was freed from scabies and enveloped with radiance. (68)

5.211.s:
tatra sthāne svayaṃ gatvā jñātvā ca tīrthamuttamam ..
tapastepe sa tatraiva dhyāyamāno divākaram ..69..
5.211.d:
तत्र स्थाने स्वयं गत्वा ज्ञात्वा च तीर्थमुत्तमम् ..
तपस्तेपे स तत्रैव ध्यायमानो दिवाकरम् ..69..
5.211.m: Having gone there himself and recognized it as an excellent sacred ford, / he performed austerity right there, meditating upon the Sun, (69)

5.211.s:
araṇyavāsinaṃ samyagdivārātramataṃdritaḥ ..
gataśca paramāṃ siddhiṃ durlabhāṃ tridaśairapi .. 6.212.70 ..
5.211.d:
अरण्यवासिनं सम्यग्दिवारात्रमतंद्रितः ..
गतश्च परमां सिद्धिं दुर्लभां त्रिदशैरपि .. 6.212.70 ..
5.211.m: dwelling properly in the forest, unwearied day and night; / and he attained supreme perfection, difficult to reach even for the thirty [gods]. (70)

5.211.s: tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snānaṃ samācaret .. 71 ..
5.211.d: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र स्नानं समाचरेत् .. 71 ..
5.211.m: Therefore, with every effort, one should perform a ritual ablution there. (71)

5.211.s:
pūjayeccāpi taṃ devaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram ..
adyāpi kalikāle'pi tatra snāto naraḥ śuciḥ .. 72 ..
5.211.d:
पूजयेच्चापि तं देवं भास्करं वारितस्करम् ..
अद्यापि कलिकालेऽपि तत्र स्नातो नरः शुचिः .. 72 ..
5.211.m: And one should worship that god, the Sun, who draws up the water. / Even today, even in the Kali age, a man who has bathed there becomes pure. (72)

5.211.s:
tatra puṇyajale kuṇḍe saptamyāṃ sūryavāsare ..
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā so'pi pāpaiḥ pramucyate ..73..
5.211.d:
तत्र पुण्यजले कुण्डे सप्तम्यां सूर्यवासरे ..
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या सोऽपि पापैः प्रमुच्यते ..73..
5.211.m: Whoever worships him with devotion in that reservoir of sacred water / on a Sunday which is a seventh lunar day, he too is freed from sins. (73)

5.211.s:
gāyatryaṣṭasahasraṃ yo japettatpurataḥ sthitaḥ ..
so'pi rogavinirmukto mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 74 ..
5.211.d:
गायत्र्यष्टसहस्रं यो जपेत्तत्पुरतः स्थितः ..
सोऽपि रोगविनिर्मुक्तो मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 74 ..
5.211.m: Whoever, standing before him, recites eight thousand Gāyatrī [mantras], / he too, freed from disease, is liberated from all heinous sins. (74)

5.211.s:
tasyoddeśena yo dadyāddhenuṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
na tasyānvayajāto'pi vyādhinā parigṛhyate .. 785 ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ mayādityasya saṃbhavam ..
māhātmyaṃ śravaṇādyasya naraḥ pāpādvimucyate .. 76 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetra māhātmye ratnādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 212 .. ..
5.211.d:
तस्योद्देशेन यो दद्याद्धेनुं श्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
न तस्यान्वयजातोऽपि व्याधिना परिगृह्यते .. 785 ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं मयादित्यस्य संभवम् ..
माहात्म्यं श्रवणाद्यस्य नरः पापाद्विमुच्यते .. 76 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये रत्नादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वादशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 212 .. ..
5.211.m:
Whoever with faith gives a cow dedicated to him, / not even a person born in his family line is seized by disease. (75)
All this about the origin of the Sun [shrine] has been told to you by me, / the māhātmya from the hearing of which a person is liberated from sin. (76)
Thus ends the two hundred and twelfth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Ratnāditya Māhātmya,' in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part], in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. (212)

5.212.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ratnādityasya māhātmyametadvaḥ parikīrtitam ..
sarvakuṣṭhaharaṃ yacca sarvapātakanāśanam ..
bhūyastathaiva māhātmyaṃ mahadvai śrūyatāṃ raveḥ .. 1 ..
purāsīdbrāhmaṇaḥ kaścitkuṣṭhavyādhisamākulaḥ .1
5.212.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
रत्नादित्यस्य माहात्म्यमेतद्वः परिकीर्तितम् ..
सर्वकुष्ठहरं यच्च सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
भूयस्तथैव माहात्म्यं महद्वै श्रूयतां रवेः .. 1 ..
पुरासीद्ब्राह्मणः कश्चित्कुष्ठव्याधिसमाकुलः .1
5.212.m:
Sūta said: / This māhātmya of Ratnāditya, which removes all leprosy / and destroys all heinous sins, has been proclaimed to you. / Now hear likewise another great māhātmya of the Sun. (1)
Formerly there was a certain brahmin afflicted with the disease of leprosy. (1b)

5.212.s: tena cārādhitaḥ sūryastatrasthena dvijottamāḥ .. 2 ..
5.212.d: तेन चाराधितः सूर्यस्तत्रस्थेन द्विजोत्तमाः .. 2 ..
5.212.m: Staying there, O best of the twice-born, the Sun was worshipped by him. (2)

5.212.s:
pūrvadakṣiṇadigbhāge samāsādya tataḥ param ..
rakta candanajāṃ kṛtvā pratimāṃ bhāvitātmanā .. 3 ..
5.212.d:
पूर्वदक्षिणदिग्भागे समासाद्य ततः परम् ..
रक्त चन्दनजां कृत्वा प्रतिमां भावितात्मना .. 3 ..
5.212.m: Having reached the south-eastern region after that, / with a purified soul he fashioned an image made of red sandalwood. (3)

5.212.s:
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tuṣṭastasya divākaraḥ ..
varado'smīti taṃ prāha dṛṣṭigocaramāgataḥ .. 4 .. ..
5.212.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते तुष्टस्तस्य दिवाकरः ..
वरदोऽस्मीति तं प्राह दृष्टिगोचरमागतः .. 4 .. ..
5.212.m: Then, at the end of a thousand years, the Sun, being pleased, / appeared within his sight and said to him, “I am a giver of boons.” (4)

5.212.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva kuṣṭhavyādhiṃ hara prabho ..
nānyena kāraṇaṃ me'sti rājyenāpi triviṣṭape .. 5 ..
5.212.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव कुष्ठव्याधिं हर प्रभो ..
नान्येन कारणं मेऽस्ति राज्येनापि त्रिविष्टपे .. 5 ..
5.212.m: The brahmin said: / “If you are pleased with me, O god, take away the disease of leprosy, O Lord! / I have no need of anything else, nor even of kingdom in heaven.” (5)

5.212.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa kuru vipra pradakṣiṇām ..
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yāvatsnātvā puṇyahrade śubhe ..
phalahastaḥ pṛthaktvena tataḥ kuṣṭhena mucyase ..6..
5.212.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
सप्तम्यां सूर्यवारेण कुरु विप्र प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
शतमष्टोत्तरं यावत्स्नात्वा पुण्यह्रदे शुभे ..
फलहस्तः पृथक्त्वेन ततः कुष्ठेन मुच्यसे ..6..
5.212.m: The Holy One said: / “On a Sunday which is a seventh lunar day, O brahmin, circumambulate [me] / a hundred and eight times, having bathed in the auspicious holy pool, / with a fruit in your hand for each one; then you shall be freed from leprosy. (6)

5.212.s:
anyo'tra gāṃ gato yo'pi vratametatkariṣyati ..
sarvarogavinirmukto mama lokaṃ sa gacchati .. 7 ..
5.212.d:
अन्योऽत्र गां गतो योऽपि व्रतमेतत्करिष्यति ..
सर्वरोगविनिर्मुक्तो मम लोकं स गच्छति .. 7 ..
5.212.m: Whosoever else on earth shall perform this observance / shall be freed from all diseases and go to my realm.” (7)

5.212.s:
.. śrīsūrya uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā sa tathā cakre brāhmaṇaḥ śraddhayā'nvitaḥ ..
vimuktaśca tadā kuṣṭhāddivyadehamavāptavān .. 8 ..
5.212.d:
.. श्रीसूर्य उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा स तथा चक्रे ब्राह्मणः श्रद्धयाऽन्वितः ..
विमुक्तश्च तदा कुष्ठाद्दिव्यदेहमवाप्तवान् .. 8 ..
5.212.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that, the brahmin acted accordingly with faith; / and then he was freed from leprosy and attained a divine body. (8)

5.212.s:
atha bhūyo'pi taṃ prāha nīrogaṃ bhagavānraviḥ ..
kiṃ te priyaṃ karomyanyadvada brāhmaṇasattama .. 9 ..
5.212.d:
अथ भूयोऽपि तं प्राह नीरोगं भगवान्रविः ..
किं ते प्रियं करोम्यन्यद्वद ब्राह्मणसत्तम .. 9 ..
5.212.m: Then the blessed Sun said once more to him who was freed from disease: / “What other pleasing thing may I do for you? Speak, O best of brahmins.” (9)

5.212.s: so'bravītsarvadaivātra sthātavyaṃ bhagavanvibho .. 6.213.10 ..
5.212.d: सोऽब्रवीत्सर्वदैवात्र स्थातव्यं भगवन्विभो .. 6.213.10 ..
5.212.m: He said: “O blessed Lord, you must always abide here.” (10)

5.212.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ mamāvāsaḥ sthāne'tra ca bhaviṣyati ..
nāmnā kuharavāsākhyā saṃjñā mama bhaviṣyati .. 11 ..
5.212.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
अतः परं ममावासः स्थानेऽत्र च भविष्यति ..
नाम्ना कुहरवासाख्या संज्ञा मम भविष्यति .. 11 ..
5.212.m: The Holy One said: / “Henceforth my abode shall be in this place, / and my name will be known as Kuharavāsin.” (11)

5.212.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya viṣṇuputro babhūva ha ..
sāṃbonāma surūpāḍhyo jāṃbavatyāṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 12 ..
kṣobhasaṃjananaḥ strīṇāṃ mātṝṇāmapi sa dvijāḥ .1
5.212.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य विष्णुपुत्रो बभूव ह ..
सांबोनाम सुरूपाढ्यो जांबवत्यां द्विजोत्तमाः .. 12 ..
क्षोभसंजननः स्त्रीणां मातॄणामपि स द्विजाः .1
5.212.m:
Now after some time a son was born to Viṣṇu / named Sāmba, richly endowed with beauty, from Jāmbavatī, O best of the twice-born. (12)
He caused agitation even among women who were like mothers, O twice-born. (13a)

5.212.s: atha taṃ rājamārgeṇa gacchaṃtaṃ yadusattamam .. 13 ..
5.212.d: अथ तं राजमार्गेण गच्छंतं यदुसत्तमम् .. 13 ..
5.212.m: Now, as that best of the Yadus was walking along the royal highway, (13b)

5.212.s:
puranāryo'pi saṃtuṣṭā vīkṣāṃcakruḥ sukautukāt ..
gṛhakāryāṇi saṃtyajya samārūḍhā gavākṣakān .. 14 ..
5.212.d:
पुरनार्योऽपि संतुष्टा वीक्षांचक्रुः सुकौतुकात् ..
गृहकार्याणि संत्यज्य समारूढा गवाक्षकान् .. 14 ..
5.212.m: the city women also, delighted, watched him with great curiosity; / abandoning their household chores, they climbed up onto the lattice-windows, (14)

5.212.s:
tasya kāmātmadehasya darśanārthaṃ samutsukāḥ ..
kāścidardhānuliptāṃgyaḥ kāścidekāṃjitekṣaṇāḥ .. 15
5.212.d:
तस्य कामात्मदेहस्य दर्शनार्थं समुत्सुकाः ..
काश्चिदर्धानुलिप्तांग्यः काश्चिदेकांजितेक्षणाः .. 15
5.212.m: eager to catch sight of him whose body was like Love incarnate— / some with their limbs only half-anointed, some with only one eye painted with collyrium. (15)

5.212.s:
ardhasaṃyamitaiḥ keśaistathānyāstyaktabālakāḥ..
ekasmiṃścaraṇe kāścinniyojyopānahaṃ drutāḥ . 16 ..
5.212.d:
अर्धसंयमितैः केशैस्तथान्यास्त्यक्तबालकाः..
एकस्मिंश्चरणे काश्चिन्नियोज्योपानहं द्रुताः . 16 ..
5.212.m: with hair only half bound up, and others leaving their children behind; / some, slipping a sandal on one foot, ran swiftly,

5.212.s:
pādukāṃ ca dvitīye tu paryadhāvannitaṃbinīḥ ..
vrajaṃtīṣu tathānyāsu vanitāsu gavākṣakān .. 17 ..
5.212.d:
पादुकां च द्वितीये तु पर्यधावन्नितंबिनीः ..
व्रजंतीषु तथान्यासु वनितासु गवाक्षकान् .. 17 ..
5.212.m: and the broad-hipped women ran about with a shoe on the second. / And while the other women were rushing to the latticed windows,

5.212.s:
vyākrośaṃti krudhāviṣṭāḥ śiśavo guravastathā ..
nīvībandhanaviśleṣasamākulitacetasaḥ .. 18 ..
5.212.d:
व्याक्रोशंति क्रुधाविष्टाः शिशवो गुरवस्तथा ..
नीवीबन्धनविश्लेषसमाकुलितचेतसः .. 18 ..
5.212.m: children and elders, overcome with anger, shouted loudly after them. / Their minds perturbed by the loosening of their skirt-knots,

5.212.s:
yayurevāparāḥ sveṣu gavākṣeṣu varāṃganāḥ ..
sa cakarṣa tadā tāsāṃ patitairnetraraśmibhiḥ .. 19 ..
5.212.d:
ययुरेवापराः स्वेषु गवाक्षेषु वरांगनाः ..
स चकर्ष तदा तासां पतितैर्नेत्ररश्मिभिः .. 19 ..
5.212.m: the noble women went straight to their own windows. / Then, with the rays of their falling glances, that youth resembling Kāmadeva

5.212.s:
hṛdayāni dharāpṛṣṭhe kāmadevasamo yuvā ..
kāciddṛṣṭvaiva tadrūpaṃ tasya sāṃbasya kāminī .. 6.213.20 ..
5.212.d:
हृदयानि धरापृष्ठे कामदेवसमो युवा ..
काचिद्दृष्ट्वैव तद्रूपं तस्य सांबस्य कामिनी .. 6.213.20 ..
5.212.m: drew their hearts down onto the surface of the earth. / A certain lovestruck woman, merely upon seeing that form of Sāmba,

5.212.s:
niścalā kāmataptāṃgī likhiteva vibhābyate ..
kācidagnisamānmuktvā niśvāsānkāmapīḍitā .. 21 ..
ekāstaṃ ca samālokya rūpayauvanasaṃyutam ..
gavākṣātprapataṃti sma niśceṣṭā dharaṇītale .. 22 ..
5.212.d:
निश्चला कामतप्तांगी लिखितेव विभाब्यते ..
काचिदग्निसमान्मुक्त्वा निश्वासान्कामपीडिता .. 21 ..
एकास्तं च समालोक्य रूपयौवनसंयुतम् ..
गवाक्षात्प्रपतंति स्म निश्चेष्टा धरणीतले .. 22 ..
5.212.m: stood motionless, her limbs burning with passion, appearing as if painted. / Another, afflicted with passion, let out sighs hot as fire; / and one, beholding him endowed with beauty and youth, / fell senseless from the window down onto the surface of the earth.

5.212.s:
anyāḥ parasparālāpa prakurvaṃti varastriyaḥ ..
ekā sā kāminī dhanyā yāsya cakrevagūhanam .. 23
5.212.d:
अन्याः परस्परालाप प्रकुर्वंति वरस्त्रियः ..
एका सा कामिनी धन्या यास्य चक्रेवगूहनम् .. 23
5.212.m: Other noble women conversed with one another: / “Blessed is that one loving woman who embraces him

5.212.s:
niḥśeṣāṃ rajanīṃ prāpya māghamāsasamudbhavām ..
āstāṃ tāvatstriyo yāśca narā api nirargalam .. 24 ..
5.212.d:
निःशेषां रजनीं प्राप्य माघमाससमुद्भवाम् ..
आस्तां तावत्स्त्रियो याश्च नरा अपि निरर्गलम् .. 24 ..
5.212.m: throughout the entire night in the month of Māgha!” / Let the women be: even men, unrestrained,

5.212.s:
jalpaṃti cedṛśaṃ sarvaṃ tasya rūpeṇa vismitāḥ ..
atraye vadanti sevāma enamarthena varjitāḥ .. 25 ..
5.212.d:
जल्पंति चेदृशं सर्वं तस्य रूपेण विस्मिताः ..
अत्रये वदन्ति सेवाम एनमर्थेन वर्जिताः .. 25 ..
5.212.m: spoke in such a manner, astonished by his beauty. / In this matter they said: “Let us serve him without taking any wealth,

5.212.s:
vīkṣyāmo vadanaṃ yena nityameveṃdusaṃnibham ..
karṇābhyāṃ vāritā vṛddhirnetrayorapyasaṃśayam ..
no cejjānīmahe naiva kiyatī saṃ bhaviṣyati .. 26 ..
5.212.d:
वीक्ष्यामो वदनं येन नित्यमेवेंदुसंनिभम् ..
कर्णाभ्यां वारिता वृद्धिर्नेत्रयोरप्यसंशयम् ..
नो चेज्जानीमहे नैव कियती सं भविष्यति .. 26 ..
5.212.m: so that we may constantly behold his face resembling the moon! / Undoubtedly the growth of his eyes was halted by his ears; / otherwise, we do not know how immense it would become.”

5.212.s:
evaṃ saṃvīkṣyamāṇastu kāminībhirnaraistathā ..
niryayau rājamārgeṇa pitṛdarśanalālasaḥ .. 27 ..
5.212.d:
एवं संवीक्ष्यमाणस्तु कामिनीभिर्नरैस्तथा ..
निर्ययौ राजमार्गेण पितृदर्शनलालसः .. 27 ..
5.212.m: Thus being gazed upon by passionate women and by men alike, / he went out along the royal highway, eager to see his father.

5.212.s:
bhaginyo mātaro yāśca bhrātṛpatnyaśca yāḥ sthitāḥ ..
avasthāmīdṛśīṃ prāptā brāhmaṇānāmapi striyaḥ ..
mātaro'pi ca yāstasya bhaginyaśca viśeṣataḥ .. .. 28 ..
5.212.d:
भगिन्यो मातरो याश्च भ्रातृपत्न्यश्च याः स्थिताः ..
अवस्थामीदृशीं प्राप्ता ब्राह्मणानामपि स्त्रियः ..
मातरोऽपि च यास्तस्य भगिन्यश्च विशेषतः .. .. 28 ..
5.212.m: Sisters, mothers, and those who were brothers' wives— / even the wives of brahmins fell into such a state; / and especially his own mothers and his sisters.

5.212.s:
anyasminnahani prāpte prāvṛṭkāle niśāgame ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe tamobhūte alakṣye'pi gate puraḥ .. 29 ..
5.212.d:
अन्यस्मिन्नहनि प्राप्ते प्रावृट्काले निशागमे ..
कृष्णपक्षे तमोभूते अलक्ष्येऽपि गते पुरः .. 29 ..
5.212.m: When another day arrived during the rainy season, at the onset of night, / in the dark fortnight, shrouded in darkness so that nothing before them could be seen,

5.212.s:
tanmātā nandinīnāma kāmadevaśarārditā ..
tatpatnyā veṣamādhāya tacchayyāyāmupasthitā .. 6.213.30 ..
5.212.d:
तन्माता नन्दिनीनाम कामदेवशरार्दिता ..
तत्पत्न्या वेषमाधाय तच्छय्यायामुपस्थिता .. 6.213.30 ..
5.212.m: his mother named Nandinī, afflicted by the arrows of Kāmadeva, / assumed the guise of his wife and approached his bed.

5.212.s:
so'pi tāṃ dayitāṃ jñātvā sevayāmāsa kāminīm ..
ratopacārairvividhairaśraddheyavinirmitaiḥ .. 31 ..
5.212.d:
सोऽपि तां दयितां ज्ञात्वा सेवयामास कामिनीम् ..
रतोपचारैर्विविधैरश्रद्धेयविनिर्मितैः .. 31 ..
5.212.m: He too, thinking her to be his beloved, made love to that passionate woman / with diverse acts of lovemaking of an incredible nature.

5.212.s:
tayā tatra yaduśreṣṭho vikalpamakarottadā ..
aṃgarājasutā yā me prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī .. .. 32 ..
5.212.d:
तया तत्र यदुश्रेष्ठो विकल्पमकरोत्तदा ..
अंगराजसुता या मे प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी .. .. 32 ..
5.212.m: There the best of the Yadus became suspicious concerning her: / “She who is the daughter of the king of Aṅga, dearer to me than my very life,

5.212.s:
naivaṃvidhaṃ rataṃ veda anayā yadvinirmitam ..
veśyā api na jānaṃti ratamīdṛkkathañcana .. 33 ..
5.212.d:
नैवंविधं रतं वेद अनया यद्विनिर्मितम् ..
वेश्या अपि न जानंति रतमीदृक्कथञ्चन .. 33 ..
5.212.m: does not know such lovemaking as has been performed by this woman! / Even courtesans do not know of such lovemaking by any means.”

5.212.s:
tato gāḍhaṃ kare dhṛtvā dīpamānīya tatkṣaṇāt ..
yāvatpaśyati sā mātā nandinīti ca yā smṛtā .. 34 ..
5.212.d:
ततो गाढं करे धृत्वा दीपमानीय तत्क्षणात् ..
यावत्पश्यति सा माता नन्दिनीति च या स्मृता .. 34 ..
5.212.m: Then, seizing her firmly by the hand, he immediately brought a lamp. / As soon as he looked, she was that mother known as Nandinī.

5.212.s:
tataśca garhayāmāsa rape kimidaṃ kṛtam ..
garhitaṃ sarvalokānāṃ nara kārtipradaṃ tathā .. 35 ..
5.212.d:
ततश्च गर्हयामास रपे किमिदं कृतम् ..
गर्हितं सर्वलोकानां नर कार्तिप्रदं तथा .. 35 ..
5.212.m: And then he reproached her: “Alas! What is this that has been done? / It is despised by all the world and brings the torment of hell!

5.212.s:
sāpi lajjāsamopetā mahābhayasamākulā ..
praṇaṣṭā tatkṣaṇādeva bhayena mahatā'nvinā .. 36 ..
5.212.d:
सापि लज्जासमोपेता महाभयसमाकुला ..
प्रणष्टा तत्क्षणादेव भयेन महताऽन्विना .. 36 ..
5.212.m: She too, overcome with shame and confounded by great dread, / vanished that very instant, possessed by overwhelming fear.

5.212.s:
sāṃbo'pi pralapannārto nidrāṃ lebhe na vai dvijāḥ ..
rātriśeṣamabhūttasya tadā varṣaśatopamam .. 37 ..
5.212.d:
सांबोऽपि प्रलपन्नार्तो निद्रां लेभे न वै द्विजाः ..
रात्रिशेषमभूत्तस्य तदा वर्षशतोपमम् .. 37 ..
5.212.m: Sāmba too, wailing and distressed, found no sleep at all, O twice-born; / the remainder of the night seemed to him then like a hundred years.

5.212.s:
atha rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ prodgate ravimaṇḍale ..
duḥkhena mahatā yuktaḥ protthitaḥ sa hareḥ sutaḥ .. 38 ..
5.212.d:
अथ रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां प्रोद्गते रविमण्डले ..
दुःखेन महता युक्तः प्रोत्थितः स हरेः सुतः .. 38 ..
5.212.m: Then, when the night had passed and the orb of the sun had arisen, / that son of Hari arose, filled with great sorrow.

5.212.s:
āvaśyakamapi tyaktvā kaṃcidbrāhmaṇasattamam ..
dharmaśāstravidhānajñaṃ samānīyātha cābravīt .. 39 ..
5.212.d:
आवश्यकमपि त्यक्त्वा कंचिद्ब्राह्मणसत्तमम् ..
धर्मशास्त्रविधानज्ञं समानीयाथ चाब्रवीत् .. 39 ..
5.212.m: Setting aside even his daily duties, he brought a certain excellent brahmin / who knew the ordinances of the Dharmaśāstras, and said to him:

5.212.s:
rahasye vinayopetaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ..
.. sāṃba uvāca .. ..
mātrā svasrā duhitrā vā svayaṃ syādyadi mohanam .. 6.213.40 ..
5.212.d:
रहस्ये विनयोपेतः कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः ..
.. सांब उवाच .. ..
मात्रा स्वस्रा दुहित्रा वा स्वयं स्याद्यदि मोहनम् .. 6.213.40 ..
5.212.m: Standing in secret, full of humility, with folded hands: / Sāmba said: / “If infatuation should happen to occur with one's mother, sister, or daughter,

5.212.s:
kathaṃ śuddhirbhavettasya paramārthena me vada ..
dharmaśāstrāṇi saṃvīkṣya sarvāṇi ca yathākramam .. 41 ..
5.212.d:
कथं शुद्धिर्भवेत्तस्य परमार्थेन मे वद ..
धर्मशास्त्राणि संवीक्ष्य सर्वाणि च यथाक्रमम् .. 41 ..
5.212.m: tell me truly, how can his purification be attained? / Having examined all the Dharmaśāstras in their proper order, [tell me].”

5.212.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
paranāryāḥ kṛte vatsa prāyaścittaṃ vinirmitam ..
dharma droṇeṣu sarveṣu varṇānāṃ ca pṛthagvidham .. 42 ..
5.212.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
परनार्याः कृते वत्स प्रायश्चित्तं विनिर्मितम् ..
धर्म द्रोणेषु सर्वेषु वर्णानां च पृथग्विधम् .. 42 ..
5.212.m: The brahmin said: / “My child, an expiation is prescribed for [the violation of] another man's wife; / in all the codes of law it is prescribed differently for each of the castes.

5.212.s:
āsāṃ ca tisṛṇāṃ caiva trayāṇāṃ parikīrtitam ..
evamevaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ prāyaścittaṃ viśudaye .. 43 ..
5.212.d:
आसां च तिसृणां चैव त्रयाणां परिकीर्तितम् ..
एवमेवं विनिर्दिष्टं प्रायश्चित्तं विशुदये .. 43 ..
5.212.m: And in the case of these three women, it is proclaimed for the three [higher castes]; / in this very manner the expiation has been declared for purification.

5.212.s:
mātrā mohanamāsādya bhaginyā vātha yādava ..
duhitrā vā pramādācca kāryaṃ saṃśodhanaṃ budhaiḥ ..
śuddhyarthaṃ tiṃginīmekāṃ nānyajjānāmyahaṃ yataḥ .. 44 ..
5.212.d:
मात्रा मोहनमासाद्य भगिन्या वाथ यादव ..
दुहित्रा वा प्रमादाच्च कार्यं संशोधनं बुधैः ..
शुद्ध्यर्थं तिंगिनीमेकां नान्यज्जानाम्यहं यतः .. 44 ..
5.212.m: If infatuation occurs with a mother, or with a sister, O Yādava, / or through negligence with a daughter, purification must be performed by the wise. / For purification, I know of only the tiṅginī and nothing else.

5.212.s:
dharmadroṇeṣu sarveṣu nirṇayo'yamudāhṛtaḥ ..
yo mayā tava saṃdiṣṭo nānyosti yadupuṃgava .. 45 ..
5.212.d:
धर्मद्रोणेषु सर्वेषु निर्णयोऽयमुदाहृतः ..
यो मया तव संदिष्टो नान्योस्ति यदुपुंगव .. 45 ..
5.212.m: In all the codes of law this decision has been pronounced; / that which I have declared to you has no alternative, O bull of the Yadus.

5.212.s:
anyathā yo vadetpṛṣṭaḥ prāyāścittaṃ svacchanda taḥ ..
tasya pāpasya bhāgī syādyathā kartā tathaiva saḥ .. 46 ..
5.212.d:
अन्यथा यो वदेत्पृष्टः प्रायाश्चित्तं स्वच्छन्द तः ..
तस्य पापस्य भागी स्याद्यथा कर्ता तथैव सः .. 46 ..
5.212.m: Whoever, being questioned, declares an expiation otherwise out of his own whim, / would become a sharer in that sin, just as the perpetrator himself.”

5.212.s:
.. sāṃba uvāca .. ..
tiṃginyāḥ kiṃ svarūpaṃ ca kiṃ pramāṇaṃ dvijottama ..
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi mamāstyatra prayojanam .. 47 ..
5.212.d:
.. सांब उवाच .. ..
तिंगिन्याः किं स्वरूपं च किं प्रमाणं द्विजोत्तम ..
सर्वं विस्तरतो ब्रूहि ममास्त्यत्र प्रयोजनम् .. 47 ..
5.212.m: Sāmba said: / “What is the nature of the tiṅginī, and what is its measure, O best of the twice-born? / Tell me everything in detail; I have a need for it here.”

5.212.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
govāṭacūrṇamādāya gartāṃ bhṛtvā svamānajām ..
śayanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ yāvadvaktreṇa yādava .. 48 ..
5.212.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
गोवाटचूर्णमादाय गर्तां भृत्वा स्वमानजाम् ..
शयनं तत्र कर्तव्यं यावद्वक्त्रेण यादव .. 48 ..
5.212.m: The brahmin said: / “Taking dry cow-dung powder and filling a pit measured to one's own size, / one must lie down in it, O Yādava, up to one's mouth.

5.212.s:
upariṣṭāttacca cūrṇaṃ dhāryaṃ govāṭasaṃbhavam ..
yāvadvaktrapramāṇaṃ ca varjayitvā svamānanam .. 49 ..
5.212.d:
उपरिष्टात्तच्च चूर्णं धार्यं गोवाटसंभवम् ..
यावद्वक्त्रप्रमाणं च वर्जयित्वा स्वमाननम् .. 49 ..
5.212.m: Above, that powder made of cow-dung must be applied, / up to the level of the mouth, leaving one's face exposed.

5.212.s:
tataḥ pādapradeśe tu jvālayeddhavyavāhanam ..
yathā śanaiḥ śanairdāhaḥ śarīrasya prajāyate .. 6.213.50 ..
5.212.d:
ततः पादप्रदेशे तु ज्वालयेद्धव्यवाहनम् ..
यथा शनैः शनैर्दाहः शरीरस्य प्रजायते .. 6.213.50 ..
5.212.m: Then one should kindle fire at the region of the feet, / so that burning of the body occurs very gradually.

5.212.s:
na caiva cālayedaṃgaṃ kathaṃcittatra saṃsthitaḥ ..
naivākraṃdaṃ tathā kuryāddhyāyedekaṃ janārdanam .. 51 ..
5.212.d:
न चैव चालयेदंगं कथंचित्तत्र संस्थितः ..
नैवाक्रंदं तथा कुर्याद्ध्यायेदेकं जनार्दनम् .. 51 ..
5.212.m: Stationed there, one should not move a limb in any way; / nor should one cry out; one should meditate solely on Janārdana.

5.212.s: tato jīvitanāśena gātraśuddhiḥ prajāyate .. 52 ..
5.212.d: ततो जीवितनाशेन गात्रशुद्धिः प्रजायते .. 52 ..
5.212.m: Then, through the loss of life, purification of the body is achieved.

5.212.s:
tiṃginyā yatsvarūpaṃ ca tanmayā parikīrtitam ..
prāyaścittamidaṃ samyaṅmahāpātakanāśanam .. 53 ..
5.212.d:
तिंगिन्या यत्स्वरूपं च तन्मया परिकीर्तितम् ..
प्रायश्चित्तमिदं सम्यङ्महापातकनाशनम् .. 53 ..
5.212.m: The nature of the tiṅginī has thus been described by me. / This is the expiation that completely destroys great sins.”

5.212.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ ..
hṛdaye niścayaṃ kṛtvā tiṃginīsādhakodbhavam .. 54 ..
5.212.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य सांबो जांबवतीसुतः ..
हृदये निश्चयं कृत्वा तिंगिनीसाधकोद्भवम् .. 54 ..
5.212.m: Hearing his words, Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavatī, / made a resolve in his heart to undertake the tiṅginī.

5.212.s:
tataḥ provāca vijane vāsudevaṃ ghṛṇānvitaḥ ..
tātāhaṃ vipralabdhastu naṃdinyā tava bhāryayā .. 55 ..
5.212.d:
ततः प्रोवाच विजने वासुदेवं घृणान्वितः ..
ताताहं विप्रलब्धस्तु नंदिन्या तव भार्यया .. 55 ..
5.212.m: Then, filled with self-disgust, he spoke to Vāsudeva in seclusion: / “Father, I was deceived by your wife Nandinī.

5.212.s:
bhāryāyā rūpamādhāya pāpayā tamasi sthite ..
sā mayā nijabhāryeyamiti matvā niṣevitā .. 56 ..
5.212.d:
भार्याया रूपमाधाय पापया तमसि स्थिते ..
सा मया निजभार्येयमिति मत्वा निषेविता .. 56 ..
5.212.m: Assuming the form of my wife while it was dark, that sinful woman came; / thinking, ‘This is my own wife,’ she was enjoyed by me.

5.212.s:
tatastu ceṣṭitairjñātvā garhayitvā visarjitā ..
tataḥprabhṛti gātre me kuṣṭhavyādhirayaṃ sthitaḥ .. .. 57 ..
5.212.d:
ततस्तु चेष्टितैर्ज्ञात्वा गर्हयित्वा विसर्जिता ..
ततःप्रभृति गात्रे मे कुष्ठव्याधिरयं स्थितः .. .. 57 ..
5.212.m: Then, recognizing her by her movements, I rebuked and dismissed her. / From that time on, this leprosy has settled upon my body.

5.212.s:
mayātha dharmaśāstrajñaḥ kaścitpṛṣṭo dvijottamaḥ ..
prāyaścittaṃ yathoktaṃ me vada mātṛniṣevaṇāt .. 58 ..
5.212.d:
मयाथ धर्मशास्त्रज्ञः कश्चित्पृष्टो द्विजोत्तमः ..
प्रायश्चित्तं यथोक्तं मे वद मातृनिषेवणात् .. 58 ..
5.212.m: I then questioned an excellent brahmin who knows the Dharmaśāstras: / ‘Tell me the expiation as taught for cohabiting with a mother.’

5.212.s:
tenoktaṃ sādhanaṃ samyaktiṃginyā mama śuddhaye ..
so'haṃ tāṃ sādhayiṣyāmi tasya pāpasya śuddhaye .. 59 ..
5.212.d:
तेनोक्तं साधनं सम्यक्तिंगिन्या मम शुद्धये ..
सोऽहं तां साधयिष्यामि तस्य पापस्य शुद्धये .. 59 ..
5.212.m: By him was declared the proper practice of Tiṅginī for my purification. / I shall undertake that practice to cleanse that sin. // 59

5.212.s:
anujñāṃ dehi me śīghraṃ kāryaṃ yena karomyaham ..
kṣaṃtavyaṃ ca mayā bālye yatkiṃcitkukṛtaṃ kṛtam.. 6.213.60 ..
5.212.d:
अनुज्ञां देहि मे शीघ्रं कार्यं येन करोम्यहम् ..
क्षंतव्यं च मया बाल्ये यत्किंचित्कुकृतं कृतम्.. 6.213.60 ..
5.212.m: Give me your permission quickly, so that I may perform this duty; / and you must forgive whatever wrongdoing I committed in my childhood. // 60

5.212.s: mama mātā yathā duḥkhaṃ na kuryāttvaṃ tathā kuru .. 61 ..
5.212.d: मम माता यथा दुःखं न कुर्यात्त्वं तथा कुरु .. 61 ..
5.212.m: Act in such a way that my mother does not grieve. // 61

5.212.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya vajrapātopamaṃ hariḥ ..
bāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇo dīnastataḥ provāca gadgadam .. 62 ..
5.212.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य वज्रपातोपमं हरिः ..
बाष्पपूर्णेक्षणो दीनस्ततः प्रोवाच गद्गदम् .. 62 ..
5.212.m: Hearing his word, which was like the fall of a thunderbolt, Hari, / his eyes filled with tears, dejected, then spoke with a faltering voice: // 62

5.212.s:
na tvayā kāmataḥ putra kṛtyametadanuṣṭhitam ..
na jñānena kṛtaṃ yasmāttatsmātsvalpaṃ hi pātakam .. 63 ..
5.212.d:
न त्वया कामतः पुत्र कृत्यमेतदनुष्ठितम् ..
न ज्ञानेन कृतं यस्मात्तत्स्मात्स्वल्पं हि पातकम् .. 63 ..
5.212.m: “This act was not performed by you out of lust, O son, / and because it was not done with knowledge, the sin is indeed very small. // 63

5.212.s:
jānatā yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ taccaivākṣayatāṃ vrajet ..
na karoti mahīpālo yadi tasya vinigraham .. 64 ..
5.212.d:
जानता यत्कृतं पापं तच्चैवाक्षयतां व्रजेत् ..
न करोति महीपालो यदि तस्य विनिग्रहम् .. 64 ..
5.212.m: A sin committed knowingly becomes inexhaustible indeed, / if the king does not inflict punishment for it. // 64

5.212.s:
tasmātte kīrtayiṣyāmi prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye ..
dānaṃ caiva mahābhāga yena kuṣṭhaṃ praṇaśyati .. 65 ..
5.212.d:
तस्मात्ते कीर्तयिष्यामि प्रायश्चित्तं विशुद्धये ..
दानं चैव महाभाग येन कुष्ठं प्रणश्यति .. 65 ..
5.212.m: Therefore, I shall proclaim to you the penance for complete purification, / and also the gift, O fortunate one, by which leprosy is destroyed. // 65

5.212.s:
uktāni pratiṣiddhāni punaḥ saṃbhāvitāni ca ..
sāpekṣanirapekṣāṇi munivākyānyaśeṣataḥ .. 66 ..
5.212.d:
उक्तानि प्रतिषिद्धानि पुनः संभावितानि च ..
सापेक्षनिरपेक्षाणि मुनिवाक्यान्यशेषतः .. 66 ..
5.212.m: Enjoined, prohibited, and likewise regarded as suitable, / conditional and unconditional, are the words of the sages without remainder. // 66

5.212.s:
tadatra viṣaye putra mama vākyaṃ samācara ..
bhaviṣyati mahacchreya iha loke paratra ca .. 67 ..
5.212.d:
तदत्र विषये पुत्र मम वाक्यं समाचर ..
भविष्यति महच्छ्रेय इह लोके परत्र च .. 67 ..
5.212.m: Therefore in this matter, O son, follow my word; / great welfare will accrue [to you] in this world and the next. // 67

5.212.s:
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre viśvāmitrapratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
mārtaṇḍo'sti suvikhyātaḥ sarvakuṣṭhavināśakaḥ .. 68 ..
5.212.d:
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे विश्वामित्रप्रतिष्ठितः ..
मार्तण्डोऽस्ति सुविख्यातः सर्वकुष्ठविनाशकः .. 68 ..
5.212.m: In the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, consecrated by Viśvāmitra, / there is the renowned Sun, the destroyer of all leprosy. // 68

5.212.s:
sūryavāreṇa saptamyāṃ saṃprāpte māsi mādhave ..
nakṣatre pitṛdaivatye śuklapakṣe samāgate .. 69 ..
5.212.d:
सूर्यवारेण सप्तम्यां संप्राप्ते मासि माधवे ..
नक्षत्रे पितृदैवत्ये शुक्लपक्षे समागते .. 69 ..
5.212.m: When a Sunday falls on the seventh lunar day in the month of Mādhava, / during the asterism sacred to the ancestors and in the bright fortnight, // 69

5.212.s:
bhāskarasyodaye prāpte śraddhāpūtena cetasā ..
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yāvatkurute ca pradakṣiṇām .. 6.213.70 ..
5.212.d:
भास्करस्योदये प्राप्ते श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा ..
शतमष्टोत्तरं यावत्कुरुते च प्रदक्षिणाम् .. 6.213.70 ..
5.212.m: at the rising of the sun, with a mind purified by faith, / whoever performs one hundred and eight circumambulations, // 70

5.212.s:
phalaiḥ śreṣṭhatamaiścaiva tatpramāṇaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
tasya kuṣṭhaṃ viniryāti sadya eva na saṃśayaḥ .. 71 ..
5.212.d:
फलैः श्रेष्ठतमैश्चैव तत्प्रमाणैः पृथक्पृथक् ..
तस्य कुष्ठं विनिर्याति सद्य एव न संशयः .. 71 ..
5.212.m: along with the finest fruits individually of that same number, / his leprosy departs immediately, without doubt. // 71

5.212.s:
nīrogaḥ kurute yastu ravestasya pradakṣiṇāḥ ..
tāvadyugaṃ pumāneṣa sūryaloke mahīyate .. 72 ..
5.212.d:
नीरोगः कुरुते यस्तु रवेस्तस्य प्रदक्षिणाः ..
तावद्युगं पुमानेष सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 72 ..
5.212.m: A healthy man who performs circumambulations of that sun / is honoured in the realm of the Sun for as many yugas. // 72

5.212.s:
sūryavāreṇa yo martyastasya kṛtvā ṇdakṣiṇām ..
namaskaroti sadbhaktyā so'pi rogaiḥ pramucyate .. 73 ..
5.212.d:
सूर्यवारेण यो मर्त्यस्तस्य कृत्वा ण्दक्षिणाम् ..
नमस्करोति सद्भक्त्या सोऽपि रोगैः प्रमुच्यते .. 73 ..
5.212.m: The mortal who, having circumambulated him on a Sunday, / bows down with true devotion, is also released from diseases. // 73

5.212.s:
tasmāttvaṃ hi mahārāja tamārādhaya bhāskaram ..
devaṃ vai vidhinānena yo mayokto'khilastava .. 74 ..
5.212.d:
तस्मात्त्वं हि महाराज तमाराधय भास्करम् ..
देवं वै विधिनानेन यो मयोक्तोऽखिलस्तव .. 74 ..
5.212.m: Therefore, O great prince, worship that Sun, / the god indeed, by this ritual procedure which has been entirely described by me to you. // 74

5.212.s:
avikalpena manasā samārādhaya satvaram ..
muktaroge vipāpmātha dibyadehamavāpsyasi .. 75..
5.212.d:
अविकल्पेन मनसा समाराधय सत्वरम् ..
मुक्तरोगे विपाप्माथ दिब्यदेहमवाप्स्यसि .. 75..
5.212.m: Worship him swiftly with an unwavering mind; / freed from disease and sinless, you will then obtain a divine body. // 75

5.212.s:
mā kuruṣva viṣādaṃ tvaṃ kuṣṭhavyādhisamudravam ..
tasminkṣetre sthite deve kuharāśrayasaṃjñite .. 76 ..
5.212.d:
मा कुरुष्व विषादं त्वं कुष्ठव्याधिसमुद्रवम् ..
तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे स्थिते देवे कुहराश्रयसंज्ञिते .. 76 ..
5.212.m: Do not indulge in despair arising from the disease of leprosy, / while that god named Kuharāśraya is present in that sacred field.” // 76

5.212.s: atha tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prasthito viṣṇunandanaḥ .. 77 ..
5.212.d: अथ तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रस्थितो विष्णुनन्दनः .. 77 ..
5.212.m: Then, having heard that speech, the son of Viṣṇu departed. // 77

5.212.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etacchrutvā vacastasya devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ..
cakāra gamane buddhiyogaṃ sāṃbo'rbudaṃ prati .. 78 ..
5.212.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः ..
चकार गमने बुद्धियोगं सांबोऽर्बुदं प्रति .. 78 ..
5.212.m: Sūta said: / Hearing this speech of the discus-bearing god of gods, / Sāmba resolved to set out towards Arbuda. // 78

5.212.s:
tataḥ śubhe'hani prāpte hastyaśvarathasaṃyutaḥ ..
pratasthe sa suto viṣṇoḥ senayā parivāritaḥ .. 79 ..
5.212.d:
ततः शुभेऽहनि प्राप्ते हस्त्यश्वरथसंयुतः ..
प्रतस्थे स सुतो विष्णोः सेनया परिवारितः .. 79 ..
5.212.m: Then, when an auspicious day arrived, accompanied by elephants, horses, and chariots, / that son of Viṣṇu departed, surrounded by an army. // 79

5.212.s:
anuyātaḥ sudūraṃ ca kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā ..
bāṣpapūrṇe kṣaṇenaiva sarvamātṛjanena ca .. 6.213.80 ..
5.212.d:
अनुयातः सुदूरं च कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ..
बाष्पपूर्णे क्षणेनैव सर्वमातृजनेन च .. 6.213.80 ..
5.212.m: He was followed for a long distance by Kṛṣṇa of unwearied deeds, / his eyes filled with tears, and by all the mothers, // 80

5.212.s:
balabhadreṇa vīreṇa cārudeṣṇena dhīmatā ..
yuyudhānāniruddhābhyāṃ pradyumnena ca dhīmatā .. 81 ..
5.212.d:
बलभद्रेण वीरेण चारुदेष्णेन धीमता ..
युयुधानानिरुद्धाभ्यां प्रद्युम्नेन च धीमता .. 81 ..
5.212.m: by the heroic Balabhadra, by wise Cārudeṣṇa, / by Yuyudhāna and Aniruddha, and by the wise Pradyumna. // 81

5.212.s:
tato jāṃbavatī putraṃ dṛṣṭvā tīrthonmukhaṃ tadā ..
gacchamānaṃ pracakre'tha pralāpānkurarī yathā .. 82 ..
5.212.d:
ततो जांबवती पुत्रं दृष्ट्वा तीर्थोन्मुखं तदा ..
गच्छमानं प्रचक्रेऽथ प्रलापान्कुररी यथा .. 82 ..
5.212.m: Then Jāmbavatī, seeing her son departing / intent on visiting the sacred ford, wailed like an osprey: // 82

5.212.s:
hā hatāsmi vinaṣṭāsmi maṃdabhāgyā hyabhāginī ..
ekopi tanayo yasyā mamāpyenāṃ daśāṃ gataḥ .. 83 ..
5.212.d:
हा हतास्मि विनष्टास्मि मंदभाग्या ह्यभागिनी ..
एकोपि तनयो यस्या ममाप्येनां दशां गतः .. 83 ..
5.212.m: “Alas, I am undone, I am ruined, unfortunate and ill-fated, / whose only son has also fallen into this condition!” // 83

5.212.s:
atha tāṃ rudatīṃ dṛṣṭvā provāca madhusūdanaḥ ..
kimamaṃgalametasya prasthitasya kariṣyasi ..84..
5.212.d:
अथ तां रुदतीं दृष्ट्वा प्रोवाच मधुसूदनः ..
किममंगलमेतस्य प्रस्थितस्य करिष्यसि ..84..
5.212.m: Then, seeing her weeping, Madhusūdana said: / “Why do you cause an inauspicious omen for him as he departs, // 84

5.212.s:
bāṣpapūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā muktakeśī viśeṣataḥ ..
eṣa vyādhivinirmuktastīrthayātrāphalānvitaḥ ..
kuṣṭhavyādhiparityaktaḥ punareṣyati teṃ'tikam .. 85 ..
5.212.d:
बाष्पपूर्णेक्षणा दीना मुक्तकेशी विशेषतः ..
एष व्याधिविनिर्मुक्तस्तीर्थयात्राफलान्वितः ..
कुष्ठव्याधिपरित्यक्तः पुनरेष्यति तेंऽतिकम् .. 85 ..
5.212.m: with eyes full of tears, wretched, and especially with your hair dishevelled? / Freed from disease, endowed with the fruit of the pilgrimage to sacred fords, / and released from the disease of leprosy, he will return to your presence.” // 85

5.212.s:
etasminnaṃtare yānādavatīrya tvarānvitaḥ ..
sāṃbo'sau prasthitastatra yatra jāṃbavatī sthitā .. 86 ..
5.212.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे यानादवतीर्य त्वरान्वितः ..
सांबोऽसौ प्रस्थितस्तत्र यत्र जांबवती स्थिता .. 86 ..
5.212.m: In the meantime, having descended from his vehicle in haste, / Sāmba went to the place where Jāmbavatī was standing. // 86

5.212.s:
sa tāṃ praṇamya hṛṣṭātmā kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ..
praṇipatya vihasyo ccairvākyametaduvāca ha ..87..
5.212.d:
स तां प्रणम्य हृष्टात्मा कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः ..
प्रणिपत्य विहस्यो च्चैर्वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ..87..
5.212.m: Bowing to her, joyful in spirit, standing with joined palms, / prostrating and smiling warmly, he uttered this speech: // 87

5.212.s:
mā tvaṃ mātarvṛthā duḥkhamasmadarthe kariṣyasi ..
āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ śīghraṃ tīrthayātrāṃ vidhāya vai ..88..
5.212.d:
मा त्वं मातर्वृथा दुःखमस्मदर्थे करिष्यसि ..
आगमिष्याम्यहं शीघ्रं तीर्थयात्रां विधाय वै ..88..
5.212.m: “O Mother, do not grieve in vain on my account; / I shall return swiftly indeed after completing the pilgrimage to sacred fords.” // 88

5.212.s:
.. jāṃbavatyuvāca .. ..
rakṣatu tvāṃ vane vatsa sarvāstā vanadevatāḥ ..
śvāpadebhyaḥ piśācebhyo duṣṭebhyaḥ putra sarvataḥ ..89..
5.212.d:
.. जांबवत्युवाच .. ..
रक्षतु त्वां वने वत्स सर्वास्ता वनदेवताः ..
श्वापदेभ्यः पिशाचेभ्यो दुष्टेभ्यः पुत्र सर्वतः ..89..
5.212.m: Jāmbavatī said: / “May all those forest deities protect you in the forest, my child, / from beasts of prey, Piśācas, and wicked beings on every side, O son! // 89

5.212.s:
śiraste pātu goviṃdaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ ca madhusūdanaḥ ..
bāhudeśaṃ hṛṣīkeśo hṛdayaṃ daityanāśanaḥ ..6.213.90..
5.212.d:
शिरस्ते पातु गोविंदः कण्ठं च मधुसूदनः ..
बाहुदेशं हृषीकेशो हृदयं दैत्यनाशनः ..6.213.90..
5.212.m: May Govinda protect your head, and Madhusūdana your neck; / may Hṛṣīkeśa protect the region of your arms, and the destroyer of Daityas your heart! // 90

5.212.s:
jaṭharaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣaḥ kaṭiṃ pātu gadādharaḥ ..
jānunoryugalaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pādau ca dharaṇīdharaḥ .. 91 ..
5.212.d:
जठरं पुंडरीकाक्षः कटिं पातु गदाधरः ..
जानुनोर्युगलं कृष्णः पादौ च धरणीधरः .. 91 ..
5.212.m: May the lotus-eyed one protect your belly, and the mace-bearer your hips; / may Kṛṣṇa protect both your knees, and the bearer of the earth your feet!” // 91

5.212.s:
evaṃ saṃspṛśya hastena nijenāṃgāni tasya sā..
samāliṃgya samāghrāya mūrdhadeśe muhurmuhuḥ .. 92 ..
5.212.d:
एवं संस्पृश्य हस्तेन निजेनांगानि तस्य सा..
समालिंग्य समाघ्राय मूर्धदेशे मुहुर्मुहुः .. 92 ..
5.212.m: Touching his limbs with her own hand in this manner, / embracing him and smelling him repeatedly upon the crown of his head, // 92

5.212.s:
preṣayāmāsa taṃ putraṃ kṛtarakṣaṃ yaśasvinī ..
sā sarvāṃtaḥpurīyuktā nivṛtā tadanantaram .. 93 ..
5.212.d:
प्रेषयामास तं पुत्रं कृतरक्षं यशस्विनी ..
सा सर्वांतःपुरीयुक्ता निवृता तदनन्तरम् .. 93 ..
5.212.m: that illustrious woman sent forth her son, having performed protection for him. / Accompanied by all the women of the inner apartments, she then turned back, // 93

5.212.s:
aśrupūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā niḥśvasantī yathoragī ..
tathā ca bhagavānviṣṇuryādavaiḥ sakalaiḥ saha .. 94 ..
5.212.d:
अश्रुपूर्णेक्षणा दीना निःश्वसन्ती यथोरगी ..
तथा च भगवान्विष्णुर्यादवैः सकलैः सह .. 94 ..
5.212.m: her eyes filled with tears, dejected, sighing like a female serpent. / Likewise the Lord Viṣṇu, together with all the Yādavas, // 94

5.212.s:
praviṣṭo dvārakāpuryā sāṃbaṃ proṣya tataḥ param..
aśrupūrṇekṣaṇo dīno balabhadrapuraḥsaraḥ .. 95 ..
5.212.d:
प्रविष्टो द्वारकापुर्या सांबं प्रोष्य ततः परम्..
अश्रुपूर्णेक्षणो दीनो बलभद्रपुरःसरः .. 95 ..
5.212.m: entered the city of Dvārakā after seeing Sāmba off on his journey, / his eyes filled with tears, dejected, led by Balabhadra, // 95

5.212.s:
putraiḥ pautraistathā mitrairbāṃdhavairaparairapi ..
dvārakāyā viniṣkramya sāṃbo'pi dvijasattamāḥ .. 96 ..
5.212.d:
पुत्रैः पौत्रैस्तथा मित्रैर्बांधवैरपरैरपि ..
द्वारकाया विनिष्क्रम्य सांबोऽपि द्विजसत्तमाः .. 96 ..
5.212.m: with sons, grandsons, friends, and other kinsmen. / Having departed from Dvārakā, Sāmba too, O best of brahmins, // 96

5.212.s:
saṃprāptaśca krameṇātha siṃdhusāgarasaṃgame ..
yatra yogīśvaraḥ sākṣādaṃbarīṣapratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 97 ..
5.212.d:
संप्राप्तश्च क्रमेणाथ सिंधुसागरसंगमे ..
यत्र योगीश्वरः साक्षादंबरीषप्रतिष्ठितः .. 97 ..
5.212.m: arrived in due course at the confluence of the Sindhu and the ocean, / where Viṣṇu himself, Lord of Yogins, established by Ambarīṣa, // 97

5.212.s:
adyāpi tiṣṭhate viṣṇurjaṃtūnāṃ pāpanāśanaḥ ..
tatra snātvā samabhyarcya devaṃ yogīśvaraṃ tataḥ .. 98 ..
5.212.d:
अद्यापि तिष्ठते विष्णुर्जंतूनां पापनाशनः ..
तत्र स्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य देवं योगीश्वरं ततः .. 98 ..
5.212.m: stands even today, destroying the sins of living beings. / Having bathed there and having worshipped the god, the Lord of Yogins, he then // 98

5.212.s:
dadau dānāni viprebhyo nānārūpāṇi śaktitaḥ ..
dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇebhyaśca tathaivānyebhya eva ca .. 99 ..
5.212.d:
ददौ दानानि विप्रेभ्यो नानारूपाणि शक्तितः ..
दीनांधकृपणेभ्यश्च तथैवान्येभ्य एव च .. 99 ..
5.212.m: distributed various gifts according to his ability to brahmins, / and likewise to the wretched, the blind, the destitute, and others, // 99

5.212.s:
yānāni vastraratnāni yadyacca yena vāṃchitam ..
sa trirātraṃ hareḥ putraḥ sthitvā tatra samāhitaḥ .. 6.213.100 ..
cyavanasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ jagāmātha tataḥ param ..
yatra saṃtiṣṭhate viṣṇuścyavanena pratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 1 ..
siṃdhostaṭe ca puṇye ca sarvapātakanāśanaḥ ..
tatrāpi vipramukhyebhyo dadau dānāni yādavaḥ .. 2
vāṃchitāni yathoktāni śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā ..
tatrāpi saṃyataḥ sāṃba sa sthitvā śraddhayānvitaḥ .. 3 ..
trirātraṃ prajagāmātha snātvā siṃdhūdake śubhe ..
tatastu puṣkarādīni samuddiśya śanaiḥ śanaiḥ .. 4 ..
puṣkarāvāsinaṃ devaṃ dhyāyamāno hyaharniśam ..
tastu puṣkaraṃ prāpya krameṇa yadusattamaḥ ..5..
puṇye kuṇḍajale snātaḥ saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ..
saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa gṛhītvātha phalāni ca ..
gataḥ saṃtiṣṭhate yatra devo vai viṣṇu sūcitaḥ .. 6..
5.212.d:
यानानि वस्त्ररत्नानि यद्यच्च येन वांछितम् ..
स त्रिरात्रं हरेः पुत्रः स्थित्वा तत्र समाहितः .. 6.213.100 ..
च्यवनस्याश्रमं पुण्यं जगामाथ ततः परम् ..
यत्र संतिष्ठते विष्णुश्च्यवनेन प्रतिष्ठितः .. 1 ..
सिंधोस्तटे च पुण्ये च सर्वपातकनाशनः ..
तत्रापि विप्रमुख्येभ्यो ददौ दानानि यादवः .. 2
वांछितानि यथोक्तानि शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा ..
तत्रापि संयतः सांब स स्थित्वा श्रद्धयान्वितः .. 3 ..
त्रिरात्रं प्रजगामाथ स्नात्वा सिंधूदके शुभे ..
ततस्तु पुष्करादीनि समुद्दिश्य शनैः शनैः .. 4 ..
पुष्करावासिनं देवं ध्यायमानो ह्यहर्निशम् ..
तस्तु पुष्करं प्राप्य क्रमेण यदुसत्तमः ..5..
पुण्ये कुण्डजले स्नातः संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः..
सप्तम्यां सूर्यवारेण गृहीत्वाथ फलानि च ..
गतः संतिष्ठते यत्र देवो वै विष्णु सूचितः .. 6..
5.212.m:
vehicles, clothes, jewels, and whatever was desired by anyone. / That son of Hari, having remained there concentrated in mind for three nights, // 100
went thereafter to the holy hermitage of Cyavana, / where Viṣṇu, consecrated by Cyavana, resides // 1
on the holy bank of the Sindhu, destroying all sins. / There too, the descendant of Yadu gave gifts to the foremost brahmins. // 2
[gifts] that were desired, according to the rites seen in the scriptures. / There too, restrained, Sāmba remained, full of faith, 3
for three nights, and then departed after bathing in the auspicious water of the ocean. / Then, directing his steps slowly toward Puṣkara and other [places], 4
meditating day and night upon the god who dwells at Puṣkara, / that best of Yadus gradually reached Puṣkara. 5
Bathing in the sacred water of the pool, having gratified the ancestors and deities, / on the seventh lunar day, on a Sunday, taking fruits, / he went where the god Viṣṇu has been described as staying. 6

5.212.s:
pūjayitvā tato bhaktyā devaṃ kuharavāsinam ..
vastrānulepanairdhūpairnaivedyaistu pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..7..
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāścakre phalahastaḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ ..
prapaṭhansūryagāyatrīṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ .. 8 ..
yathāyathā karotyeṣa ravestasya pradakṣiṇām ..
tathātathā ca saṃyāti tasya kuṣṭhaṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 9 ..
5.212.d:
पूजयित्वा ततो भक्त्या देवं कुहरवासिनम् ..
वस्त्रानुलेपनैर्धूपैर्नैवेद्यैस्तु पृथग्विधैः ..7..
ततः प्रदक्षिणाश्चक्रे फलहस्तः शनैःशनैः ..
प्रपठन्सूर्यगायत्रीं श्रद्धया परया युतः .. 8 ..
यथायथा करोत्येष रवेस्तस्य प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
तथातथा च संयाति तस्य कुष्ठं द्विजोत्तमाः .. 9 ..
5.212.m:
Having then worshipped with devotion the god who dwells in the cave / with garments, unguents, incenses, and various kinds of food-offerings, 7
he slowly made circumambulations with fruit in his hand, / reciting the Sūryagāyatrī, endowed with supreme faith. 8
Just as he performed the circumambulation of that Sun, / so too his leprosy departed, O best of brahmins! 9

5.212.s:
tatra kṣaṇe'bhavattasya citte sāṃbasya dhīmataḥ ..
mukto'haṃ kuṣṭharogeṇa nirvikalpaṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 6.213.110 ..
tataśca sahitaṃ tena yatkiṃcittatra cāgatam ..
hastyaśvaratharatnāḍhyaṃ tatsarvaṃ bhaktipūrvakam .. 11 ..
nāgarāṇāṃ dadau sarvaṃ tathānyadgrāmapaṃcakam ..
sāṃbā''dityaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tataḥ saṃprasthito gṛham .. 12 ..
kiṃcidurvaritaṃ yacca tatsarvaṃ bhaktisaṃyutam ..
pradadau sūryaviprebhyaḥ pūjayitvā divākaram .. 13 ..
aṣṭau vājisahasrāṇi nāgānāṃ ca śatatrayam ..
rathānāṃ ṣaṭśatānyeva aśvairyuktāni vājibhiḥ ..
anaṃtāni ca ratnāni dattvā sāṃbo gṛhaṃ gataḥ .. 14
ya etatpaṭhate bhaktyā sāṃbākhyānamanuttamam ..
śṛṇoti vā'nvaye tasya na kuṣṭhaṃ saṃprajāyate .. 15 ..
5.212.d:
तत्र क्षणेऽभवत्तस्य चित्ते सांबस्य धीमतः ..
मुक्तोऽहं कुष्ठरोगेण निर्विकल्पं द्विजोत्तमाः .. 6.213.110 ..
ततश्च सहितं तेन यत्किंचित्तत्र चागतम् ..
हस्त्यश्वरथरत्नाढ्यं तत्सर्वं भक्तिपूर्वकम् .. 11 ..
नागराणां ददौ सर्वं तथान्यद्ग्रामपंचकम् ..
सांबा'ऽदित्यं प्रतिष्ठाप्य ततः संप्रस्थितो गृहम् .. 12 ..
किंचिदुर्वरितं यच्च तत्सर्वं भक्तिसंयुतम् ..
प्रददौ सूर्यविप्रेभ्यः पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम् .. 13 ..
अष्टौ वाजिसहस्राणि नागानां च शतत्रयम् ..
रथानां षट्शतान्येव अश्वैर्युक्तानि वाजिभिः ..
अनंतानि च रत्नानि दत्त्वा सांबो गृहं गतः .. 14
य एतत्पठते भक्त्या सांबाख्यानमनुत्तमम् ..
शृणोति वाऽन्वये तस्य न कुष्ठं संप्रजायते .. 15 ..
5.212.m:
At that moment, in the mind of the wise Sāmba [the thought] arose: / "I am freed from the disease of leprosy beyond doubt, O best of brahmins!" 10
Then, whatever he had brought with him there, / rich with elephants, horses, chariots, and jewels, all that, preceded by devotion, 11
he gave to the Nāgaras, as well as another five villages. / Having installed Sāmbāditya, he then departed for home. 12
Whatever little remained, all that, accompanied by devotion, / he gave to the brahmins devoted to the Sun, having worshipped the Maker of Day. 13
Eight thousand horses, three hundred elephants, / six hundred chariots yoked with swift horses, / and endless jewels Sāmba gave, and returned home. 14
Whoever recites with devotion this peerless narrative of Sāmba / or hears it, in his lineage leprosy does not arise. 15

5.212.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ viśvāmitrīyamuttamam ..
caturthaṃ ca puṇyatīrthaṃ strīṇāṃ caiva śubhāvaham .. 116 ..
5.212.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं विश्वामित्रीयमुत्तमम् ..
चतुर्थं च पुण्यतीर्थं स्त्रीणां चैव शुभावहम् .. 116 ..
5.212.m: Sūta said: / All this has been narrated to you regarding the excellent Viśvāmitrīya, / the fourth sacred ford, which brings auspiciousness to women. 16

5.212.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye viśvāmitrīyamāhātmye kuharavāsisāṃbādityaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 213 ..
5.212.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये विश्वामित्रीयमाहात्म्ये कुहरवासिसांबादित्यप्रभाववर्णनंनाम त्रयोदशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 213 ..
5.212.m: Thus ends the two hundred and thirteenth chapter, titled "Description of the Majesty of Kuharavāsi-Sāmbāditya," in the Viśvāmitrīyamāhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 213

5.213.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānyopi ca tatrāsti viśvāmitrapratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
gaṇanātho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvasiddhiprado nṛṇām .. 1 ..
5.213.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्योपि च तत्रास्ति विश्वामित्रप्रतिष्ठितः ..
गणनाथो द्विजश्रेष्ठाः सर्वसिद्धिप्रदो नृणाम् .. 1 ..
5.213.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, there is another Gaṇanātha installed there by Viśvāmitra, / O best of brahmins, who grants all perfections to mortals. 1

5.213.s:
māghamāse caturthyāṃ ca śuklāyāṃ pūjayettu yaḥ ..
sa ca saṃvatsaraṃ yāvatsarvai vighnairvimucyate o. 2 ..
5.213.d:
माघमासे चतुर्थ्यां च शुक्लायां पूजयेत्तु यः ..
स च संवत्सरं यावत्सर्वै विघ्नैर्विमुच्यते ओ. 2 ..
5.213.m: Whoever worships him on the fourth lunar day of the bright fortnight of the month of Māgha / is freed from all obstacles for a year. 2

5.213.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
gaṇanāthasya cotpattiṃ sāṃprataṃ sūta no vada ..
kathameṣa samutpannaḥ kiṃ māhātmyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 3 .. ..
5.213.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
गणनाथस्य चोत्पत्तिं सांप्रतं सूत नो वद ..
कथमेष समुत्पन्नः किं माहात्म्यः प्रकीर्तितः .. 3 .. ..
5.213.m: The seers said: / Now tell us, Sūta, the origin of Gaṇanātha: / how he was born, and what majesty is proclaimed of him. 3

5.213.s:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
eṣa cotpādito gauryā nijāṃgamalataḥ svayam ..
krīḍārthaṃ mānuṣairaṃgairmātaṃgānanaśobhitaḥ ..4..
5.213.d:
..सूत उवाच .. ..
एष चोत्पादितो गौर्या निजांगमलतः स्वयम् ..
क्रीडार्थं मानुषैरंगैर्मातंगाननशोभितः ..4..
5.213.m: Sūta said: / He was produced by Gaurī herself from the dirt of her own body / for sport, with human limbs and adorned with an elephant face, 4

5.213.s:
caturhastasamopeta ākhuvāhanagastathā ..
kuṭhārahastaśca tathā modakāśanatoṣakṛt .. 5 ..
5.213.d:
चतुर्हस्तसमोपेत आखुवाहनगस्तथा ..
कुठारहस्तश्च तथा मोदकाशनतोषकृत् .. 5 ..
5.213.m: endowed with four arms, mounted upon a rat as vehicle, / holding an axe in his hand, and rejoicing in eating sweetmeats; 5

5.213.s:
sarvasiddhiprado loke bhaktānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
eṣa pūrvaṃ prabhoḥ kārye saṃgrāme tārakāmaye ..6...
5.213.d:
सर्वसिद्धिप्रदो लोके भक्तानां च विशेषतः ..
एष पूर्वं प्रभोः कार्ये संग्रामे तारकामये ..6...
5.213.m: he bestows all perfections in the world, especially to his devotees. / Formerly, in the battle caused by Tāraka, for the Lord's purpose, 6

5.213.s:
saṃgrāmamakarodraudraṃ na kṛtaṃ yacca kenacit ..
nihatā dānavāḥ sarve saṃkhyayā parivarjitāḥ .. 7 ..
5.213.d:
संग्राममकरोद्रौद्रं न कृतं यच्च केनचित् ..
निहता दानवाः सर्वे संख्यया परिवर्जिताः .. 7 ..
5.213.m: he fought a fierce battle, such as had never been fought by anyone. / All the Dānavas were slain without number. 7

5.213.s:
tataḥ śakreṇa tuṣṭena proktaḥ saṃgrāmabhūmipaḥ ..
kṣata vikṣatasarvāṃgo rudhireṇa pariplutaḥ .. 8 ..
5.213.d:
ततः शक्रेण तुष्टेन प्रोक्तः संग्रामभूमिपः ..
क्षत विक्षतसर्वांगो रुधिरेण परिप्लुतः .. 8 ..
5.213.m: Then, being pleased, Śakra spoke to him, the lord of the battlefield, / whose limbs were all pierced and wounded, drenched with blood: 8

5.213.s:
asmadarthe tvayā yuddhaṃ yatkṛtaṃ sugajānana ..
nihatā dānavāḥ sarve saṃkhyayā parivarjitāḥ ..9..
5.213.d:
अस्मदर्थे त्वया युद्धं यत्कृतं सुगजानन ..
निहता दानवाः सर्वे संख्यया परिवर्जिताः ..9..
5.213.m: "Since you fought this battle for our sake, O auspicious Elephant-faced One, / and all the Dānavas have been slain without number, 9

5.213.s:
tasmāttvaṃ sarvadevānāmapi pūjyo bhaviṣyasi ..
kiṃpunarmānuṣāṇāṃ ca ye nityaṃ vighnasaṃplutāḥ .. 6.214.10 ..
5.213.d:
तस्मात्त्वं सर्वदेवानामपि पूज्यो भविष्यसि ..
किंपुनर्मानुषाणां च ये नित्यं विघ्नसंप्लुताः .. 6.214.10 ..
5.213.m: therefore you shall be worthy of worship even by all the gods, / how much more so by mortals, who are constantly overcome by obstacles! 10

5.213.s:
ye tvāṃ saṃpūjayiṣyaṃti kāryāraṃbheṣu sarvataḥ ..
kāryasiddhirna saṃdehasteṣāṃ bhūyādgirā mama .. 11 ..
5.213.d:
ये त्वां संपूजयिष्यंति कार्यारंभेषु सर्वतः ..
कार्यसिद्धिर्न संदेहस्तेषां भूयाद्गिरा मम .. 11 ..
5.213.m: Whoever worships you everywhere at the commencement of undertakings, / their undertaking shall succeed—there is no doubt—by my word!" 11

5.213.s:
evamuktvā sahasrākṣo visasarjātha taṃ tadā ..
saṃmānya bahumānena gaurīśaṃkarapārśvataḥ .. 12 ..
5.213.d:
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षो विससर्जाथ तं तदा ..
संमान्य बहुमानेन गौरीशंकरपार्श्वतः .. 12 ..
5.213.m: Having spoken thus, the Thousand-eyed One then dismissed him, / honoring him with great respect, by the side of Gaurī and Śaṃkara. 12

5.213.s:
ayamarthaḥ purā pṛṣṭo rohitāśvena dhīmatā ..
sarvavipravināśārthaṃ mārkaṃḍeyaṃ mahāmunim .. 13 ..
5.213.d:
अयमर्थः पुरा पृष्टो रोहिताश्वेन धीमता ..
सर्वविप्रविनाशार्थं मार्कंडेयं महामुनिम् .. 13 ..
5.213.m: This matter was asked long ago by the wise Rohitāśva / to the great sage Mārkaṇḍeya, for the removal of all brahmins' [affliction]. 13

5.213.s:
tamevārthaṃ mahābhāgāḥ kathayiṣye yathārthataḥ ..
tacchṛṇudhvaṃ purāvṛttaṃ sarvaṃ sarve samāhitāḥ .. 14 ..
5.213.d:
तमेवार्थं महाभागाः कथयिष्ये यथार्थतः ..
तच्छृणुध्वं पुरावृत्तं सर्वं सर्वे समाहिताः .. 14 ..
5.213.m: I shall narrate that very matter to you truthfully, O fortunate ones; / listen attentively to all of that ancient event. 14

5.213.s:
.. rohitāśva uvāca .. ..
bhagavannatra ye martyāḥ sarve vighnasamanvitāḥ ..
śubhakṛtyeṣu sarveṣu jāyaṃte śucayo'pi ca .. .. 15 ..
5.213.d:
.. रोहिताश्व उवाच .. ..
भगवन्नत्र ये मर्त्याः सर्वे विघ्नसमन्विताः ..
शुभकृत्येषु सर्वेषु जायंते शुचयोऽपि च .. .. 15 ..
5.213.m: Rohitāśva said: / O Blessed One, here all mortals, even when pure, / are beset with obstacles in all auspicious actions. 15

5.213.s:
prārabdheṣu ca kāryeṣu dharmajeṣu viśeṣataḥ ..
tāni vighnāni jāyante yaistatkāryaṃ na sidhyati .. 16 ..
5.213.d:
प्रारब्धेषु च कार्येषु धर्मजेषु विशेषतः ..
तानि विघ्नानि जायन्ते यैस्तत्कार्यं न सिध्यति .. 16 ..
5.213.m: And when undertakings are begun, especially those born of dharma, / such obstacles arise by which that undertaking does not succeed. 16

5.213.s:
tasmādvighnavināśāya kiṃcinme vratamā diśa ..
vrataṃ vā niyamo vā'tha tapo vā dānameva ca .. 17 ..
5.213.d:
तस्माद्विघ्नविनाशाय किंचिन्मे व्रतमा दिश ..
व्रतं वा नियमो वाऽथ तपो वा दानमेव च .. 17 ..
5.213.m: Therefore, prescribe to me some vow for the destruction of obstacles— / whether a vow, an observance, an austerity, or a gift— 17

5.213.s:
sakṛccīrṇena yenātra yāvajjīvati mānavaḥ ..
tāvanna jāyate vighnamājanmamaraṇāṃtikam .. .. 18 ..
5.213.d:
सकृच्चीर्णेन येनात्र यावज्जीवति मानवः ..
तावन्न जायते विघ्नमाजन्ममरणांतिकम् .. .. 18 ..
5.213.m: by which, performed only once here, as long as a person lives, / no obstacle will arise from birth until death. 18

5.213.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
atra te kīrtayiṣyāmi sarvavighnavināśanam ..
vrataṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
viśvāmitreṇa sañcīrṇaṃ yatpurā bhāvitātmanā .. 19 ..
5.213.d:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
अत्र ते कीर्तयिष्यामि सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम् ..
व्रतं सर्वगुणोपेतं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
विश्वामित्रेण सञ्चीर्णं यत्पुरा भावितात्मना .. 19 ..
5.213.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Here I shall describe to you a vow that destroys all obstacles, / endowed with all virtues, destroying all sins, / which was formerly observed by the contemplative Viśvāmitra. 19

5.213.s:
viśvāmitra iti khyāto gādhiputraḥ pratāpavān ..
vasiṣṭhena samaṃ tasya vairamāsīnmahātmanaḥ .. 6.214.20 ..
5.213.d:
विश्वामित्र इति ख्यातो गाधिपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ..
वसिष्ठेन समं तस्य वैरमासीन्महात्मनः .. 6.214.20 ..
5.213.m: The glorious son of Gādhi was known as Viśvāmitra; / he had an enmity with the great-souled Vasiṣṭha. 20

5.213.s:
brāhmaṇyārthe na samproktaḥ kathaṃcitsa mahātapāḥ ..
brāhmaṇastvaṃ vasiṣṭhena tato vairamajāyata .. 21 ..
5.213.d:
ब्राह्मण्यार्थे न सम्प्रोक्तः कथंचित्स महातपाः ..
ब्राह्मणस्त्वं वसिष्ठेन ततो वैरमजायत .. 21 ..
5.213.m: Though of great austerities, he was never addressed by Vasiṣṭha / for the sake of brahminhood, as "You are a brahmin." Thence enmity arose. 21

5.213.s:
.. rohitāśva uvāca .. ..
kasmānna proktavānvipro vasiṣṭhastu kathaṃcana ..
brāhmaṇaḥ sa paraṃ proktobrahmādibhirapi svayam.. 22 ..
5.213.d:
.. रोहिताश्व उवाच .. ..
कस्मान्न प्रोक्तवान्विप्रो वसिष्ठस्तु कथंचन ..
ब्राह्मणः स परं प्रोक्तोब्रह्मादिभिरपि स्वयम्.. 22 ..
5.213.m: Rohitāśva said: / Why did the brahmin Vasiṣṭha not address him [as such] at all, / whereas he was proclaimed a supreme brahmin even by Brahmā and the others themselves? 22

5.213.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
kṣatriyaśca sthitaḥ pūrvaṃ viśvāmitro mahīpatiḥ ..
mṛgayāsu paribhrāṃto vasiṣṭhasya tadā''śramam..
praviṣṭaḥ kṣutpipāsārttaḥ sa tenātha prapūjitaḥ .. 23 ..
5.213.d:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
क्षत्रियश्च स्थितः पूर्वं विश्वामित्रो महीपतिः ..
मृगयासु परिभ्रांतो वसिष्ठस्य तदा'ऽश्रमम्..
प्रविष्टः क्षुत्पिपासार्त्तः स तेनाथ प्रपूजितः .. 23 ..
5.213.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Formerly, King Viśvāmitra was a kṣatriya. / Roaming about on hunting expeditions, he then entered the hermitage of Vasiṣṭha, / afflicted with hunger and thirst, and was hospitably honored by him. 23

5.213.s:
tasyāsīnnandinīnāma dhenuḥ kāmadughā sadā ..
sā sūte vāñchitaṃ sadyo yadvasiṣṭho'bhivāñchati .. 24 ..
5.213.d:
तस्यासीन्नन्दिनीनाम धेनुः कामदुघा सदा ..
सा सूते वाञ्छितं सद्यो यद्वसिष्ठोऽभिवाञ्छति .. 24 ..
5.213.m: He possessed a cow named Nandinī, who always granted all desires; / she would instantly yield whatever Vasiṣṭha desired. 24

5.213.s:
tatprabhāvātsa bhūpālaḥ sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ ..
tena tṛptiparā nīto miṣṭānnairvividhaistataḥ .. .. 25 ..
5.213.d:
तत्प्रभावात्स भूपालः सभृत्यबलवाहनः ..
तेन तृप्तिपरा नीतो मिष्टान्नैर्विविधैस्ततः .. .. 25 ..
5.213.m: By her power, that king, together with his servants, army, and mounts, / was then brought to supreme satisfaction by him with various sweet foods. (25)

5.213.s:
pārthivo'yamiti jñātvā hyarghyādyairbhojanaiḥ sa ca ..
so'pi dṛṣṭvā prabhāvaṃ taṃ sarvaṃ dhenośca saṃbhavam ..
prārthayāmāsa tāṃ mūlyairgajavājisamu dbhavaiḥ .. 26 ..
5.213.d:
पार्थिवोऽयमिति ज्ञात्वा ह्यर्घ्याद्यैर्भोजनैः स च ..
सोऽपि दृष्ट्वा प्रभावं तं सर्वं धेनोश्च संभवम् ..
प्रार्थयामास तां मूल्यैर्गजवाजिसमु द्भवैः .. 26 ..
5.213.m: Knowing, "This is a king," he [honored him] with guest-water and meals; / and he too, seeing that power and that all of it arose from the cow, / begged for her in exchange for prices consisting of elephants and horses. (26)

5.213.s:
na dadau sa tadā vipraḥ sāmnā dānena vā punaḥ ..
bhedena ca tato daṇḍaṃ yojayāmāsa vai nṛpaḥ .. 27 ..
5.213.d:
न ददौ स तदा विप्रः साम्ना दानेन वा पुनः ..
भेदेन च ततो दण्डं योजयामास वै नृपः .. 27 ..
5.213.m: The brahmin did not give [her] up then by conciliation or by gift; / nor by division; therefore the king resorted to force. (27)

5.213.s: kālayāmāsa tāṃ dhenuṃ tataḥ kopātsa pārthivaḥ .. 28 ..
5.213.d: कालयामास तां धेनुं ततः कोपात्स पार्थिवः .. 28 ..
5.213.m: Then out of anger, that king drove that cow away. (28)

5.213.s:
sā'bravīnnīyamānā'tha vasiṣṭhaṃ kiṃ tvayā vibho ..
dattāhamasya nṛpateryanmāṃ nayati yatnataḥ .. 29 ..
5.213.d:
साऽब्रवीन्नीयमानाऽथ वसिष्ठं किं त्वया विभो ..
दत्ताहमस्य नृपतेर्यन्मां नयति यत्नतः .. 29 ..
5.213.m: Being led away, she then said to Vasiṣṭha: "O lord, / have I been given by you to this king, since he leads me away by force?" (29)

5.213.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
na mayā tvaṃ mahābhāge dattā cāsya mahīpateḥ ..
balānnayati yadyeṣa tasmādyuktaṃ samācara .. 6.214.30 ..
5.213.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
न मया त्वं महाभागे दत्ता चास्य महीपतेः ..
बलान्नयति यद्येष तस्माद्युक्तं समाचर .. 6.214.30 ..
5.213.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / "You have not been given by me to this king, O fortunate one. / If he takes you by force, do therefore what is fitting." (30)

5.213.s:
tacchrutvā kopasaṃyuktā nandinī dhenuruttamā ..
jṛṃbhāṃ cakāra tatsainyaṃ samuddiśya nṛpodbhavam .. 31 ..
5.213.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा कोपसंयुक्ता नन्दिनी धेनुरुत्तमा ..
जृंभां चकार तत्सैन्यं समुद्दिश्य नृपोद्भवम् .. 31 ..
5.213.m: Hearing that, Nandinī, the excellent cow, filled with rage, / yawned, directing herself toward the army belonging to that king. (31)

5.213.s:
dhūmāvartistato jātā tasyā vaktrāttataḥ param ..
tato jvālā mahāraudrāstato yodhāḥ sahasraśaḥ .. 32 ..
5.213.d:
धूमावर्तिस्ततो जाता तस्या वक्त्रात्ततः परम् ..
ततो ज्वाला महारौद्रास्ततो योधाः सहस्रशः .. 32 ..
5.213.m: Thereupon a swirl of smoke arose from her mouth, and after that, / a fiercely terrible flame, and from that thousands of warriors, (32)

5.213.s:
nānāśastradharā raudrā yamadūtā yathā ca te ..
pulindā barbarābhīrāḥ kirātā yavanāḥ śakāḥ .. .. 33 ..
5.213.d:
नानाशस्त्रधरा रौद्रा यमदूता यथा च ते ..
पुलिन्दा बर्बराभीराः किराता यवनाः शकाः .. .. 33 ..
5.213.m: bearing various weapons, terrifying like the messengers of Yama— / Pulindas, Barbaras, Ābhīras, Kirātas, Yavanas, and Śakas. (33)

5.213.s: te procustāṃ vadāsmākaṃ kasmātsṛṣṭā vayaṃ śubhe .. 34 ..
5.213.d: ते प्रोचुस्तां वदास्माकं कस्मात्सृष्टा वयं शुभे .. 34 ..
5.213.m: They said to her: "Tell us, O auspicious one, why have we been created?" (34)

5.213.s:
.. nandinyuvāca .. ..
ete māṃ ye balātpāpā nayaṃti nṛpasevakāḥ ..
tānnighnantu samādeśānnānyadvāṃchāmi kiṃcana .. 35 ..
5.213.d:
.. नन्दिन्युवाच .. ..
एते मां ये बलात्पापा नयंति नृपसेवकाः ..
तान्निघ्नन्तु समादेशान्नान्यद्वांछामि किंचन .. 35 ..
5.213.m: Nandinī said: / "These sinful servants of the king who take me by force— / strike them down by my command! I desire nothing else." (35)

5.213.s:
tatastaistasya tatsainyaṃ viśvāmitrasya sūditam ..
yudhyamānaṃ mahārāja daśarātreṇa saṃyuge .. 36 ..
5.213.d:
ततस्तैस्तस्य तत्सैन्यं विश्वामित्रस्य सूदितम् ..
युध्यमानं महाराज दशरात्रेण संयुगे .. 36 ..
5.213.m: Then that army of Viśvāmitra was slain by them, / fighting in battle over ten nights, O great king. (36)

5.213.s:
viśvāmitro'pi taddṛṣṭvā brāhmyaṃ balamanuttamam ..
pratijñāmakarottatra tāreṇa susvareṇa ca .. 37 ..
5.213.d:
विश्वामित्रोऽपि तद्दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्म्यं बलमनुत्तमम् ..
प्रतिज्ञामकरोत्तत्र तारेण सुस्वरेण च .. 37 ..
5.213.m: Viśvāmitra too, seeing that unsurpassed power of a brahmin, / made a vow there with a loud, clear voice: (37)

5.213.s:
athāhaṃ saṃbhaviṣyāmi brāhmaṇo nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
mamāpi jāyate yena prabhāvaścedṛśo'dbhutaḥ .. 38 ..
5.213.d:
अथाहं संभविष्यामि ब्राह्मणो नात्र संशयः ..
ममापि जायते येन प्रभावश्चेदृशोऽद्भुतः .. 38 ..
5.213.m: "Now I will become a brahmin, there is no doubt in this, / so that such wondrous power may arise for me as well. (38)

5.213.s:
tasmāttapaḥ kariṣyāmi yadasādhyaṃ surairapi ..
svaputraṃ sve pade dhṛtvā tataścakre tapo mahat .. 39 ..
5.213.d:
तस्मात्तपः करिष्यामि यदसाध्यं सुरैरपि ..
स्वपुत्रं स्वे पदे धृत्वा ततश्चक्रे तपो महत् .. 39 ..
5.213.m: Therefore I will perform austerity which is unachievable even by the gods." / Having placed his own son in his own position, he then undertook great austerity. (39)

5.213.s:
brāhmaṇyārthaṃ mahāraudraṃ sumahadduṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ..
brāhmaṇyaṃ tena naivāptaṃ vailakṣyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 6.214.40 ..
5.213.d:
ब्राह्मण्यार्थं महारौद्रं सुमहद्दुष्करं तपः ..
ब्राह्मण्यं तेन नैवाप्तं वैलक्ष्यं परमं गतः .. 6.214.40 ..
5.213.m: For the sake of brahminhood, [he performed] extremely terrible, immense, and arduous austerity. / He did not attain brahminhood by that, [and] fell into supreme dejection. (40)

5.213.s:
tataḥ kailāsamāsādya devadevaṃ maheśvaram ..
samyagārādhayāmāsa gaurīyuktaṃ maheśvaram .. 41 ..
5.213.d:
ततः कैलासमासाद्य देवदेवं महेश्वरम् ..
सम्यगाराधयामास गौरीयुक्तं महेश्वरम् .. 41 ..
5.213.m: Then, having reached Kailāsa, he properly propitiated / the god of gods, Maheśvara, the Great Lord joined with Gaurī. (41)

5.213.s:
ahaṃ tapaḥ kariṣyāmi brāhmaṇyasya kṛte prabho ..
tvadīye parvataśreṣṭhe kailāse śaraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 42 ..
5.213.d:
अहं तपः करिष्यामि ब्राह्मण्यस्य कृते प्रभो ..
त्वदीये पर्वतश्रेष्ठे कैलासे शरणं गतः .. 42 ..
5.213.m: "I will perform austerity for the sake of brahminhood, O Lord, / having taken refuge on your foremost mountain, Kailāsa. (42)

5.213.s:
tasmādvighnasya me rakṣāṃ devadevaḥ prayacchatu ..
yathā no nāśamāyāti tapaḥ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ mahat .. 43 ..
5.213.d:
तस्माद्विघ्नस्य मे रक्षां देवदेवः प्रयच्छतु ..
यथा नो नाशमायाति तपः सर्वं कृतं महत् .. 43 ..
5.213.m: Therefore let the god of gods grant me protection from obstacle, / so that all this great austerity performed by us does not go to ruin." (43)

5.213.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
śuddhyarthaṃ caiva yatkāryaṃ kāryesminnṛpasattama ..
vināyakasamudbhūtāṃ tattvaṃ pūjāṃ samācara .. 44 ..
5.213.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
शुद्ध्यर्थं चैव यत्कार्यं कार्येस्मिन्नृपसत्तम ..
विनायकसमुद्भूतां तत्त्वं पूजां समाचर .. 44 ..
5.213.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "O best of kings, for purification and whatever task is to be done in this matter, / perform that worship which is dedicated to Vināyaka, (44)

5.213.s: yena te jāyate siddhiḥ samyagbrāhmaṇyasaṃbhavā.. 45 .. ..
5.213.d: येन ते जायते सिद्धिः सम्यग्ब्राह्मण्यसंभवा.. 45 .. ..
5.213.m: by which your attainment arising from brahminhood will properly come to be." (45)

5.213.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
tadvadasva suraśreṣṭha tathā tasya karomyaham ..
pūrvaṃ pūjāṃ gaṇeśasya sarvavighnapraśāntaye .. 46 ..
5.213.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
तद्वदस्व सुरश्रेष्ठ तथा तस्य करोम्यहम् ..
पूर्वं पूजां गणेशस्य सर्वविघ्नप्रशान्तये .. 46 ..
5.213.m: Viśvāmitra said: / "Tell that, O best of gods, so that I may perform / the prior worship of Gaṇeśa for the pacification of all obstacles." (46)

5.213.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
eṣa gauryā purā kṛtvā nijāṃgodvartanaṃ kṛtaḥ ..
nirmalena kṛtaḥ paścānnarākāraścaturbhujaḥ .. 47 ..
5.213.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
एष गौर्या पुरा कृत्वा निजांगोद्वर्तनं कृतः ..
निर्मलेन कृतः पश्चान्नराकारश्चतुर्भुजः .. 47 ..
5.213.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "Formerly, having prepared unguent for her own limbs, Gaurī made him; / from the pure [paste] he was afterward made human-shaped, four-armed. (47)

5.213.s:
krīḍārthaṃ mama putro'yaṃ bālabhāvaḥ prakalpitaḥ ..
gajavaktro mahākāyo laṃbodaralaghūrukaḥ .. 4- ..
tato'hamanayā proktaḥ sajīvaḥ kriyatāmayam ..
putrako me yathā bhāvī loke pūjya tamo vibho .. 49 ..
5.213.d:
क्रीडार्थं मम पुत्रोऽयं बालभावः प्रकल्पितः ..
गजवक्त्रो महाकायो लंबोदरलघूरुकः .. 4- ..
ततोऽहमनया प्रोक्तः सजीवः क्रियतामयम् ..
पुत्रको मे यथा भावी लोके पूज्य तमो विभो .. 49 ..
5.213.m: For sport, this son of mine was fashioned in childhood form: / elephant-faced, huge-bodied, pot-bellied, with short thighs. / Then I was told by her: 'Let this one be brought to life, / so that my little son may become most worthy of worship in the world, O Lord.' (48–49)

5.213.s:
tato mayāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ sṛṣṭisūktena pārthiva ..
jīvasūktena samyaksa prāṇavānsamajāyata .. 6.214.50 ..
5.213.d:
ततो मयापि संस्पृष्टः सृष्टिसूक्तेन पार्थिव ..
जीवसूक्तेन सम्यक्स प्राणवान्समजायत .. 6.214.50 ..
5.213.m: Then, O king, he was touched by me with the hymn of creation, / [and] with the hymn of life he properly became endowed with breath. (50)

5.213.s:
tato mayā prahṛṣṭena proktā devī himādrijā ..
caturthīdivase prāpte mayā'dyāyaṃ vinirmitaḥ .. 51 ..
5.213.d:
ततो मया प्रहृष्टेन प्रोक्ता देवी हिमाद्रिजा ..
चतुर्थीदिवसे प्राप्ते मयाऽद्यायं विनिर्मितः .. 51 ..
5.213.m: Then, delighted, I said to the goddess born of the Himālaya: / 'When the fourth day arrived, this one was fashioned by me today, (51)

5.213.s:
putrastava mahābhāge jīvasūktaprabhāvataḥ ..
eṣa sarvāgaṇānāṃ ca madīyānāṃ sureśvari ..
bhaviṣyati sadā'dhyakṣa stasmācca gaṇanāyakaḥ .. 52 ..
5.213.d:
पुत्रस्तव महाभागे जीवसूक्तप्रभावतः ..
एष सर्वागणानां च मदीयानां सुरेश्वरि ..
भविष्यति सदाऽध्यक्ष स्तस्माच्च गणनायकः .. 52 ..
5.213.m: as your son, O fortunate one, by the power of the hymn of life. / And he shall always be the leader of all my hosts, O queen of gods; / therefore, [he is] Gaṇanāyaka. (52)

5.213.s:
paṭhyamānena yaścainaṃ jīvasūktena sundari ..
pūjayiṣyati sadbhaktyā caturthīdivase śubhe .. 53 ..
5.213.d:
पठ्यमानेन यश्चैनं जीवसूक्तेन सुन्दरि ..
पूजयिष्यति सद्भक्त्या चतुर्थीदिवसे शुभे .. 53 ..
5.213.m: And whoever, reciting the hymn of life, O beautiful one, / shall worship him with true devotion on the auspicious fourth day, (53)

5.213.s:
tasya sarveṣu kṛtyeṣu sarvavighrāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
prayāsyaṃti kṣayaṃ devi tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā .. 54 ..
5.213.d:
तस्य सर्वेषु कृत्येषु सर्वविघ्रानि कृत्स्नशः ..
प्रयास्यंति क्षयं देवि तमः सूर्योदये यथा .. 54 ..
5.213.m: for him, in all undertakings, all obstacles entirely / will perish, O goddess, just as darkness does at sunrise.' (54)

5.213.s:
namo laṃbodarāyeti namo gaṇavibho tathā ..
kuṭhāradhāriṇe nityaṃ tathā vāksaṃgatāya ca .. 55 ..
5.213.d:
नमो लंबोदरायेति नमो गणविभो तथा ..
कुठारधारिणे नित्यं तथा वाक्संगताय च .. 55 ..
5.213.m: "Salutations to the Pot-Bellied One; and likewise salutations to the Lord of Hosts, / always to the Bearer of the Axe, and likewise to the One joined with Speech; (55)

5.213.s: namo modakabhakṣāya namo dantaikadhāriṇe .. 56 ..
5.213.d: नमो मोदकभक्षाय नमो दन्तैकधारिणे .. 56 ..
5.213.m: salutations to the Eater of Sweetmeats; salutations to the Bearer of a Single Tusk." (56)

5.213.s:
ebhirmantraiḥ samabhyarcya paścānmoda kajaṃśubham ..
naivedyaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ tataścārghyaṃ nivedayet .. 57 [.
ahaṃ karma kariṣyāmi yatkicicchaṃbhusaṃbhavam ..
avighnaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ sarvadaiva tvayā vibho .. 58 ..
5.213.d:
एभिर्मन्त्रैः समभ्यर्च्य पश्चान्मोद कजंशुभम् ..
नैवेद्यं च प्रदातव्यं ततश्चार्घ्यं निवेदयेत् .. 57 [.
अहं कर्म करिष्यामि यत्किचिच्छंभुसंभवम् ..
अविघ्नं तत्र कर्तव्यं सर्वदैव त्वया विभो .. 58 ..
5.213.m: Having worshipped with these mantras, an auspicious offering of sweetmeats / is then to be given, and then one should offer the guest-water: / "Whatever work I shall undertake arising from Śambhu, / let it always be made free of obstacles by you there, O Lord." (57–58)

5.213.s:
tatastu brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanaṃ modakodbhavam ..
yathāśaktyā pradātavyaṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet .. 59 ..
5.213.d:
ततस्तु ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनं मोदकोद्भवम् ..
यथाशक्त्या प्रदातव्यं वित्तशाठ्यं विवर्जयेत् .. 59 ..
5.213.m: Then a meal of sweetmeats is to be given / to brahmins according to one's means; one should avoid stinginess with wealth. (59)

5.213.s:
evamuktaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ svayameva nṛpottama ..
gaṇanāthaṃ samuddiśya gauryāḥ purata eva ca .. 6.214.60 ..
5.213.d:
एवमुक्तं मया पूर्वं स्वयमेव नृपोत्तम ..
गणनाथं समुद्दिश्य गौर्याः पुरत एव च .. 6.214.60 ..
5.213.m: Thus it was spoken by me formerly myself, O best of kings, / regarding the Lord of Hosts, right in the presence of Gaurī. (60)

5.213.s:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭā sā devī vākyametaduvāca ha ..
adyaprabhṛti yaḥ putraṃ madīyaṃ gaṇanāya kam .. 61 ..
5.213.d:
ततः प्रहृष्टा सा देवी वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ..
अद्यप्रभृति यः पुत्रं मदीयं गणनाय कम् .. 61 ..
5.213.m: Then, delighted, that goddess spoke this speech: / "From this day forward, whoever my son, Gaṇanāyaka, (61)

5.213.s:
anena vidhinā samyakcaturthyāṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
tasya vighnāni sarvāṇi nāśaṃ yāsyaṃtyasaṃśayam .. 62 ..
5.213.d:
अनेन विधिना सम्यक्चतुर्थ्यां पूजयिष्यति ..
तस्य विघ्नानि सर्वाणि नाशं यास्यंत्यसंशयम् .. 62 ..
5.213.m: properly worships according to this rite on the fourth day— / all his obstacles will go to destruction, without doubt. (62)

5.213.s:
smṛtvā vā pūjayitvā vā yaḥ kāryāṇi kariṣyati ..
bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃdehastatosyāvicalāni ca .. 63 ..
5.213.d:
स्मृत्वा वा पूजयित्वा वा यः कार्याणि करिष्यति ..
भविष्यंति न संदेहस्ततोस्याविचलानि च .. 63 ..
5.213.m: Having remembered or having worshipped [him], whoever undertakes tasks, / they will without doubt become unshakable for him; (63)

5.213.s: na sandehastato'sya śrīracalaiva bhaviṣyati .. 64 ..
5.213.d: न सन्देहस्ततोऽस्य श्रीरचलैव भविष्यति .. 64 ..
5.213.m: and without doubt his prosperity will be unwavering." (64)

5.213.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
tasmāttvaṃ hi mahābhāga caturthyāṃ samyagācara ..
vināyakodbhavāṃ pūjāṃ yenābhīṣṭena yujyase .. 65 ..
5.213.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
तस्मात्त्वं हि महाभाग चतुर्थ्यां सम्यगाचर ..
विनायकोद्भवां पूजां येनाभीष्टेन युज्यसे .. 65 ..
5.213.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "Therefore, O highly fortunate one, perform properly on the fourth day / the worship directed to Vināyaka, so that you may obtain what is desired." (65)

5.213.s:
.. mārkaṇḍeya uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvāmitro mahīpatiḥ ..
gaṇanāthasamudbhūtāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathocitām .. 66 ..
5.213.d:
.. मार्कण्डेय उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रो महीपतिः ..
गणनाथसमुद्भूतां पूजां कृत्वा यथोचिताम् .. 66 ..
5.213.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Hearing that speech of his, Viśvāmitra, the king of the earth, / having performed as appropriate the worship dedicated to Gaṇanātha, (66)

5.213.s:
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ sarvavighnavivarjitam ..
brāhmaṇyaṃ ca tataḥ prāptaṃ sarveṣāmapi durlabham o. 67 ..
5.213.d:
तपश्चचार विपुलं सर्वविघ्नविवर्जितम् ..
ब्राह्मण्यं च ततः प्राप्तं सर्वेषामपि दुर्लभम् ओ. 67 ..
5.213.m: performed vast austerity, free from all obstacles, / and then attained brahminhood, which is difficult even for all to attain. (67)

5.213.s:
tasmāttvaṃ hi mahābhāga vināyakasamudbhavām ..
pūjāṃ kuru caturthyāṃ ca saṃprāptāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
saṃprāpnoṣi mahābhogānhṛdisthānnātra saṃśayaḥ .. 68 ..
5.213.d:
तस्मात्त्वं हि महाभाग विनायकसमुद्भवाम् ..
पूजां कुरु चतुर्थ्यां च संप्राप्तायां विशेषतः ..
संप्राप्नोषि महाभोगान्हृदिस्थान्नात्र संशयः .. 68 ..
5.213.m: Therefore, O highly fortunate one, perform the worship born of Vināyaka, / especially when the fourth lunar day has arrived; / you will attain the great pleasures dwelling in your heart, there is no doubt about this. (68)

5.213.s:
yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya gaṇanāthaṃ prapūjayet ..
sa taṃ sarvamavāpnoti maheśvaravaco yathā .. 69 ..
5.213.d:
यो यं काममभिध्याय गणनाथं प्रपूजयेत् ..
स तं सर्वमवाप्नोति महेश्वरवचो यथा .. 69 ..
5.213.m: Meditating on whatever desire one might worship the lord of Gaṇas, / he obtains all of that, according to the word of Maheśvara. (69)

5.213.s:
aputro labhate putraṃ dhanahīno mahaddhanam ..
śatrūñjayati saṃgrāme smṛtvā taṃ gaṇanāyakam .. 6.214.70 ..
5.213.d:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रं धनहीनो महद्धनम् ..
शत्रूञ्जयति संग्रामे स्मृत्वा तं गणनायकम् .. 6.214.70 ..
5.213.m: One without a son obtains a son; one devoid of wealth obtains great wealth; / he conquers enemies in battle, remembering that leader of Gaṇas. (70)

5.213.s:
yā nārī patinā tyaktā durbhagā ca virūpitā ..
sā saubhāgyamavāpnoti gaṇanāthasya pūjayā .. 71 ..
5.213.d:
या नारी पतिना त्यक्ता दुर्भगा च विरूपिता ..
सा सौभाग्यमवाप्नोति गणनाथस्य पूजया .. 71 ..
5.213.m: A woman abandoned by her husband, unfortunate and disfigured, / attains good fortune through the worship of the lord of Gaṇas. (71)

5.213.s:
ya idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ ..
na vighnaṃ jāyate tasya sarvakṛtyeṣu sarvadā .. 72 ..
5.213.d:
य इदं पठते नित्यं शृणुयाद्वा समाहितः ..
न विघ्नं जायते तस्य सर्वकृत्येषु सर्वदा .. 72 ..
5.213.m: Whoever constantly recites this or hears it with concentrated mind, / no obstacle arises for him at any time in all his undertakings. (72)

5.213.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye viśvāmitropākhyānaprasaṃgena gaṇapatipūjāvidhimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 214 ..
5.213.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये विश्वामित्रोपाख्यानप्रसंगेन गणपतिपूजाविधिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्दशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 214 ..
5.213.m: Thus ends the two hundred and fourteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Procedure and Māhātmya of the Worship of Gaṇapati in the Context of the Story of Viśvāmitra', in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. (214)

5.214.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
sāṃprataṃ vada naḥ sūta śrāddhakalpasya yo vidhiḥ ..
vistareṇa mahābhāga yathā taccākṣayaṃ bhavet .. 1 ..
5.214.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
सांप्रतं वद नः सूत श्राद्धकल्पस्य यो विधिः ..
विस्तरेण महाभाग यथा तच्चाक्षयं भवेत् .. 1 ..
5.214.m: The seers said: / Now tell us, O Sūta, the procedure of the rite of ancestral offerings, / in detail, O highly fortunate one, so that it may become imperishable. (1)

5.214.s:
kasminkāle prakartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ pitṛparāyaṇaiḥ ..
kīdṛśairbrāhmaṇaistacca tathā dravyairmahāmate .. 2 ..
5.214.d:
कस्मिन्काले प्रकर्तव्यं श्राद्धं पितृपरायणैः ..
कीदृशैर्ब्राह्मणैस्तच्च तथा द्रव्यैर्महामते .. 2 ..
5.214.m: At what time should the śrāddha be performed by those devoted to the ancestors? / With what kind of brahmins should it be done, and likewise with what substances, O highly intelligent one? (2)

5.214.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etadarthaṃ purā pṛṣṭo mārkaṃḍeyo mahāmuniḥ ..
rohitāśvena vipreṃdrā hariścandra sutena saḥ..3 ..
5.214.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतदर्थं पुरा पृष्टो मार्कंडेयो महामुनिः ..
रोहिताश्वेन विप्रेंद्रा हरिश्चन्द्र सुतेन सः..3 ..
5.214.m: Sūta said: / For this purpose the great sage Mārkaṇḍeya was questioned long ago, / O foremost of brahmins, by Rohitāśva, the son of Hariścandra. (3)

5.214.s:
hariścandre gate svargaṃ rohitāśve nṛpe sthite ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena mārkaṇḍo munisattamaḥ .. 4 ..
5.214.d:
हरिश्चन्द्रे गते स्वर्गं रोहिताश्वे नृपे स्थिते ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन मार्कण्डो मुनिसत्तमः .. 4 ..
5.214.m: When Hariścandra had gone to heaven and Rohitāśva remained as king, / the best of sages, Mārkaṇḍa, on the occasion of a pilgrimage to sacred fords, (4)

5.214.s:
sarayvāḥ saṃgame puṇye snānārthaṃ samupasthitaḥ ..
tatra snātvā pitṝndevānsaṃtarpya vidhipūrvakam.. 5 ..
5.214.d:
सरय्वाः संगमे पुण्ये स्नानार्थं समुपस्थितः ..
तत्र स्नात्वा पितॄन्देवान्संतर्प्य विधिपूर्वकम्.. 5 ..
5.214.m: arrived at the holy confluence of the Sarayū for the sake of ritual ablution. / Having bathed there and satisfied the ancestors and the gods according to the rules, (5)

5.214.s:
praviṣṭastāṃ purīṃ ramyāmayodhyāṃ satyanāmikām ..
