rohitāśvo'pi taṃ śrutvā samāyātaṃ munīśvaram..
padātiḥ prayayau tūrṇaṃ dūradeśaṃ tu sammukham.. 6 ..
5.214.d:
प्रविष्टस्तां पुरीं रम्यामयोध्यां सत्यनामिकाम् ..
रोहिताश्वोऽपि तं श्रुत्वा समायातं मुनीश्वरम्..
पदातिः प्रययौ तूर्णं दूरदेशं तु सम्मुखम्.. 6 ..
5.214.m: he entered that charming city, Ayodhyā, true to its name. / Rohitāśva also, hearing that the lord of sages had arrived, / set out quickly on foot toward him over a great distance. (6)

5.214.s:
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ mūrdhnā kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ..
provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ vinayena samanvi taḥ .. 7 ..
5.214.d:
ततः प्रणम्य तं मूर्ध्ना कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः ..
प्रोवाच मधुरं वाक्यं विनयेन समन्वि तः .. 7 ..
5.214.m: Then, having bowed to him with his head, standing with folded hands, / filled with modesty, he spoke a sweet word: (7)

5.214.s:
svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ mune ..
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtapuṇyo'haṃ saṃprāptaḥ paramāṃ gatim ..
yatte pādarajobhirme mūrddhajā vimalīkṛtāḥ .. .. 8..
5.214.d:
स्वागतं ते मुनिश्रेष्ठ भूयः सुस्वागतं मुने ..
धन्योऽहं कृतपुण्योऽहं संप्राप्तः परमां गतिम् ..
यत्ते पादरजोभिर्मे मूर्द्धजा विमलीकृताः .. .. 8..
5.214.m: “Welcome to you, O best of sages, again a hearty welcome, O sage! / I am blessed, I have acquired merit, I have attained the highest state, / since my hair has been purified by the dust of your feet!” (8)

5.214.s:
evamuktvā gṛhītvā taṃ svahastālaṃbanaṃ tadā ..
yayau tatra sabhāsthānaṃ bṛhatsiṃhāsanāśrayam .. 9 ..
5.214.d:
एवमुक्त्वा गृहीत्वा तं स्वहस्तालंबनं तदा ..
ययौ तत्र सभास्थानं बृहत्सिंहासनाश्रयम् .. 9 ..
5.214.m: Having spoken thus and then taking hold of his hand as a support, / he went to that assembly hall containing a great throne. (9)

5.214.s:
siṃhāsane niveśyātha taṃ muniṃ pārthivottamaḥ ..
upaviṣṭo dharāpṛṣṭhe kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ .. 6.215.10 ..
5.214.d:
सिंहासने निवेश्याथ तं मुनिं पार्थिवोत्तमः ..
उपविष्टो धरापृष्ठे कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः .. 6.215.10 ..
5.214.m: Then, having seated that sage upon the throne, the best of kings / sat on the surface of the earth and stood with folded hands. (10)

5.214.s:
tataḥ provāca madhuraṃ vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ ..
niḥspṛhasyāpi vipreṃdra ki vā''gamanakāraṇam .. .. 11 ..
5.214.d:
ततः प्रोवाच मधुरं विनयावनतः स्थितः ..
निःस्पृहस्यापि विप्रेंद्र कि वा'ऽगमनकारणम् .. .. 11 ..
5.214.m: Then, standing bent low with modesty, he spoke sweetly: / “O foremost of brahmins, even for one devoid of desire, what is the cause of your arrival? (11)

5.214.s:
tadbravīhi yathātathyaṃ karomi tava sāṃpratam ..
adeyamapi dāsyāmi gṛhāyātasya te vibho .. 12 ..
5.214.d:
तद्ब्रवीहि यथातथ्यं करोमि तव सांप्रतम् ..
अदेयमपि दास्यामि गृहायातस्य ते विभो .. 12 ..
5.214.m: Speak that truthfully; I shall do it for you now. / Even what should not be given I will give to you who have come to my house, O lord.” (12)

5.214.s:
mārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena vayamatra samāgatāḥ ..
sarayvāḥ saṃgame puṇye kalye yāsyāmyahe punaḥ .. 13 ..
5.214.d:
मार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन वयमत्र समागताः ..
सरय्वाः संगमे पुण्ये कल्ये यास्याम्यहे पुनः .. 13 ..
5.214.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “We have come here on the occasion of a pilgrimage to sacred fords; / I shall go again tomorrow to the holy confluence of the Sarayū. (13)

5.214.s:
niḥspṛhairapi draṣṭavyā dharmavanto dvijottamāḥ ..
tataḥ proktaṃ purāṇa jñairbrāhmaṇaiḥ śāstradṛṣṭibhiḥ .. 14 ..
5.214.d:
निःस्पृहैरपि द्रष्टव्या धर्मवन्तो द्विजोत्तमाः ..
ततः प्रोक्तं पुराण ज्ञैर्ब्राह्मणैः शास्त्रदृष्टिभिः .. 14 ..
5.214.m: Even by those devoid of desire, righteous, foremost twice-born ones are to be visited. / Therefore it was said by brahmins knowing the Purāṇas, having the vision of scripture: (14)

5.214.s:
dharmavantaṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ tathā ..
nadīṃ sāgaragāṃ caiva mucyetpāpāddinodbhavāt .. 15
5.214.d:
धर्मवन्तं नृपं दृष्ट्वा लिंगं स्वायंभुवं तथा ..
नदीं सागरगां चैव मुच्येत्पापाद्दिनोद्भवात् .. 15
5.214.m: ‘Seeing a righteous king, and likewise a self-manifest liṅga, / and a river flowing to the ocean, one is freed from the sin born of that day.’ (15)

5.214.s:
evamuktvā tataścakre pṛcchāṃ sa munisattamaḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpaśārdūlaṃ puraḥsthaṃ vinayānvitam .. 16 ..
5.214.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततश्चक्रे पृच्छां स मुनिसत्तमः ..
तं दृष्ट्वा नृपशार्दूलं पुरःस्थं विनयान्वितम् .. 16 ..
5.214.m: Having spoken thus, that best of sages then made an inquiry, / seeing that tiger among kings standing before him endowed with modesty: (16)

5.214.s:
kaccitte saphalā vedāḥ kaccitte saphalaṃ śrutam ..
kaccitte saphalā dārāḥ kaccitte saphalaṃ dhanam.. 17 ..
5.214.d:
कच्चित्ते सफला वेदाः कच्चित्ते सफलं श्रुतम् ..
कच्चित्ते सफला दाराः कच्चित्ते सफलं धनम्.. 17 ..
5.214.m: “Are your Vedas fruitful? Is your learning fruitful? / Is your wife fruitful? Is your wealth fruitful?” (17)

5.214.s:
.. rohitāśva uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ syuḥ saphalā vedāḥ kathaṃ syātsaphalaṃ śrutam ..
kathaṃ syuḥ saphalā dārāḥ kathaṃ syātsaphalaṃ dhanam .. 18 ..
5.214.d:
.. रोहिताश्व उवाच .. ..
कथं स्युः सफला वेदाः कथं स्यात्सफलं श्रुतम् ..
कथं स्युः सफला दाराः कथं स्यात्सफलं धनम् .. 18 ..
5.214.m: Rohitāśva said: / “How would the Vedas be fruitful? How would learning be fruitful? / How would a wife be fruitful? How would wealth be fruitful?” (18)

5.214.s:
.. mārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
agnihotraphalā vedāḥ śīlavṛttaphalaṃ śrutam ..
ratiputraphalā dārā dattabhuktaphalaṃ dhanam .. 19 ..
5.214.d:
.. मार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
अग्निहोत्रफला वेदाः शीलवृत्तफलं श्रुतम् ..
रतिपुत्रफला दारा दत्तभुक्तफलं धनम् .. 19 ..
5.214.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “The Vedas bear fruit in the agnihotra; learning bears fruit in good character and conduct; / a wife bears fruit in pleasure and a son; wealth bears fruit in giving and enjoying. (19)

5.214.s: evaṃ jñātvā mahārāja nānyathā kartumarhasi .. 6.215.20 ..
5.214.d: एवं ज्ञात्वा महाराज नान्यथा कर्तुमर्हसि .. 6.215.20 ..
5.214.m: Knowing thus, O great king, you ought not to act otherwise. (20)

5.214.s:
catvāryetāni kṛtyāni mayoktāni ca tāni te ..
yathā tāni prakṛtyāni lokadvayamabhīpsatā .. 21 ..
5.214.d:
चत्वार्येतानि कृत्यानि मयोक्तानि च तानि ते ..
यथा तानि प्रकृत्यानि लोकद्वयमभीप्सता .. 21 ..
5.214.m: These four duties have been told by me to you, / just as they are to be performed by one desiring both worlds.” (21)

5.214.s:
evamuktvā tataścakre kathāścitrāśca tatpuraḥ ..
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 22 ..
5.214.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततश्चक्रे कथाश्चित्राश्च तत्पुरः ..
राजर्षीणां पुराणानां देवर्षीणां विशेषतः .. 22 ..
5.214.m: Having spoken thus, he then narrated varied tales before him, / especially of ancient royal seers and divine seers. (22)

5.214.s:
tataḥ kathāvasāne ca kasmiṃściddvijasattamāḥ ..
papraccha taṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ rohitāśvo mahīpatiḥ .. 23 ..
5.214.d:
ततः कथावसाने च कस्मिंश्चिद्द्विजसत्तमाः ..
पप्रच्छ तं मुनिश्रेष्ठं रोहिताश्वो महीपतिः .. 23 ..
5.214.m: Then, at the conclusion of a story, O best of twice-borns, / King Rohitāśva questioned that best of sages: (23)

5.214.s:
bhagavañchrotumicchāmi śrāddhakalpamahaṃ yataḥ ..
dṛśyaṃte bahavo bhedā dvijānāṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi .. 24 .. ..
5.214.d:
भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि श्राद्धकल्पमहं यतः ..
दृश्यंते बहवो भेदा द्विजानां श्राद्धकर्मणि .. 24 .. ..
5.214.m: “O venerable one, I wish to hear the procedure of the rite of ancestral offerings, since / many differences among the twice-born are seen in the performance of the śrāddha.” (24)

5.214.s:
.. mārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahābhāga yatpṛṣṭo'smi nṛpottama ..
śrāddhasya bahavo bhedāḥ śākhābhedairvyavasthitāḥ.. 25 ..
5.214.d:
.. मार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाभाग यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि नृपोत्तम ..
श्राद्धस्य बहवो भेदाः शाखाभेदैर्व्यवस्थिताः.. 25 ..
5.214.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “This is true, O highly fortunate one, what I am asked, O best of kings. / Many differences of the śrāddha are established according to the differences of the Vedic branches. (25)

5.214.s:
tasmātte nirṇayaṃ vacmi bhartṛyajñena yatpurā ..
ānarttādhipateḥ proktaṃ samyakchrāddhasya lakṣaṇam .. 26 ..
5.214.d:
तस्मात्ते निर्णयं वच्मि भर्तृयज्ञेन यत्पुरा ..
आनर्त्ताधिपतेः प्रोक्तं सम्यक्छ्राद्धस्य लक्षणम् .. 26 ..
5.214.m: Therefore I will tell you the settled conclusion which of old by Bhartṛyajña / was declared to the ruler of Ānarta as the proper characteristic of the śrāddha. (26)

5.214.s:
bhartṛyajñaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ nijāśramapade nṛpaḥ ..
ānartādhipatirgatvā praṇipatya tato'bravīt .. 27 ..
5.214.d:
भर्तृयज्ञं सुखासीनं निजाश्रमपदे नृपः ..
आनर्ताधिपतिर्गत्वा प्रणिपत्य ततोऽब्रवीत् .. 27 ..
5.214.m: Going to Bhartṛyajña seated comfortably in the grounds of his hermitage, / the ruler of Ānarta bowed down and then said: (27)

5.214.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
sāṃprataṃ vada me brahmañchrāddhakalpaṃ pitrīpsitam ..
yena me tuṣṭimāyāṃti pitaraḥ śrāddhatarpitāḥ .. 28 ..
5.214.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
सांप्रतं वद मे ब्रह्मञ्छ्राद्धकल्पं पित्रीप्सितम् ..
येन मे तुष्टिमायांति पितरः श्राद्धतर्पिताः .. 28 ..
5.214.m: Ānarta said: / ‘Now tell me, O holy one, the procedure of the śrāddha desired by the ancestors, / by which my ancestors, propitiated by the śrāddha, attain satisfaction. (28)

5.214.s:
kaḥ kālo vihitaḥ śrāddhe kāni dravyāṇi me vada ..
śrāddhārhāṇi tathānyāni medhyāni dvi jasattama ..
yāni yojyāni vāṃchadbhiḥ pitṛṇāṃ tṛptimuttamām .. 29 ..
5.214.d:
कः कालो विहितः श्राद्धे कानि द्रव्याणि मे वद ..
श्राद्धार्हाणि तथान्यानि मेध्यानि द्वि जसत्तम ..
यानि योज्यानि वांछद्भिः पितृणां तृप्तिमुत्तमाम् .. 29 ..
5.214.m: What time is prescribed for the śrāddha? Tell me what substances / are fit for the śrāddha and what other pure things, O best of twice-borns, / are to be employed by those desiring the highest satisfaction of the ancestors? (29)

5.214.s:
kīdṛśā brāhmaṇā brahmañchrāddhārhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ..
kīdṛśā varjanīyāśca sarvaṃ me vistarādvada .. 6.215.30 ..
5.214.d:
कीदृशा ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मञ्छ्राद्धार्हाः परिकीर्तिताः ..
कीदृशा वर्जनीयाश्च सर्वं मे विस्तराद्वद .. 6.215.30 ..
5.214.m: What kind of brahmins, O holy one, are proclaimed fit for the śrāddha, / and what kind are to be avoided? Tell me everything in detail.’ (30)

5.214.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ te kīrtayiṣyāmi śrāddhakalpamanuttamam ..
yaṃ śrutvā'pi mahārāja labhecchrāddhaphalaṃ naraḥ .. .. 31 ..
5.214.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
अहं ते कीर्तयिष्यामि श्राद्धकल्पमनुत्तमम् ..
यं श्रुत्वाऽपि महाराज लभेच्छ्राद्धफलं नरः .. .. 31 ..
5.214.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / ‘I shall declare to you the unsurpassed procedure of the śrāddha, / hearing even which, O great king, a man may obtain the fruit of a śrāddha. (31)

5.214.s:
śrāddhamidukṣaye'vaśyaṃ sadā kāryaṃ vipaścitā ..
yadi jyeṣṭhatamaḥ sargaḥ santānaṃ ca tathā nṛpa .. 32 ..
5.214.d:
श्राद्धमिदुक्षयेऽवश्यं सदा कार्यं विपश्चिता ..
यदि ज्येष्ठतमः सर्गः सन्तानं च तथा नृप .. 32 ..
5.214.m: The śrāddha must always be performed by a wise man on the wane of the moon, / if there is the eldest creation and offspring, O king. (32)

5.214.s:
śītārtā yadvadicchaṃti vahniṃ prāvaraṇāni ca ..
pitarastadvadicchaṃti kṣutsāmāścandrasaṃkṣayam .. 33 ..
5.214.d:
शीतार्ता यद्वदिच्छंति वह्निं प्रावरणानि च ..
पितरस्तद्वदिच्छंति क्षुत्सामाश्चन्द्रसंक्षयम् .. 33 ..
5.214.m: Just as those afflicted by cold desire fire and warm coverings, / so do the ancestors, emaciated by hunger, desire the disappearance of the moon.’ (33)

5.214.s:
daridropahatā yadvaddhanaṃ vāṃchaṃti mānavāḥ ..
pitarastadvadicchaṃti kṣutkṣāmāścandrasaṃ kṣayam .. 34 ..
5.214.d:
दरिद्रोपहता यद्वद्धनं वांछंति मानवाः ..
पितरस्तद्वदिच्छंति क्षुत्क्षामाश्चन्द्रसं क्षयम् .. 34 ..
5.214.m: Just as men stricken by poverty desire wealth, / so the ancestors, emaciated by hunger, desire the waning of the moon.

5.214.s:
yathā vṛṣṭiṃ pravāṃchanti karṣukāḥ sasyavṛddhaye ..
tathātmaprītaye te'pi pravāṃchantīṃdusaṃkṣayam .. 35 ..
5.214.d:
यथा वृष्टिं प्रवांछन्ति कर्षुकाः सस्यवृद्धये ..
तथात्मप्रीतये तेऽपि प्रवांछन्तींदुसंक्षयम् .. 35 ..
5.214.m: Just as farmers eagerly desire rain for the growth of their crops, / so they too eagerly desire the waning of the moon for their own satisfaction.

5.214.s:
yathoṣaścakravākyaśca vāṃchanti ravi darśanam ..
pitarastadvadicchaṃti śrāddhaṃ darśasamudbhavam .. 36 ..
5.214.d:
यथोषश्चक्रवाक्यश्च वांछन्ति रवि दर्शनम् ..
पितरस्तद्वदिच्छंति श्राद्धं दर्शसमुद्भवम् .. 36 ..
5.214.m: Just as female cakravāka birds at dawn desire the sight of the sun, / so the ancestors desire the śrāddha born of the new moon.

5.214.s:
jalenāpi ca yaḥ śrāddhaṃ śākenāpi karoti vāḥ ..
darśasya pitarastṛptiṃ yāṃti pāpaṃ praṇa śyati . 37 ..
5.214.d:
जलेनापि च यः श्राद्धं शाकेनापि करोति वाः ..
दर्शस्य पितरस्तृप्तिं यांति पापं प्रण श्यति . 37 ..
5.214.m: And whoever performs a śrāddha on the new moon even with water, or even with vegetables, / their ancestors attain satisfaction, and [their] sin is destroyed.

5.214.s:
amāvāsyādine prāpte gṛhadvāraṃ samāśritā..
vāyubhūtāḥ pravāṃchanti śrāddhaṃ pitṛgaṇā nṛṇām ..
yāvadastamayaṃ bhānoḥ kṣutpipāsāsa mākulāḥ .. 38 ..
5.214.d:
अमावास्यादिने प्राप्ते गृहद्वारं समाश्रिता..
वायुभूताः प्रवांछन्ति श्राद्धं पितृगणा नृणाम् ..
यावदस्तमयं भानोः क्षुत्पिपासास माकुलाः .. 38 ..
5.214.m: When the day of the new moon arrives, having resorted to the doorway of the house, / turned into wind, afflicted with hunger and thirst, the hosts of ancestors of men eagerly desire the śrāddha until the setting of the sun.

5.214.s:
tataścāstaṃ gate bhānau nirāśā duḥkhasaṃyutāḥ ..
niḥśvasya suciraṃ yāṃti garhayaṃti svavaṃśajam .. 39 ..
5.214.d:
ततश्चास्तं गते भानौ निराशा दुःखसंयुताः ..
निःश्वस्य सुचिरं यांति गर्हयंति स्ववंशजम् .. 39 ..
5.214.m: Then, when the sun has set, hopeless and filled with grief, / having sighed for a long time, they depart, reproaching the descendant of their own lineage.

5.214.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
kimarthaṃ kriyate śrāddhamamāvāsyādine dvija ..
viśeṣeṇa mamācakṣya vistareṇa yathātatham .. 6.215.40 ..
5.214.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
किमर्थं क्रियते श्राद्धममावास्यादिने द्विज ..
विशेषेण ममाचक्ष्य विस्तरेण यथातथम् .. 6.215.40 ..
5.214.m: Ānarta said: / For what reason is a śrāddha performed on the day of the new moon, O twice-born one? / Tell me this in detail, particularly and accurately.

5.214.s:
mṛtāśca puruṣā vipra svakarmajanitāṃ gatim ..
gacchanti te kathaṃ tasya sutasyāśrayamāyayuḥ .. 41 ..
5.214.d:
मृताश्च पुरुषा विप्र स्वकर्मजनितां गतिम् ..
गच्छन्ति ते कथं तस्य सुतस्याश्रयमाययुः .. 41 ..
5.214.m: O brahmin, dead men go to the state produced by their own actions. / How do they come to rely upon their son?

5.214.s: eṣa naḥ saṃśayo vipra sumahānhṛdi saṃsthitaḥ .. 42 ..
5.214.d: एष नः संशयो विप्र सुमहान्हृदि संस्थितः .. 42 ..
5.214.m: This very great doubt, O brahmin, resides in our heart.

5.214.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahābhāga yattvayā vyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ ..
svakarmārhāṃ gatiṃ yāṃti mṛtāḥ sarvatra mānavāḥ .. 43 ..
5.214.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाभाग यत्त्वया व्याहृतं वचः ..
स्वकर्मार्हां गतिं यांति मृताः सर्वत्र मानवाः .. 43 ..
5.214.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / This word that has been spoken by you, O fortunate one, is true: / dead men everywhere go to the state deserved by their own action.

5.214.s:
paraṃ yathā samāyāṃti vaṃśajasyāśrayaṃ prati ..
tathā te'haṃ prava kṣyāmi na tathā saṃśayo bhavet .. 44 ..
5.214.d:
परं यथा समायांति वंशजस्याश्रयं प्रति ..
तथा तेऽहं प्रव क्ष्यामि न तथा संशयो भवेत् .. 44 ..
5.214.m: However, how they come toward the shelter of their descendant, / that I shall tell you, so that you may not have such a doubt.

5.214.s:
mṛtā yāṃti tathā rājanye'tra kecinmahītale ..
te jāyaṃte na martye'tra yāvadvaṃśasya saṃsthitiḥ .. 45 ..
5.214.d:
मृता यांति तथा राजन्येऽत्र केचिन्महीतले ..
ते जायंते न मर्त्येऽत्र यावद्वंशस्य संस्थितिः .. 45 ..
5.214.m: O king, some who have died here upon the surface of the earth go thus: / they are not born here among mortals as long as their lineage endures.

5.214.s:
paraṃ śubhātmakā ye ca te tiṣṭhaṃti surālaye ..
pāpātmāno narā ye ca vaivasvatanivāsinaḥ .. 46 ..
5.214.d:
परं शुभात्मका ये च ते तिष्ठंति सुरालये ..
पापात्मानो नरा ये च वैवस्वतनिवासिनः .. 46 ..
5.214.m: Moreover, those who are virtuous stay in the abode of the gods, / while those men who are sinful reside in the realm of Vaivasvata.

5.214.s:
anyadehaṃ samāśritya bhuṃjānāḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam ..
śubhaṃ vā yadi vā pāpaṃ svayaṃ vihitamātmanaḥ .. 47 ..
5.214.d:
अन्यदेहं समाश्रित्य भुंजानाः कर्मणः फलम् ..
शुभं वा यदि वा पापं स्वयं विहितमात्मनः .. 47 ..
5.214.m: Having taken up another body, they enjoy the fruit of [their] action, / whether good or sinful, performed by themselves.

5.214.s:
yamaloke sthitānāṃ hi svargasthānāmapi kṣudhā ..
pipāsā ca tathā rājaṃsteṣāṃ saṃjāyate'dhikā .. 48 ..
5.214.d:
यमलोके स्थितानां हि स्वर्गस्थानामपि क्षुधा ..
पिपासा च तथा राजंस्तेषां संजायतेऽधिका .. 48 ..
5.214.m: Indeed, for those residing in the realm of Yama, and even for those dwelling in heaven, O king, / an intense hunger and thirst arises.

5.214.s:
yāvannaratrayaṃ rājanmātṛtaḥ pitṛtastathā ..
teṣāṃ ca parato ye ca te svakarma śubhāśubham ..
bhuṃjate kṣutpipāsā ca na teṣāṃ jāyate kv cit .. 49 ..
5.214.d:
यावन्नरत्रयं राजन्मातृतः पितृतस्तथा ..
तेषां च परतो ये च ते स्वकर्म शुभाशुभम् ..
भुंजते क्षुत्पिपासा च न तेषां जायते क्व् चित् .. 49 ..
5.214.m: O king, for three generations of men on the mother's side as well as on the father's side, / and those who are beyond them, they experience their own good and bad action, / and hunger and thirst never arise for them.

5.214.s:
tatrāpi patanaṃ tasmātsthānādbhavati bhūmipa ..
vaṃśocchedānpunaḥ sarve nipataṃti mahītale ..
truṭadrajjunibaddhaṃ hi bhāṃḍaṃ yadvannirāśrayam .. .. 6.215.50 ..
5.214.d:
तत्रापि पतनं तस्मात्स्थानाद्भवति भूमिप ..
वंशोच्छेदान्पुनः सर्वे निपतंति महीतले ..
त्रुटद्रज्जुनिबद्धं हि भांडं यद्वन्निराश्रयम् .. .. 6.215.50 ..
5.214.m: Even there, a fall occurs from that place, O protector of the earth; / due to the destruction of their lineage, they all fall back down to the surface of the earth, / just like a vessel tied with a snapping rope, left without support.

5.214.s:
etasmātkāraṇādyatnaḥ santānāya vicakṣaṇaiḥ ..
prakartavyo manuṣyeṃdra vaṃśasya sthitaye sadā .. 51 ..
5.214.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्यत्नः सन्तानाय विचक्षणैः ..
प्रकर्तव्यो मनुष्येंद्र वंशस्य स्थितये सदा .. 51 ..
5.214.m: For this reason, an effort for offspring must always be made / by the wise, O lord of men, for the stability of the lineage.

5.214.s:
api dvādaśadhā rājannaurasādisamu dbhavāḥ ..
teṣāmekatamo'pyatra na daivājjāyate sutaḥ .. 52 ..
pitṝṇāṃ guptaye tena sthāpyo'śvatthaḥ samādhinā ..
putravatparipālyaśca nirviśeṣaṃ narādhipa.. .. 53 ..
5.214.d:
अपि द्वादशधा राजन्नौरसादिसमु द्भवाः ..
तेषामेकतमोऽप्यत्र न दैवाज्जायते सुतः .. 52 ..
पितॄणां गुप्तये तेन स्थाप्योऽश्वत्थः समाधिना ..
पुत्रवत्परिपाल्यश्च निर्विशेषं नराधिप.. .. 53 ..
5.214.m: Even though there are twelve kinds [of sons], O king, born of one's own body and so on, / if by fate not even one son among them is born here, / then, for the protection of the ancestors, a peepal tree should be planted with contemplation / and protected just like a son, without any distinction, O ruler of men.

5.214.s:
yāvatsaṃdhārayedbhūmistamaśvatthaṃ narādhipa ..
kṛtodvāhaṃ samaṃ śamyā tāvadvaṃśo'pi tiṣṭhati .. 54 ..
5.214.d:
यावत्संधारयेद्भूमिस्तमश्वत्थं नराधिप ..
कृतोद्वाहं समं शम्या तावद्वंशोऽपि तिष्ठति .. 54 ..
5.214.m: As long as the earth supports that peepal tree, O ruler of men, / married together with a śamī tree, so long does the lineage also endure.

5.214.s:
aśvatthajanakā martyā nipatya jagatī tale ..
pāpāmuktāḥ samāyāṃti yoniṃ śreṣṭhāṃ śubhānvitāḥ .. 55 ..
5.214.d:
अश्वत्थजनका मर्त्या निपत्य जगती तले ..
पापामुक्ताः समायांति योनिं श्रेष्ठां शुभान्विताः .. 55 ..
5.214.m: Mortals who are the progenitors of a peepal tree, having fallen down to the surface of the world, / freed from sins, attain an excellent womb, endowed with auspiciousness.

5.214.s:
etasmātkāraṇādannaṃ nityaṃ deyaṃ tathodakam ..
samuddiśya pitṝnrājanyataste tanmayāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 56 ..
5.214.d:
एतस्मात्कारणादन्नं नित्यं देयं तथोदकम् ..
समुद्दिश्य पितॄन्राजन्यतस्ते तन्मयाः स्मृताः .. 56 ..
5.214.m: For this reason, food and water should be given daily / dedicated to the ancestors, O king, because they are traditionally regarded as consisting of that.

5.214.s:
adattvā salilaṃ sasyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ yo narādhipa ..
svayamaśnāti vā toyaṃ pivetsa syātpitṛdruhaḥ ..
svarge'pi ca na te toyaṃ labhaṃte nānnameva ca .. 57 ..
5.214.d:
अदत्त्वा सलिलं सस्यं पितॄणां यो नराधिप ..
स्वयमश्नाति वा तोयं पिवेत्स स्यात्पितृद्रुहः ..
स्वर्गेऽपि च न ते तोयं लभंते नान्नमेव च .. 57 ..
5.214.m: O ruler of men, he who eats or drinks water himself without having given water and grain to the ancestors / is a injurer of the ancestors; / even in heaven they receive neither water nor food.

5.214.s:
na dattaṃ vaṃśajairmartyaiścedvyathāṃ yāṃti dāruṇām ..
kṣutpipāsāsamudbhūtāṃ tasmātsaṃtarpayetpitṝn .. .. 58 ..
5.214.d:
न दत्तं वंशजैर्मर्त्यैश्चेद्व्यथां यांति दारुणाम् ..
क्षुत्पिपासासमुद्भूतां तस्मात्संतर्पयेत्पितॄन् .. .. 58 ..
5.214.m: If it is not given by mortal descendants, they undergo severe pain / arising from hunger and thirst; therefore, one should satisfy the ancestors.

5.214.s:
nityaṃ śaktyā naro rājanpayo'nnaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
tathānyairvastranaivedyaiḥ puṣpagandhānulepanaiḥ .. 59 ..
5.214.d:
नित्यं शक्त्या नरो राजन्पयोऽन्नैश्च पृथग्विधैः ..
तथान्यैर्वस्त्रनैवेद्यैः पुष्पगन्धानुलेपनैः .. 59 ..
5.214.m: Daily, according to his capacity, a man, O king, with milk, various kinds of foods, / and with other garments, offerings of food, flowers, and fragrant unguents,

5.214.s:
pitṛmedhādibhiḥ puṇyaiḥ śrāddhairuccāvacairapi ..
tarpitāste prayacchaṃti kāmāniṣṭānhṛdi sthitān ..
trivargaṃ ca mahārāja pitaraḥ śrāddhatarpitāḥ .. .. 6.215.60 ..
5.214.d:
पितृमेधादिभिः पुण्यैः श्राद्धैरुच्चावचैरपि ..
तर्पितास्ते प्रयच्छंति कामानिष्टान्हृदि स्थितान् ..
त्रिवर्गं च महाराज पितरः श्राद्धतर्पिताः .. .. 6.215.60 ..
5.214.m: with holy ancestral sacrifices and so forth, and with various śrāddhas— / satisfied, they bestow desired wishes residing in the heart / and the three goals of life, O great king, [these] ancestors satisfied by śrāddha.

5.214.s:
tarpayaṃti na ye pāpāḥ svapitṝnnityaśo nṛpa ..
paśavaste sadā jñeyā dvipadāḥ śṛṃgavarjitāḥ .. 61 ..
5.214.d:
तर्पयंति न ये पापाः स्वपितॄन्नित्यशो नृप ..
पशवस्ते सदा ज्ञेया द्विपदाः शृंगवर्जिताः .. 61 ..
5.214.m: Those wicked people who do not daily satisfy their own ancestors, O king, / are always to be known as animals on two legs, devoid of horns.

5.214.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhāvaśyakatākāraṇavarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśottaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ .. 215 ..
5.214.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे श्राद्धावश्यकताकारणवर्णनंनाम पञ्चदशोत्तरद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः .. 215 ..
5.214.m: Thus ends the two hundred and fifteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Cause of the Necessity of Śrāddha' in the Rules of Śrāddha in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
